features.name: Nieuwe Tolbrug
features.opening: De Nieuwe Tolbrug in de Nederlandse plaats Voorburg (ook bekend als Kippetjesbrug of Kippenbruggetje) is een ophaalbrug over de Vliet uit het jaar 1891/1892.

facts.text: Swimming youth frequently use the area around this bridge on summer days.
facts.sourceQuote: Op zomerse dagen is de brug populair bij de zwemmende jeugd uit de buurt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On summer days, the bridge is popular with the swimming youth from the neighborhood.

features.name: Zoetermeer Stadslijn
features.opening: Zoetermeer Stadslijn is a light-rail line converted from a former commuter rail line in the Netherlands, between The Hague and Zoetermeer.

facts.text: The line switched from Dutch Railways management to light-rail tram service in June 2006.
facts.sourceQuote: Originally, the line was managed by the Dutch Railways (NS). Since June 2006, it has served as a light-rail line, using trams.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Originally, the line was managed by the Dutch Railways (NS). Since June 2006, it has served as a light-rail line, using trams.

facts.text: An extra track was added after the Oosterheem neighbourhood construction in Zoetermeer.
facts.sourceQuote: After the Oosterheem neighbourhood was built in Zoetermeer, an extra track was added.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the Oosterheem neighbourhood was built in Zoetermeer, an extra track was added.

facts.text: Unlike other routes, this line splits between Seghweart and Leidsewallen stations instead of looping.
facts.sourceQuote: It does not take the round line, unlike the other routes, but splits between Seghweart and Leidsewallen stations.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It does not take the round line, unlike the other routes, but splits between Seghweart and Leidsewallen stations.

facts.text: In 2020, a new line 34 merged the routes of lines 3 and 4.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2020 a new line 34 was added combining the routes of line 3 in The Hague and that of line 4 in Zoetermeer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2020 a new line 34 was added combining the routes of line 3 in The Hague and that of line 4 in Zoetermeer.

facts.text: Line 3 uses the older track while line 4 takes the newer Oosterheem route.
facts.sourceQuote: Line 3 uses the older track, and line 4, or the Oosterheem line, takes the newer track.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Line 3 uses the older track, and line 4, or the Oosterheem line, takes the newer track.

features.name: Netkous

features.name: Spoorbrug Nootdorpboog
features.opening: De Spoorbrug Nootdorpboog is een spoorbrug in de Nederlandse provincie Zuid-Holland, op de grens tussen Nootdorp en Leidschenveen-Ypenburg.

facts.text: Unlike standard tracks, this line exists solely to provide access to the NS Maintenance & Service train workshop in Leidschendam.
facts.sourceQuote: Dit is geen reguliere spoorlijn, maar een lijn bedoeld om de treinwerkplaats van NS Onderhoud & Service in Leidschendam te kunnen bereiken vanaf het hoofdspoornetwerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This is not a regular railway line, but a line intended to enable access to the train workshop of NS Maintenance & Service in Leidschendam from the main rail network.

facts.text: Thirteen pipe elements form the arches, spaced by eight meters between hangers.
facts.sourceQuote: De bogen bestaan uit dertien rechte buiselementen, tussen de twaalf hangers is steeds een onderlinge afstand van 8 meter.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The arches consist of thirteen straight pipe elements, there is always an inter-element distance of 8 meters between the twelve hangers.

facts.text: Colijn and Gebroeders de Koning built this bridge as a construction consortium.
facts.sourceQuote: De brug is gebouwd door een aannemerscombinatie bestaande uit Colijn en Gebroeders de Koning.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bridge was built by a construction consortium consisting of Colijn and Gebroeders de Koning.

facts.text: Engineers used S355 steel and B45 concrete for its structural components.
facts.sourceQuote: De staalkwaliteit is S355, de betonkwaliteit is B45.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The steel quality is S355, the concrete quality is B45.

facts.text: A 2004 raise increased the clearance from KP +0.20 m to aid shipping traffic.
facts.sourceQuote: De Zwartebrug is ten behoeve van het scheepvaartverkeer in 2004 verhoogd; daarvoor was de doorvaarthoogte KP +0,20 m.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Zwartebrug was raised in 2004 for the benefit of shipping traffic; before that, the clearance height was KP +0.20 m.

facts.text: Bridge heights are measured relative to the Delfland basin level, with a target of NAP −0.43 meters.
facts.sourceQuote: De brughoogten zijn aangegeven ten opzichte van het kanaalpeil, dat is het Delflands boezempeil. Streefpeil is NAP −0,43 m.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bridge heights are indicated relative to the canal level, which is the Delfland basin level. Target level is NAP −0.43 m.

facts.text: Sloping walls on some bridges reduce the actual passage width available underwater compared to the surface.
facts.sourceQuote: De wijdte van de bruggen is aangegeven op het waterniveau, maar rekening moet worden gehouden met het feit dat sommige bruggen zijn gebouwd met schuin aflopende muren. Daardoor is onder water minder doorvaartwijdte beschikbaar.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The width of the bridges is indicated at the water level, but it must be taken into account that some bridges were built with sloping walls. As a result, less passage width is available underwater.

facts.text: Water levels fluctuate locally by about 20 to 25 centimeters due to wind, precipitation, and pumping stations.
facts.sourceQuote: Onder invloed van neerslag, wind en gemaalinzet kan de waterstand lokaal zo'n 20 tot 25 cm afwijken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Under the influence of precipitation, wind and pumping station use, the water level can locally deviate by about 20 to 25 cm.

features.name: Railway bridge over the Vliet
features.opening: De Spoorbrug over de Vliet (ook wel Hoge Brug) is een spoorbrug over de Vliet, gelegen tussen de Nederlandse plaatsen Leidschendam en Voorburg.

facts.text: The Hofplein line construction in 1907 and 1908 brought this bridge to life.
facts.sourceQuote: De brug is aan het begin van de 20e eeuw aangelegd in het kader van de bouw van de Hofpleinlijn in 1907/1908.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bridge was built at the beginning of the 20th century as part of the construction of the Hofplein line in 1907/1908.

facts.text: Travelers once used a separate pedestrian bridge here to reach Leidschendam-Voorburg station from Leidschendam.
facts.sourceQuote: Naast de spoorbrug was een voetgangersbrug waarmee reizigers vanuit Leidschendam het station Leidschendam-Voorburg konden bereiken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In addition to the railway bridge, there was a pedestrian bridge with which travelers could reach Leidschendam-Voorburg station from Leidschendam.

features.name: Leeghwaterbrug
features.opening: De Leeghwaterbrug is een brug in Den Haag, in het zuidelijke stadsdeel Laak.

facts.text: Tram lines 1, 16, and 17 travel directly over both the square and the bridge.
facts.sourceQuote: Over het plein en de brug rijden de Haagse tramlijnen 1, 16 en 17.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Hague tram lines 1, 16 and 17 run over the square and the bridge.

facts.sourceQuote: On 2 August 2024 the doubling of the tracks was completed after a long delay.

facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From December 2011 it is used by all direct trains from Amsterdam to The Hague, and all direct supplement-free trains from Amsterdam to Rotterdam except those through Woerden.

features.name: Scheveningsebrug
features.opening: Scheveningsebrug is de naam van een brug in het noordwesten van de historische stadskern van Den Haag.

facts.text: Until the nineteenth century, the Noordeinde served as the main route for Scheveningen traffic.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Noordeinde was tot in de negentiende eeuw de hoofdtoegang tot Den Haag voor verkeer van- en naar het dorp Scheveningen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until the nineteenth century, the Noordeinde was the main access to The Hague for traffic from and to the village of Scheveningen.

facts.text: The path leading to Scheveningen likely dates back to Roman times with a nearby fort.
facts.sourceQuote: De route die leidde naar Scheveningen gaat waarschijnlijk terug tot de Romeinse tijd, wat onder meer blijkt uit de aanwezigheid van een klein Romeins fort.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The route that led to Scheveningen probably dates back to Roman times, as evidenced by the presence of a small Roman fort, among other things.

facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In March 2015 a new tunnel and station were opened in Delft, underpassing the former railway station and viaduct.

facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From December 2011 it is used by all direct trains from Amsterdam to The Hague, and all direct supplement-free trains from Amsterdam to Rotterdam except those through Woerden.

features.name: Wijkerbrug
features.opening: De Wijkerbrug in de Nederlandse plaats Voorburg is een ophaalbrug over de Vliet uit het jaar 1891.

facts.text: Originally built as a fixed bridge, it was converted into a lift bridge in 1919.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de bouw was de brug uitgevoerd als vaste brug. In 1919 is de brug omgebouwd tot ophaalbrug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During construction, the bridge was built as a fixed bridge. In 1919, the bridge was converted into a lift bridge.

facts.text: The name Wijkerbrug first appeared in 1556 as Wijcki brugghe on an old map.
facts.sourceQuote: De oudste vermelding van de naam Wijkerbrug komt uit 1556, waar de brug als Wijcki brugghe vermeld staat op een kaart van Coenraet Oelensz.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The oldest mention of the name Wijkerbrug dates back to 1556, where the bridge is listed as Wijcki brugghe on a map by Coenraet Oelensz.

facts.text: A bridge over the Vliet existed at this spot as early as the thirteenth century.
facts.sourceQuote: Reeds in de 13e eeuw lag op deze plaats een brug over de Vliet nabij de oude buurtschap Wiic of Wike.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: As early as the 13th century, there was a bridge over the Vliet near the old hamlet of Wiic or Wike.

features.name: Geestbrug
features.opening: De Geestbrug is een basculebrug over de Haagvliet of Trekvliet uit het jaar 1933, gelegen in de Nederlandse provincie Zuid-Holland.

facts.text: The current bascule bridge opened in 1933, replacing an earlier double lift bridge from 1892.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1892 werd de oude vaste brug vervangen door een dubbele ophaalbrug. In 1933 werd de huidige basculebrug geopend als verbinding tussen de Geestbrugweg in Rijswijk en de Prinses Mariannelaan in Voorburg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1892, the old fixed bridge was replaced by a double lift bridge. In 1933, the current bascule bridge was opened as a connection between the Geestbrugweg in Rijswijk and the Prinses Mariannelaan in Voorburg.

facts.text: About 200 Spanish soldiers died during the Battle of the Geestbrug following their defeat in Leiden.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de terugtocht van de in 1574 in Leiden verslagen Spanjaarden, die met rond 1100 man onder bevel van Don Alonzo Lopez Gallio naar Den Haag trokken om daar te overwinteren, volgde met onder anderen de Geuzen de Slag bij de Geestbrug. Tijdens deze veldslag lieten zo'n 200 Spanjaarden het leven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the retreat of the Spaniards defeated in Leiden in 1574, who with around 1100 men under the command of Don Alonzo Lopez Gallio marched to The Hague to winter there, the Battle of the Geestbrug followed, among others, by the Geuzen. During this battle, about 200 Spaniards lost their lives.

facts.text: The municipality of The Hague annexed the Trekvliet water in 2002 to construct a new route.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2002 heeft de gemeente Den Haag het water van de Trekvliet geannexeerd om het Trekvliettracé aan te leggen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2002, the municipality of The Hague annexed the water from the Trekvliet to build the Trekvliet route.

facts.text: Since 2002, Rijswijk no longer shares a border with Voorburg at this specific bridge site.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 2002 grenst Rijswijk ter plaatse van de Geestbrug niet meer aan Voorburg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2002, Rijswijk no longer borders Voorburg at the Geestbrug site.

features.name: Nootdorpboog
features.opening: De Nootdorpboog is een enkelsporige verbinding voor het NS-treinmaterieel tussen de spoorlijn Gouda - Den Haag en de werkplaats van NS Onderhoud & Service…

facts.text: A steel arch bridge carries the single track over the A12 motorway.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze enkelsporige boog kruist met een stalen boogbrug de autosnelweg A12.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This single-track arch crosses the A12 motorway with a steel arch bridge.

facts.text: Nootdorpboog previously named a proposed but unrealized connection near Zoetermeer.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam Nootdorpboog is eerder gebruikt voor een mogelijke toekomstige verbinding van de Zoetermeer Stadslijn met de Hofpleinlijn richting Rotterdam, in de "oksel" tussen Zoetermeer Stadslijn, Hofpleinlijn, A12 en de golfbaan bij het Zoetermeerse Westerpark.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name Nootdorpboog has previously been used for a possible future connection of the Zoetermeer City Line with the Hofplein Line towards Rotterdam, in the "axillary" area between the Zoetermeer City Line, Hofplein Line, A12 and the golf course near Zoetermeerse Westerpark.

features.name: Kerkbrug
features.opening: De huidige Kerkbrug is een brug aan de rand van de Nederlandse plaats Voorburg.

facts.text: A permanent brick replacement was erected in 1892, leaving its bridgeheads visible today.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1892 werd er een nieuwe vaste brug gebouwd, waarvan de bakstenen bruggenhoofden nog te zien zijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1892 a new permanent bridge was built, the brick bridgeheads of which can still be seen.

features.name: Damesleesmuseum
features.opening: Het Damesleesmuseum is een particuliere bibliotheek in Den Haag, opgericht op 15 mei 1894.

facts.text: After moving through five different locations, the museum settled at Nassauplein 15 in 1950.
facts.sourceQuote: Na omzwervingen langs Noordeinde 20, Parkstraat 8, Lange Voorhout 48, Lange Vijverberg 15 en Koninginnegracht 12B ging het Damesleesmuseum in 1950 naar Nassauplein 15.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After wandering around Noordeinde 20, Parkstraat 8, Lange Voorhout 48, Lange Vijverberg 15 and Koninginnegracht 12B, Damesleesmuseum moved to Nassauplein 15 in 1950.

facts.text: Men were first allowed to join the library in 1974.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 1974 staat het lidmaatschap ook open voor mannen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1974, membership has also been open to men.

facts.text: The collection grows monthly as new books are added without ever discarding old ones.
facts.sourceQuote: Elke maand worden er nieuwe boeken aangeschaft zonder dat er oude boeken worden weggedaan, zodat de collectie nog steeds groeit.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: New books are purchased every month without old books being discarded, so that the collection continues to grow.

facts.text: A special unit here houses international suspects under direct UN responsibility.
facts.sourceQuote: A special independent unit in the Scheveningen location serves as a United Nations Detention Unit (UNDU) for international offenders where they remain in pre-trial detention under the responsibility of the United Nations like suspects of the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia (ICTY) and of the International Criminal Court (ICC).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A special independent unit in the Scheveningen location serves as a United Nations Detention Unit (UNDU) for international offenders where they remain in pre-trial detention under the responsibility of the United Nations like suspects of the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia (ICTY) and of the International Criminal Court (ICC).

facts.text: The Scheveningen site features an open design limited secured installation.
facts.sourceQuote: The Zoetermeer location is for Systematic offenders and the Scheveningen location serves as a Penitentiary Psychiatric Center, the 'open design' Limited Secured Installation and Judicial Medical Center.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Zoetermeer location is for Systematic offenders and the Scheveningen location serves as a Penitentiary Psychiatric Center, the 'open design' Limited Secured Installation and Judicial Medical Center.

facts.text: The facility opened in 1995 within the Rokkenhage district.
facts.sourceQuote: The Zoetermeer location of the Hague Penitentiary Institution was built in 1995 and is located in the Rokkenhage district of Zoetermeer, a city in western Netherlands, in the province of South Holland.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Zoetermeer location of the Hague Penitentiary Institution was built in 1995 and is located in the Rokkenhage district of Zoetermeer, a city in western Netherlands, in the province of South Holland.

features.name: Trêveszaal
features.opening: De Trêveszaal is een historische vergaderzaal uit 1697 op het Binnenhof in Den Haag en maakt deel uit van de gebouwen van het ministerie van Algemene Zaken.

facts.text: In 1697, a delegation of Russian envoys was received in this hall.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1697 werd hier een delegatie van Russische gezanten ontvangen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1697, a delegation of Russian envoys was received here.

facts.text: Foreign Minister Maxime Verhagen was reprimanded in 2009 for posting a photo taken inside the room online.
facts.sourceQuote: Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken Maxime Verhagen werd in 2009 door premier Balkenende berispt toen hij een foto in de zaal maakte en die op internet plaatste.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Minister of Foreign Affairs Maxime Verhagen was reprimanded by Prime Minister Balkenende in 2009 when he took a photo in the room and posted it on the internet.

facts.text: Prime Minister Kok and German Chancellor Kohl met here in 1995.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1995 ontmoetten minister-president Kok en de Duitse Bondskanselier Kohl elkaar in de Trêveszaal.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1995, Prime Minister Kok and German Chancellor Kohl met in the Trêveszaal.

facts.text: The Trêveszaal takes its name from peace negotiations held here in 1608 between the Dutch Republic and Spain.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1608 vonden in een van deze vertrekken vredesonderhandelingen plaats tussen de Republiek der Zeven Verenigde Nederlanden en de Spanjaarden. De Trêveszaal of Bestandszaal, zou hier later zijn naam aan ontlenen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1608, peace negotiations took place in one of these rooms between the Republic of the Seven United Provinces and the Spanish. The Trêveszaal or Archive Hall, would later take its name from here.

features.name: Paleis Noordeinde
features.opening: Noordeinde Palace (Dutch: Paleis Noordeinde, Dutch pronunciation: [paːˌlɛis noːrtˈɛində] ) is one of three official palaces of the Dutch royal family.

facts.text: King Willem-Alexander and Queen Máxima have used this palace as their official workplace since 2013.
facts.sourceQuote: Located in the city centre of The Hague in the province of South Holland, it has been used as the official workplace of King Willem-Alexander and Queen Máxima since 2013.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Located in the city centre of The Hague in the province of South Holland, it has been used as the official workplace of King Willem-Alexander and Queen Máxima since 2013.

facts.text: The public can stroll through the Palace Gardens daily from sunrise to sunset.
facts.sourceQuote: The Palace Gardens are open to the public daily between sunrise and sunset, while the buildings on the palace grounds are only open to the public during specific days of the year.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Palace Gardens are open to the public daily between sunrise and sunset, while the buildings on the palace grounds are only open to the public during specific days of the year.

facts.text: While gardens are open daily, the palace buildings themselves only welcome visitors on specific days each year.
facts.sourceQuote: The Palace Gardens are open to the public daily between sunrise and sunset, while the buildings on the palace grounds are only open to the public during specific days of the year.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Palace Gardens are open to the public daily between sunrise and sunset, while the buildings on the palace grounds are only open to the public during specific days of the year.

features.name: Binnenhof
features.opening: The Binnenhof (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈbɪnə(n)ˌɦɔf] ; English: Inner Court) is a complex of buildings in the city centre of The Hague, Netherlands, next to the…

facts.text: Originally a 13th-century Gothic castle for Holland's counts, it became the Dutch Republic's political center in 1584.
facts.sourceQuote: Built primarily in the 13th century, the Gothic castle originally functioned as residence of the counts of Holland and became the political centre of the Dutch Republic in 1584.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Built primarily in the 13th century, the Gothic castle originally functioned as residence of the counts of Holland and became the political centre of the Dutch Republic in 1584.

facts.text: The King delivers his annual Speech from the Throne here every third Tuesday of September.
facts.sourceQuote: Every third Tuesday of September, on Prinsjesdag, this is where the King holds his annual Speech from the Throne.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Every third Tuesday of September, on Prinsjesdag, this is where the King holds his annual Speech from the Throne.

facts.text: A statue of King William II guards the gate known as the Stadtholder's Gate.
facts.sourceQuote: A gilt Neo-Gothic fountain adorns the courtyard and a statue of King William II, one of few Dutch equestrian statues, guards its gate, the Stadtholder's Gate, which dates from 1620.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A gilt Neo-Gothic fountain adorns the courtyard and a statue of King William II, one of few Dutch equestrian statues, guards its gate, the Stadtholder's Gate, which dates from 1620.

features.name: Kunstmuseum Den Haag
features.opening: The Kunstmuseum Den Haag is an art museum in The Hague in the Netherlands, founded in 1866 as the Museum voor Moderne Kunst.

facts.text: Victoria Hefting became the museum's first female director shortly after World War II.
facts.sourceQuote: Soon after the war, the Gemeentemuseum appointed its first female director, Victoria Hefting – one of the first women to assume such a position in the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Soon after the war, the Gemeentemuseum appointed its first female director, Victoria Hefting – one of the first women to assume such a position in the Netherlands.

facts.text: Hefting resigned in 1950 because Dutch law then forbade married women from government service.
facts.sourceQuote: Hefting remarried in 1950 and was obliged to resign. it was legally not permitted for married women to work in government services, a law that would not be repealed until 1957.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Hefting remarried in 1950 and was obliged to resign. it was legally not permitted for married women to work in government services, a law that would not be repealed until 1957.

facts.text: The institution was previously known as Haags Gemeentemuseum until 1998.
facts.sourceQuote: Later, until 1998, it was known as Haags Gemeentemuseum, and until the end of September 2019 as Gemeentemuseum Den Haag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Later, until 1998, it was known as Haags Gemeentemuseum, and until the end of September 2019 as Gemeentemuseum Den Haag.

features.name: Beeld en Geluid Den Haag
features.opening: Beeld & Geluid in Den Haag is in 1929 opgericht als Postmuseum.

facts.text: The institution opened in 1929 as a Post Museum before evolving into a media museum.
facts.sourceQuote: Beeld & Geluid in Den Haag is in 1929 opgericht als Postmuseum. Het was tot 2024 een Nederlands interactief museum over het leven in de media, gevestigd aan de Zeestraat 82 in Den Haag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Beeld & Geluid in Den Haag was founded in 1929 as a Post Museum. Until 2024, it was a Dutch interactive museum about life in the media, located at Zeestraat 82 in Den Haag.

facts.text: Beeld en Geluid Den Haag was previously known as COMM and the PTT Museum.
facts.sourceQuote: Tot 2019 was het museum bekend onder de naam COMM en eerder ook als Museum voor Communicatie en als het PTT Museum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until 2019, the museum was known under the name COMM and previously also as the Museum for Communication and as the PTT Museum.

facts.text: The institution was established in 1929 under the original name 'Het Nederlandsche Postmuseum'.
facts.sourceQuote: Het museum is 1929 als Stichting 'Het Nederlandsche Postmuseum' opgericht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was founded in 1929 as a foundation called 'Het Nederlandsche Postmuseum'.

facts.text: Despite its name, the museum covered telegraphy and telephony alongside mail history and philately.
facts.sourceQuote: Anders dan de naam doet vermoeden, was het een museum over de geschiedenis van post, filatelie (het verzamelen en de studie van postzegels en bijbehorende zaken), telegrafie en telefonie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Contrary to the name suggests, it was a museum about the history of mail, philately (the collection and study of stamps and related items), telegraphy and telephony.

features.name: Kerk van Eikenduinen
features.opening: De Kerk van Eikenduinen, beter bekend onder de naam Ruïne of Kapel van Eikenduinen, was een rooms-katholiek kerkgebouw gelegen in de oude duinen tussen…

facts.text: Count William II built the chapel to honor his father, Floris IV, who died in a tournament.
facts.sourceQuote: Waarschijnlijk tussen 1247 en 1255 liet graaf Willem II van Holland een kapel bouwen ter gedachtenis van zijn vader graaf Floris IV, die om het leven was gekomen tijdens een toernooi te Corbie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Probably between 1247 and 1255, Count William II of Holland had a chapel built in memory of his father Count Floris IV, who had died during a tournament in Corbie.

facts.text: The hamlet of Eikenduinen grew up around the chapel that Count William II had constructed.
facts.sourceQuote: In de omgeving van de kapel ontwikkelde zich vervolgens een gehucht, dat Eikenduinen werd genoemd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the vicinity of the chapel, a hamlet developed, which was called Eikenduinen.

facts.text: Originally, its chaplain shared lunch with the count at The Hague's Binnenhof before losing this privilege.
facts.sourceQuote: Hierbij speelde een rol dat dat de kapelaan van Eikenduinen een van de vier priesters was die de kapel op het Binnenhof bedienden en wanneer de graaf of gravin in Den Haag was, het middagmaal met hem deelden. Aan die gewoonte wilde graaf Willem III een einde maken door van de kapel een parochiekerk te maken en die te laten bedienen door een van de kanunniken van de abt, onder het beding dat die kanunnik-pastoor niet meer het voorrecht zou hebben om op het Binnenhof te eten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A role played here was that the chaplain of Eikenduinen was one of the four priests who served the chapel on the Binnenhof and when the count or countess was in The Hague, shared lunch with him. Count William III wanted to put an end to that custom by making the chapel a parish church and having it served by one of the canons of the abbot, on the condition that that canon-pastor would no longer have the privilege of eating at the Binnenhof.

features.name: The Hague Academy of International Law
features.opening: The Hague Academy of International Law (French: Académie de droit international de La Haye) is a center for high-level education in both public and private…

facts.text: Summer courses finally began on July 14, 1923, after World War I delayed the planned 1914 inauguration.
facts.sourceQuote: The inauguration of the academy was planned for October 1914 but was delayed by the outbreak of World War I in the preceding summer, and preparations could not be resumed until 1921. When the Summer Courses started on 14 July 1923 at the Peace Palace, 353 students originating from 31 countries attended, of whom 35 were women.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The inauguration of the academy was planned for October 1914 but was delayed by the outbreak of World War I in the preceding summer, and preparations could not be resumed until 1921. When the Summer Courses started on 14 July 1923 at the Peace Palace, 353 students originating from 31 countries attended, of whom 35 were women.

facts.text: Lawyer Tobias Asser won the 1911 Nobel Peace Prize and donated part of that prize money to fund the academy.
facts.sourceQuote: Asser received the Nobel Peace Prize in 1911 and contributed a part of the prize money to the academy; and the Carnegie Endowment for Peace provided a valuable contribution to get it started.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Asser received the Nobel Peace Prize in 1911 and contributed a part of the prize money to the academy; and the Carnegie Endowment for Peace provided a valuable contribution to get it started.

facts.text: The institution received a nomination for the Nobel Peace Prize seventy-three times between 1915 and 1974.
facts.sourceQuote: The academy has been nominated for the Nobel Peace Prize 73 times between 1915 and 1974.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The academy has been nominated for the Nobel Peace Prize 73 times between 1915 and 1974.

features.name: Internationaal Homomonument
features.opening: Internationaal Homomonument Den Haag is een gedenkteken uit 1993 aan de Koekamp in Den Haag, ontworpen door Theo ten Have.

facts.text: The monument was created by Theo ten Have, a local artist from The Hague.
facts.sourceQuote: Daarna viel uiteindelijk unaniem de keuze op het ontwerp van de Haagse kunstenaar Theo ten Have.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After that, the choice ultimately fell unanimously on the design of the Hague artist Theo ten Have.

features.name: Museon-Omniversum
features.opening: Museon is a museum for science and culture in The Hague, Netherlands, with a strong focus on education.

facts.text: Newspaper director Frits van Paasschen initiated the museum in 1904 to teach children about industry.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum was initiated in 1904 by the newspaper director Frits van Paasschen, who wanted to establish a museum where children could learn about industry.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was initiated in 1904 by the newspaper director Frits van Paasschen, who wanted to establish a museum where children could learn about industry.

facts.text: Geologist Herman van Cappelle shifted the collection policy toward natural history and ethnology as first director.
facts.sourceQuote: Under the museum's first director, the geologist Herman van Cappelle, the collection policy moved towards natural history and ethnology.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Under the museum's first director, the geologist Herman van Cappelle, the collection policy moved towards natural history and ethnology.

facts.text: Museon is a shortening of the original Dutch name Museum ten bate van het Onderwijs.
facts.sourceQuote: The name Museon is a shortening of the museum's original extended Dutch name - Museum ten bate van het Onderwijs.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name Museon is a shortening of the museum's original extended Dutch name - Museum ten bate van het Onderwijs.

facts.text: In 2022, Museon merged with the nearby cinema Omniversum to become Museon-Omniversum: One Planet.
facts.sourceQuote: Since 2022, the museum has been merged with the nearby cinema Omniversum, and goes by the name Museon-Omniversum: One Planet
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2022, the museum has been merged with the nearby cinema Omniversum, and goes by the name Museon-Omniversum: One Planet

features.name: Vissersmonument
features.opening: Scheveningen telt een drietal Vissersmonumenten.

facts.text: The oldest monument was unveiled on September 26, 1922 to honor fishermen lost in World War I.
facts.sourceQuote: Het oudste ervan werd op 26 september 1922 onthuld ter nagedachtenis aan die Scheveningse vissers, die tijdens de Eerste Wereldoorlog door oorlogsgeweld op zee het leven hadden gelaten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The oldest of them was unveiled on September 26, 1922 in memory of those Scheveningen fishermen who lost their lives during World War I due to war violence at sea.

facts.text: Scheveningen actually contains a trio of these monuments rather than just one.
facts.sourceQuote: Scheveningen telt een drietal Vissersmonumenten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Scheveningen has a trio of Vissersmonumenten.

facts.text: Queen Wilhelmina unveiled the monument in September 1922 alongside her husband, Prince Henry.
facts.section: Daar waar nacht noch nevel is
facts.sourceQuote: Het kunstwerk is ontworpen door een Scheveningse architect en het werd in september 1922 officieel onthuld door koningin Wilhelmina. Zij werd vergezeld door haar echtgenoot, prins Hendrik.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The artwork was designed by a Scheveningen architect and was officially unveiled in September 1922 by Queen Wilhelmina. She was accompanied by her husband, Prince Henry.

features.name: KB, nationale bibliotheek
features.opening: The KB National Library of the Netherlands (legal Dutch name: Koninklijke Bibliotheek [ˈkoːnɪŋkləkə ˌbiblijoːˈteːk] 'Royal Library', or KB [kaːˈbeː]) is the…

facts.text: Napoleon allowed the Imperial Library in Paris to seize publications from this Dutch Royal Library.
facts.sourceQuote: Napoleon Bonaparte transferred the Royal Library to The Hague as property, while also allowing the Imperial Library in Paris to expropriate publications from the Royal Library.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Napoleon Bonaparte transferred the Royal Library to The Hague as property, while also allowing the Imperial Library in Paris to expropriate publications from the Royal Library.

facts.text: The library has coordinated the public library network since 2015.
facts.sourceQuote: Since 2015, the KB has played a coordinating role for the network of the public library.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2015, the KB has played a coordinating role for the network of the public library.

facts.text: Delpher provides access to millions of digitized pages from its vast archives.
facts.sourceQuote: The KB offers digital services, such as the national online Library (with e-books and audiobooks), Delpher (millions of digitised pages) and The Memory (about 800,000 images).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The KB offers digital services, such as the national online Library (with e-books and audiobooks), Delpher (millions of digitised pages) and The Memory (about 800,000 images).

features.name: World Peace Flame
features.opening: De Wereldvredesvlam is een sinds 1999 brandende vlam in Wales.

facts.text: Seven flames from five continents merged in Bangor on July 31, 1999 to create the World Peace Flame.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 31 juli 1999 werden zeven vlammen vanaf vijf continenten samengebracht in Bangor in Noord-Wales. Van die zeven vlammen werd een achtste vlam gemaakt, de Vlam van de Wereldvrede.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On July 31, 1999, seven flames from five continents were brought together in Bangor, North Wales. From those seven flames an eighth flame was made, the Flame of World Peace.

facts.text: The Life Foundation behind the flame was co-founded by guru Mansukh Patel in 1978.
facts.sourceQuote: De vredesvlam is een initiatief van de spirituele en charitatieve instelling Life Foundation. Deze stichting werd in 1978 opgericht, onder meer door de (zelf benoemde) goeroe Mansukh Patel, die ook bekendstaat om zijn vredeswandelingen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The peace flame is an initiative of the spiritual and charitable institution Life Foundation. This foundation was founded in 1978, among other things by the (self-proclaimed) guru Mansukh Patel, who is also known for his peace marches.

facts.text: The flame was first lit on April 18, 2002 next to the Peace Palace entrance gates.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste wereldvredesvlam in Nederland werd op 18 april 2002 naast de toegangshekken van het Vredespaleis geplaatst.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first world peace flame in the Netherlands was placed on April 18, 2002 next to the entrance gates of the Peace Palace.

facts.text: A flat round stone at the path's start notes that seven flames from five continents united in July 1999.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan het begin van het rond het monument gaande vredespad ligt een platte ronde steen met de tekst: The World Peace Flame In July 1999 seven flames from 5 continents were united to create the World Peace Flame.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the beginning of the peace path around the monument lies a flat round stone with the text: The World Peace Flame In July 1999 seven flames from 5 continents were united to create the World Peace Flame.

facts.text: Special stones include a piece of the Berlin Wall and one from Robben Island where Nelson Mandela was imprisoned.
facts.sourceQuote: Sommige stenen zijn bijzonder: zo ligt er een brok steen uit de Berlijnse Muur en een steen van Robbeneiland, de plek waar Nelson Mandela jarenlang gevangen zat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Some stones are special: there is a piece of stone from the Berlin Wall and a stone from Robben Island, the place where Nelson Mandela was imprisoned for years.

facts.text: Visitors are invited to add their own prayer for peace while walking the World Peace Pathway.
facts.sourceQuote: Opened April 2004 Please add your prayer for peace as you walk around.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Opened April 2004 Please add your prayer for peace as you walk around.

features.name: Prins Maurits en de burgers van Den Haag
features.opening: Prins Maurits en de burgers van Den Haag is een monument ter ere van prins Maurits dat zich bevindt op de Heerenbrug in Den Haag.

facts.text: Citizens dug a defensive moat between 1613 and 1619 after Prince Maurits requested fortifications.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument herinnert aan het feit dat tussen 1613 en 1619 de burgers van Den Haag op last van Maurits een singel om de plaats hadden gegraven die diende ter verdediging van de stad.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument commemorates the fact that between 1613 and 1619, the citizens of Den Haag dug a moat around the town at the request of Maurits to defend the city.

facts.text: The pedestal inscription reads Door Burgers Daad, on Maurits Raad deez Cingel Ontstaat.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de sokkel van de beeldengroep is de tekst te lezen Door Burgers Daad, op Maurits Raad deez Cingel Ontstaat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the pedestal of the sculpture group can be read the text Door Burgers Daad, on Maurits Raad deez Cingel Ontstaat.

facts.text: Sculptor Joop van Lunteren created the monument when it was placed in 1932.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument werd geplaatst in 1932 en is van de hand van de beeldhouwer Joop van Lunteren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument was placed in 1932 and was created by the sculptor Joop van Lunteren.

features.name: Spinozahuis
features.opening: Domus Spinozana of Spinozahuis is een huis aan de Paviljoensgracht 72 in Den Haag, Nederland, waar de filosoof Spinoza verbleef tot aan zijn dood.

facts.text: The painter Jan van Goyen commissioned the house's construction in 1646 before selling it to Havick Steen.
facts.sourceQuote: Het huis werd in 1646 gebouwd in opdracht van de schilder Jan van Goyen die het verkocht aan Havick Steen, de vader van Jan Steen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The house was built in 1646 at the behest of the painter Jan van Goyen who sold it to Havick Steen, the father of Jan Steen.

facts.text: Restoration work on the building occurred in 1927 and again in 1976.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1927 en 1976 werd het pand gerestaureerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building was restored in 1927 and 1976.

features.name: Catshuis
features.opening: The Catshuis (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈkɑtsɦœys]; English: Cats House), initially known as Huis Sorgvliet ([ˌɦœys ˈsɔr(ə)xflit]; Sorgvliet House), is the…

facts.text: Prominent poet and politician Jacob Cats lived in the estate starting in July 1652.
facts.sourceQuote: As Huis Sorgvliet it was built on the site of a former farm, part of the living quarters were likely incorporated in the left wing, by Jacob Cats (1577–1660), a prominent poet and politician who lived there from 14 July 1652.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: As Huis Sorgvliet it was built on the site of a former farm, part of the living quarters were likely incorporated in the left wing, by Jacob Cats (1577–1660), a prominent poet and politician who lived there from 14 July 1652.

facts.text: A bronze bell and tower were installed on the property in 1738 by Willem Bentinck.
facts.sourceQuote: His son, Willem Bentinck, had a bronze bell and tower installed in 1738.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: His son, Willem Bentinck, had a bronze bell and tower installed in 1738.

facts.text: An extensive renovation to modernize security and comfort took place between 1999 and 2004.
facts.sourceQuote: To conform with modern norms of security, logistics, climatisation, hygiene, comfort and technical aspects of management, it was extensively renovated from 1999 to 2004.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: To conform with modern norms of security, logistics, climatisation, hygiene, comfort and technical aspects of management, it was extensively renovated from 1999 to 2004.

facts.text: Although it is an official residence, no prime minister has lived there since Dries van Agt.
facts.sourceQuote: It has been the official residence of the Prime Minister of the Netherlands since 1963, although Dries van Agt was the last premier to live there. Prime Ministers since then have preferred to live in their own homes.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It has been the official residence of the Prime Minister of the Netherlands since 1963, although Dries van Agt was the last premier to live there. Prime Ministers since then have preferred to live in their own homes.

features.name: Bethelkerk
features.opening: De Bethelkerk is een protestantse kerk in de Jurriaan Kokstraat te Scheveningen in de Nederlandse gemeente Den Haag.

facts.text: The first stone was laid on May 30, 1970 by the community's oldest member.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste steen van de kerk werd gelegd op 30 mei 1970 door J. Spaans, met 98 jaar het oudste lid van de kerkgemeente.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first stone of the church was laid on May 30, 1970 by J. Spanish, with 98 years the oldest member of the church community.

facts.text: Light enters through stained glass figures interspersed with colored lead glass.
facts.sourceQuote: Daartussen treed licht naar binnen door een mozaïek van figuurglas afgewisseld met gekleurd glas in lood.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Light enters through a mosaic of stained glass figures interspersed with colored lead glass.

facts.text: Since 2016, church services have been broadcast via a livestream.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf 2016 worden de kerkdiensten ook uitgezonden via een livestream.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 2016, the church services will also be broadcast via a livestream.

features.name: Sinti- en Roma monument
features.opening: Het Roma en Sinti-monument in de Haagse Vondelstraat tegenover de Bilderdijkstraat is een kubusvormig object met een bronzen herinneringsplaquette.

facts.text: The plaque was originally unveiled in 1990 to honor 112 Sinti and Roma deported from The Hague.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1990 onthulde burgemeester Havermans bij de ingang van een hofje aan de Bilderdijkstraat een herinneringsplaquette (ontworpen door Eric Claus), ter nagedachtenis aan 112 Sinti en Roma die tijdens de landelijke razzia van 16 mei 1944 uit Den Haag zijn weggevoerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1990, Mayor Havermans unveiled a commemorative plaque (designed by Eric Claus) at the entrance of a courtyard on Bilderdijkstraat, in memory of 112 Sinti and Roma who were deported from The Hague during the national raid on May 16, 1944.

facts.text: Serious construction errors forced the monument to be disassembled and rebuilt with new engineering.
facts.sourceQuote: Nog voordat het monument officieel kon worden onthuld, werden er ernstige constructiefouten zichtbaar. Het monument werd verwijderd, uit elkaar gehaald en met een geheel nieuwe constructie weer in elkaar gezet.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Before the monument could be officially unveiled, serious construction errors became visible. The monument was removed, disassembled and reassembled with a completely new construction.

facts.text: The monument honors the Berger family, who included a father, mother, three sons, four daughters, and one grandchild.
facts.sourceQuote: Rondom het monument is de volgende tekst in de grond aangebracht: voorzijde: Weile meer Sinti & Roma ham - Omdat wij Sinti & Roma zijn rechter- en achterzijde: Ter herdenking aan alle Sinti & Roma die slachtoffer zijn geworden tijdens de tweede wereldoorlog linkerzijde: Opdat zij nooit zullen worden vergeten Tekst op de plaquette: Bij het achterliggende hofje woonden tijdens de Duitse bezetting in de Tweede Wereldoorlog de familie Berger: vader, moeder, 3 zoons, 4 dochters en 1 kleinkind.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Around the monument, the following text has been embedded in the ground: front: Weile meer Sinti & Roma ham - Because we are Sinti & Roma right and rear sides: In memory of all Sinti & Roma who became victims during World War II left side: So that they will never be forgotten Text on the plaque: During the German occupation during World War II, the Berger family lived in the courtyard behind: father, mother, 3 sons, 4 daughters and 1 grandchild.

features.name: Zij waren eensgezind
features.opening: The Hague Penitentiary Institution (Dutch: Penitentiaire Inrichting Haaglanden) is a Dutch prison that is part of the Judicial Institutions Department (Dienst…

facts.text: The Zoetermeer location opened in 1995 within the Rokkenhage district.
facts.sourceQuote: The Zoetermeer location of the Hague Penitentiary Institution was built in 1995 and is located in the Rokkenhage district of Zoetermeer, a city in western Netherlands, in the province of South Holland.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Zoetermeer location of the Hague Penitentiary Institution was built in 1995 and is located in the Rokkenhage district of Zoetermeer, a city in western Netherlands, in the province of South Holland.

features.name: HBS-Craeyenhout
features.opening: HBS Craeyenhout is an omnisports club based in The Hague that fields teams in association football, cricket and hockey.

facts.text: The nickname 'Crows' emerged in 1905 when the team switched to all-black kits.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1905 HBS chose a new outfit, which was completely black. The nickname 'Crows' dates from that time.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1905 HBS chose a new outfit, which was completely black. The nickname 'Crows' dates from that time.

facts.text: HBS-Craeyenhout refused to turn professional in the 1950s and remains amateur.
facts.sourceQuote: The football club refused to enter into professionalism in the 1950s and has played at the amateur level ever since.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The football club refused to enter into professionalism in the 1950s and has played at the amateur level ever since.

features.name: Make art worthy
features.opening: De Valkenboskerk is een kerkgebouw in de wijk Oostbroek in Den Haag.

facts.text: Neighborhood protests against demolition helped save the building for conversion into apartments.
facts.sourceQuote: Mede door protest van omwonenden tegen geplande sloop is het kerkgebouw uiteindelijk behouden gebleven om er appartementen van te maken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In part due to protests from neighbors against planned demolition, the church building was eventually saved to make apartments out of it.

features.name: Bombardement Alexanderkazerne 10 mei 1940
features.opening: Het Monument Bombardement Alexanderkazerne is een oorlogsmonument langs de Oude Waalsdorperweg in Den Haag, dat de herinnering levend houdt aan 66 Nederlandse…

facts.text: The monument honors 66 Dutch military personnel who died during the German bombing.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Monument Bombardement Alexanderkazerne is een oorlogsmonument langs de Oude Waalsdorperweg in Den Haag, dat de herinnering levend houdt aan 66 Nederlandse militairen die om het leven kwamen tijdens een Duits bombardement op 10 mei 1940 op de Alexanderkazerne.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Monument Bombardement Alexanderkazerne is a war monument along the Oude Waalsdorperweg in The Hague, which keeps alive the memory of 66 Dutch military personnel who died during a German bombing on May 10 1940 on the Alexanderkazerne.

facts.text: Over one hundred horses were killed or euthanized after suffering severe injuries.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook meer dan 100 paarden van de Cavalerie werden gedood als gevolg van het bombardement. Vele paarden waren ernstig gewond geraakt en moesten worden afgemaakt door dierenartsen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: More than 100 horses of the Cavalry were also killed as a result of the bombing. Many horses were seriously injured and had to be euthanized by veterinarians.

facts.text: Rescuers later recalled the hours-long screaming of trapped horses as a source of horror.
facts.sourceQuote: Er werd later geschreven dat het geluid van hun urenlange geschreeuw van onder het puin, in hoge mate heeft bijgedragen aan de totale verschrikking van de overlevenden en de hulpverleners ter plaatse.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Later it was written that the sound of their hours of screaming from under the rubble, to a large extent contributed to the total horror of the survivors and the rescuers on site.

features.name: Mubarak Mosque
features.opening: The Mubarak Mosque (Dutch: Mobarakmoskee) in The Hague is the first purpose-built mosque in the Netherlands.

facts.text: The fourth caliph Mirza Tahir Ahmad laid the foundation stone for renovation on May 29, 1996.
facts.sourceQuote: The municipality gave a permit on 22 February 1995 and construction began by a group of volunteers on 29 May 1996 when the foundation stone for renovation and enlargement was laid by the fourth caliph of the community, Mirza Tahir Ahmad.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The municipality gave a permit on 22 February 1995 and construction began by a group of volunteers on 29 May 1996 when the foundation stone for renovation and enlargement was laid by the fourth caliph of the community, Mirza Tahir Ahmad.

facts.text: Construction of the minaret began in early 2005 and opened officially on December 9 that same year.
facts.sourceQuote: Construction of the minaret started early 2005 and was officially opened on 9 December 2005.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Construction of the minaret started early 2005 and was officially opened on 9 December 2005.

facts.text: Queen Beatrix visited the site on June 3, 2006 to commemorate its fiftieth anniversary.
facts.sourceQuote: On 3 June 2006 Queen Beatrix of the Netherlands had visited the Mobarak Mosque to commemorate the building's 50th anniversary.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On 3 June 2006 Queen Beatrix of the Netherlands had visited the Mobarak Mosque to commemorate the building's 50th anniversary.

facts.text: Sir Muhammad Zafarullah Khan laid the foundation stone in May 1955.
facts.sourceQuote: Its foundation stone was laid by Sir Muhammad Zafarullah Khan on 20 May 1955 who later inaugurated the mosque on 9 December 1955.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Its foundation stone was laid by Sir Muhammad Zafarullah Khan on 20 May 1955 who later inaugurated the mosque on 9 December 1955.

facts.text: The same man who laid the stone later inaugurated the mosque in December 1955.
facts.sourceQuote: Its foundation stone was laid by Sir Muhammad Zafarullah Khan on 20 May 1955 who later inaugurated the mosque on 9 December 1955.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Its foundation stone was laid by Sir Muhammad Zafarullah Khan on 20 May 1955 who later inaugurated the mosque on 9 December 1955.

features.name: Design Museum Dedel
features.opening: Design Museum Dedel is a museum located in The Hague.

facts.text: Exhibits feature graphic design and posters drawn from the former Poster Museum in Hoorn and ReclameArsenaal collections.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum hosts thematic exhibitions of two-dimensional design, including graphic design, posters, wallpaper – and has included posters from the collection of the former Poster Museum in Hoorn and objects (including posters) from the collection of the ReclameArsenaal.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum hosts thematic exhibitions of two-dimensional design, including graphic design, posters, wallpaper – and has included posters from the collection of the former Poster Museum in Hoorn and objects (including posters) from the collection of the ReclameArsenaal.

facts.text: Willem Willemszn Dedel commissioned the house in 1642, likely designed by architect Pieter Post.
facts.sourceQuote: Dedel House was built in 1642, likely by the architect Pieter Post, and was commissioned by Willem Willemszn Dedel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Dedel House was built in 1642, likely by the architect Pieter Post, and was commissioned by Willem Willemszn Dedel.

facts.text: After Nazi looting in 1938, the interior was stored in Austrian salt mines before being restituted to the family.
facts.sourceQuote: After the Anschluss in 1938 by the Nazi's, the interior was destined for the Führermuseum in Linz (not realized) and stored in salt mines in Altaussee (Austria). After the war, most of it was restituted to the family and then spread over the world.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the Anschluss in 1938 by the Nazi's, the interior was destined for the Führermuseum in Linz (not realized) and stored in salt mines in Altaussee (Austria). After the war, most of it was restituted to the family and then spread over the world.

features.name: Filmhuis Den Haag
features.opening: Filmhuis Den Haag is een filmhuis in het centrum van Den Haag.

facts.text: Architect Sjoerd Schamhart converted the structure into two cinemas with a library and workshop space.
facts.sourceQuote: Architect Sjoerd Schamhart restaureerde en bouwde het pand om tot een filmtheater met 2 filmzalen, een foyer, een bibliotheek en een ruimte voor filmworkshops.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Architect Sjoerd Schamhart restored and converted the building into a movie theater with 2 movie theaters, a lobby, a library and a space for film workshops.

facts.text: Since 1987, the cinema has organized rotating national programs linking film to architecture, fashion, music, and history.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf 1987 organiseert Filmhuis Den Haag landelijke roulerende programma's zoals Film & Architectuur, Film & Fashion, Film & Muziek en Film & Geschiedenis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1987, Filmhuis Den Haag has organized national rotating programs such as Film & Architecture, Film & Fashion, Film & Music and Film & History.

facts.text: In 2012, the cinema expanded by opening a dedicated room in Theater Dakota within the Escamp district.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2012 opent het filmhuis een zaal in Theater Dakota, in het Haagse stadsdeel Escamp.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2012, the cinema opens a room in Theater Dakota, in the Hague district of Escamp.

facts.text: A second branch opened in Theater Dakota within the Escamp district since 2012.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 2012 heeft het filmhuis ook een zaal in Theater Dakota, in het Haagse stadsdeel Escamp.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2012, the film theater has also had a room in Theater Dakota, in the Hague district of Escamp.

facts.text: Both locations joined the Cineville program starting in October 2012.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds oktober 2012 nemen beide vestigingen deel aan Cineville.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since October 2012, both branches have been participating in Cineville.

facts.text: Former director Géke Roelink received a UNIC Achievement Award from the European Union of Cinemas in 2022.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2015 de European Cinema Award for Best Programming en in 2022 kreeg voormalig directeur Géke Roelink de UNIC Achievment Award van de Europese Unie van Bioscopen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2015, she received the European Cinema Award for Best Programming and in 2022, former director Géke Roelink received the UNIC Achievement Award from the European Union of Cinemas.

features.name: Internationaal Esperanto-Instituut
features.opening: De Stichting Internationaal Esperanto-Instituut (Esperanto: Internacia Esperanto-Instituto; IEI) is een instituut dat door esperantisten Julia Isbrücker en…

facts.text: Esperantists Julia Isbrücker and András Cseh founded the institute in 1930.
facts.sourceQuote: De Stichting Internationaal Esperanto-Instituut (Esperanto: Internacia Esperanto-Instituto; IEI) is een instituut dat door esperantisten Julia Isbrücker en András Cseh in 1930 is opgericht in Den Haag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Stichting Internationaal Esperanto-Instituut (Esperanto: Internacia Esperanto-Instituto; IEI) is an institute founded in 1930 in The Hague by Esperantists Julia Isbrücker and András Cseh.

facts.text: The organization received its own office at Haagse Riouwstraat 172 in 1933.
facts.sourceQuote: Het IEI kreeg in 1933 zijn eigen kantoor aan de Haagse Riouwstraat 172, waar het tot op de dag van vandaag gevestigd is.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1933, the IEI received its own office at Haagse Riouwstraat 172, where it has been located to this day.

facts.text: In the 1930s, the institute trained over 400 qualified teachers using the Cseh method.
facts.sourceQuote: In de jaren 30 van de 20e eeuw heeft het Instituut meer dan 400 gediplomeerde leraren van de Cseh-methode opgeleid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 1930s of the 20th century, Instituut trained more than 400 qualified teachers of the Cseh method.

facts.text: The municipal government provided a country house in Arnhem for the institute's conferences.
facts.sourceQuote: Veel Cseh-cursussen en conferenties over dat onderwijs werden in die tijd georganiseerd in een landhuis in Arnhem, het Arnhemse Esperantohuis, dat het gemeentebestuur aan het IEI ter beschikking had gesteld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Many Cseh courses and conferences on that education were organized at that time in a country house in Arnhem, the Arnhem Esperanto House, which the municipal government had made available to the IEI.

features.name: Oorlogsmonument 'Leger en Vloot'
features.opening: Het Monument Leger en Vloot herdenkt de Nederlandse troepen die tijdens de Eerste Wereldoorlog gemobiliseerd werden en de slachtoffers die tijdens die oorlog…

facts.text: Queen Wilhelmina officially unveiled the monument on September 20, 1921.
facts.sourceQuote: Het werd op 20 september 1921 onthuld door koningin Wilhelmina.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was unveiled on September 20, 1921 by Queen Wilhelmina.

facts.text: The name Oorlogsmonument 'Leger en Vloot' reflects its dedication to both the army and the navy.
facts.sourceQuote: De oprichting van het nationale gedenkteken was een initiatief van de verenigingen Ons Leger en Onze Vloot.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The establishment of the national monument was an initiative of the associations Ons Leger and Onze Vloot.

facts.text: A committee was formed specifically to realize this monument for the 1914-1916 mobilization.
facts.sourceQuote: Voor de realisering van een monument ter herdenking van de mobilisatie van 1914-1916 vorm te geven was een Comité opgericht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A Committee was established to shape the realization of a monument to commemorate the mobilization of 1914-1916.

features.name: Hotelschool The Hague locatie Den Haag
features.opening: Hotelschool The Hague is a single sector university of applied sciences in the Netherlands.

facts.text: The institution was established in 1929 as one of the world's oldest independent hotel schools.
facts.sourceQuote: Hotelschool The Hague was founded in 1929 and is one of the oldest independent hotel schools in the world.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Hotelschool The Hague was founded in 1929 and is one of the oldest independent hotel schools in the world.

facts.text: The institution was established in 1929 by the hospitality industry.
facts.sourceQuote: It was founded and funded in 1929 by the hospitality industry.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was founded and funded in 1929 by the hospitality industry.

facts.text: A university-wide Research Centre focusing on practice-oriented work opened in 2010.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2010, Hotelschool The Hague founded its university wide Research Centre, focusing on interdisciplinary research with a strong practice-oriented focus.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2010, Hotelschool The Hague founded its university wide Research Centre, focusing on interdisciplinary research with a strong practice-oriented focus.

features.name: Sociëteit De Vereeniging
features.opening: Sociëteit De Vereeniging in Den Haag is een herensociëteit die werd opgericht op 30 april 1851.

facts.text: The original banquet hall was destroyed by fire and demolished in 1965.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1965 is de feestzaal afgebrand en gesloopt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1965, the banquet hall was burned down and demolished.

features.name: Museum Sophiahof
features.opening: Museum Sophiahof (formeel: Nationaal Museum Sophiahof) is een museum, kennis- en gemeenschapscentrum, dat zich wijdt aan de culturele en historische erfenis…

facts.text: A Sophiahof Management Foundation oversees operations with both a board of directors and a supervisory board.
facts.sourceQuote: Het museum wordt bestuurd door de Stichting beheer Sophiahof, dat naast een bestuur ook een raad van toezicht heeft.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum is managed by the Sophiahof Management Foundation, which, in addition to a board of directors, also has a supervisory board.

facts.text: King Willem-Alexander officially opened the museum on June 27, 2019.
facts.sourceQuote: Met de opening van het Sophiahof op 27 juni 2019 door koning Willem-Alexander is er tevens een nieuwe, gemeenschappelijke huisvesting gekomen voor enkele organisaties: Indisch Herinneringscentrum, Museum Maluku (het Moluks Historisch Museum), Stichting Pelita, Nationale Herdenking 15 augustus 1945 en het Indisch Platform.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With the opening of the Sophiahof on June 27, 2019 by King Willem-Alexander, there has also been a new, common housing for some organizations: Indian Memorial Center, Museum Maluku (the Moluccan Historical Museum), Pelita Foundation, National Commemoration August 15, 1945 and the Indian Platform.

facts.text: During the opening, relatives of unpaid colonial workers demonstrated outside demanding compensation.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de opening werd buiten het gebouw gedemonstreerd door nabestaanden van militairen en ambtenaren die onder het bestuur van het toenmalige Nederlands-Indië hebben gewerkt, maar gedurende de periode van de Japanse bezetting nooit salaris hebben ontvangen, ook niet achteraf. Zij eisten excuses, erkenning en compensatie voor geleden schade.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the opening, there was a demonstration outside the building by relatives of military personnel and civil servants who worked under the administration of the then Dutch East Indies, but never received a salary during the period of Japanese occupation, not even afterwards. They demanded apologies, recognition and compensation for the damage suffered.

facts.text: The State Secretary described the future site as an Indian healing place and center for remembrance in 2017.
facts.sourceQuote: De staatssecretaris van VWS beschreef het toekomstige museum in 2017 onder meer als "een Indische pleisterplaats als fundament, scholing en educatie, herdenken, museale en kennisfunctie, culturele activiteiten en contextgebonden zorg".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The State Secretary of Welfare, Health and Sport described the future museum in 2017 as, among other things, "an Indian healing place as a foundation, training and education, remembrance, museum and knowledge function, cultural activities and context-specific care".

features.name: AFAS Circustheater
features.opening: The AFAS Circustheater is a musical theatre in The Hague, owned and operated by Stage Entertainment.

facts.text: The venue transformed from a circus to a concert hall in 1964 as public interest waned.
facts.sourceQuote: When the publics interest in the circus declined, the theatre was transformed in 1964 to a regular theater to house concerts among others.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When the publics interest in the circus declined, the theatre was transformed in 1964 to a regular theater to house concerts among others.

facts.text: Joop van den Ende acquired the site for one guilder and led its major renovation.
facts.sourceQuote: Joop van den Ende, Stardust B.V. and Xelat Recrea B.V. acquired the theatre from the municipality of The Hague for the symbolic amount of ƒ 1,-. The consortium invested ƒ 25 million and transformed the site into the first open-end musical theatre of The Netherlands, the new theatre was designed by architect Meijs.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Joop van den Ende, Stardust B.V. and Xelat Recrea B.V. acquired the theatre from the municipality of The Hague for the symbolic amount of ƒ 1,-. The consortium invested ƒ 25 million and transformed the site into the first open-end musical theatre of The Netherlands, the new theatre was designed by architect Meijs.

facts.text: The venue was renamed Fortis Circustheater after VSB merged with the bank Fortis in 2004.
facts.sourceQuote: This started with VSB from 1991 till 2004, when VSB merged with Fortis changing the name into Fortis Circustheater.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This started with VSB from 1991 till 2004, when VSB merged with Fortis changing the name into Fortis Circustheater.

facts.text: Sponsorship ended in 2010 when the bank failed during the 2008 financial crisis.
facts.sourceQuote: When the bank failed during the 2008 financial crisis the sponsorship stopped in 2010.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When the bank failed during the 2008 financial crisis the sponsorship stopped in 2010.

facts.text: AFAS became the new sponsor in 2011, establishing the current name AFAS Circustheater.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2011 a new sponsor was found in AFAS, resulting in the current name of the complex.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2011 a new sponsor was found in AFAS, resulting in the current name of the complex.

features.name: Escher in Het Paleis
features.opening: Escher in Het Paleis (Escher in The Palace) is a museum in The Hague, Netherlands, featuring the works of the Dutch graphical artist M. C. Escher.

facts.text: Queen Emma used the palace as a winter residence from March 1901 until her death in March 1934.
facts.sourceQuote: She used it as a winter palace from March 1901 until her death in March 1934.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: She used it as a winter palace from March 1901 until her death in March 1934.

facts.text: Visitors can experience an optical illusion room where adults appear smaller than their children.
facts.sourceQuote: The third floor of the museum is dedicated to the Optical Illusion, besides the famous Escher Room in which grownups seem to be smaller than their children, one's eyes will be tricked by multiple interactive displays.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The third floor of the museum is dedicated to the Optical Illusion, besides the famous Escher Room in which grownups seem to be smaller than their children, one's eyes will be tricked by multiple interactive displays.

facts.text: Since November 2002, the collection has been housed in the Lange Voorhout Palace.
facts.sourceQuote: It is housed in the Lange Voorhout Palace since November 2002.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is housed in the Lange Voorhout Palace since November 2002.

features.name: Galerij Prins Willem V
features.opening: The Prince William V Gallery is an art gallery on the Buitenhof in The Hague that currently shares an entrance with the Gevangenpoort museum.

facts.text: After most works returned in 1815, the main collection moved to the Mauritshuis in 1822.
facts.sourceQuote: After recovery of most important works in 1815, the large collection was re-housed in 1822 in the Mauritshuis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After recovery of most important works in 1815, the large collection was re-housed in 1822 in the Mauritshuis.

facts.text: The gallery opened in 1774 as the first Dutch museum allowing general public access.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1774 the gallery opened, and in addition to the guests of the prince, it became the first museum in the Netherlands where the general public was allowed to visit.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1774 the gallery opened, and in addition to the guests of the prince, it became the first museum in the Netherlands where the general public was allowed to visit.

facts.text: French forces seized the collection in 1795, taking it to the Louvre as war booty.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1795 the collection was abducted by the French and housed in the Louvre as war booty.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1795 the collection was abducted by the French and housed in the Louvre as war booty.

features.name: Loosduins Museum "De Korenschuur"
features.opening: Het Loosduins Museum in Den Haag is een museum dat zich richt op het cultureel erfgoed van het stadsdeel Loosduinen, dat haar oorsprong heeft in de twaalfde…

facts.text: The native name De Korenschuur translates to The Grain Barn.
facts.sourceQuote: Het museum wordt ook wel Loosduins Museum “De Korenschuur” genoemd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum is also known as Loosduins Museum "The Grain Barn".

facts.text: Mayor Frans Schols officially opened the museum in 1983.
facts.sourceQuote: Het museum, dat werd gesticht door de Stichting Oud Loosduinen, werd in 1983 geopend door burgemeester Frans Schols van Den Haag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum, which was founded by the Oud Loosduinen Foundation, was opened in 1983 by Mayor Frans Schols of The Hague.

facts.text: The district remained an independent municipality from 1811 until 1923.
facts.sourceQuote: Van 1811 tot 1923 was Loosduinen een zelfstandige gemeente.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1811 to 1923, Loosduinen was an independent municipality.

facts.text: Floris III of Holland founded a manor house in the area during the twelfth century.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Loosduins Museum in Den Haag is een museum dat zich richt op het cultureel erfgoed van het stadsdeel Loosduinen, dat haar oorsprong heeft in de twaalfde eeuw, toen Floris III van Holland er een hofstede oprichtte.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Loosduins Museum in The Hague is a museum that focuses on the cultural heritage of the Loosduinen district, which dates back to the twelfth century, when Floris III of Holland founded a manor house there.

features.name: 'Haags Verzets- en Bevrijdingsmonument'
features.opening: Het Haags oorlogsmonument 1940-1945 is een monument ter herdenking aan de Tweede Wereldoorlog tegenover het Vredespaleis op het Carnegieplein in Den Haag.

facts.text: The Jewish sculptor Appie Drielsma created this monument in 1992.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument is gemaakt door de joodse beeldhouwer Appie Drielsma in 1992.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument was made by the Jewish sculptor Appie Drielsma in 1992.

facts.text: Former resistance members initiated the establishment of the Haags Verzets- en Bevrijdingsmonument.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kwam tot stand op initiatief van een groep van oud-verzetsmensen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was established at the initiative of a group of former resistance people.

facts.text: Four pillars represent neutral, Roman Catholic, Protestant, and Jewish society during World War II.
facts.sourceQuote: De vier zuilen van het monument symboliseren de vier zuilen in de samenleving ten tijde van de Tweede Wereldoorlog: neutraal, rooms-katholiek, protestants en joods.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The four pillars of the monument symbolize the four pillars in society at the time of World War II: neutral, Roman Catholic, Protestant and Jewish.

facts.text: The annual ceremony starts at Gymnasium Haganum before participants walk to Carnegieplein.
facts.sourceQuote: De herdenkingsplechtigheid begint ieder jaar in het gebouw van het Gymnasium Haganum met toespraken door onder andere de burgemeester en voordrachten door leerlingen van het gymnasium en het Segbroek College. Dan loopt iedereen naar het Carnegieplein.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The memorial ceremony begins every year in the building of the Gymnasium Haganum with speeches by the mayor among others and lectures by students of the gymnasium and the Segbroek College. Then everyone walks to Carnegieplein.

facts.text: Segbroek College adopted the monument and participates in laying wreaths during the event.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de Nationale Dodenherdenking worden om acht uur kransen gelegd door de burgemeester, nabestaanden van het verzet, joodse organisaties, de Haagsche Studenten Vereeniging (H.S.V.) en het Segbroek College, dat het monument heeft geadopteerd De plechtigheid wordt georganiseerd door de Stichting Nationale Herdenking ’s-Gravenhage.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the National Remembrance Day, wreaths will be laid at eight o'clock by the mayor, relatives of the resistance, Jewish organizations, the Haagse Studenten Vereeniging (H.S.V.) and the Segbroek College, which has adopted the monument. The ceremony is organized by the Stichting Nationale Herdenking 's-Gravenhage.

features.name: Huis van het boek
features.opening: The House of the Book (Dutch: Huis van het boek), formerly called Museum Meermanno and Museum Meermanno-Westreenianum, is a book museum in The Hague,…

facts.text: The house once belonged to book collector Willem van Westreenen, who admired his cousin Johan Meerman.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum is located in the former house of the book collector Willem Hendrik Jacob (Willem) baron van Westreenen van Tiellandt (1783–1848), who himself was a great admirer of his cousin Johan Meerman (1751–1815), a book collector, traveller, and diarist.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum is located in the former house of the book collector Willem Hendrik Jacob (Willem) baron van Westreenen van Tiellandt (1783–1848), who himself was a great admirer of his cousin Johan Meerman (1751–1815), a book collector, traveller, and diarist.

facts.text: The collection resides within an eighteenth-century townhouse retaining original period furnishings.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum is based in an 18th- century townhouse (Dutch: Herenhuis) that maintains many of its period furnishings and collectibles.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum is based in an 18th- century townhouse (Dutch: Herenhuis) that maintains many of its period furnishings and collectibles.

features.name: De Binckhorst
features.opening: Binckhorst Castle is a 16th and 17th century manor built on top of a demolished medieval castle.

facts.text: A person named Evert van der Binckhorst is recorded in the year 1076.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1076 an Evert van der Binckhorst is mentioned.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1076 an Evert van der Binckhorst is mentioned.

facts.text: In 1567, Jacob Snouckaert moved earth from high ground to lower areas nearby.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1567 Jacob Snouckaert wrote about: ende den lande die ick van den hoochte in den laechte alree heb doen brengen met afkarren ende noch doen sall. (And the ground that I have had brought from the height to the depression, and will bring there.)
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1567 Jacob Snouckaert wrote about: ende den lande die ick van den hoochte in den laechte alree heb doen brengen met afkarren ende noch doen sall. (And the ground that I have had brought from the height to the depression, and will bring there.)

facts.text: Count William V's chamberlain purchased fifty wooden plates while the count besieged the fortress.
facts.sourceQuote: While Count William V was besieging the Binckhorst, his chamberlain bought 50 pieces of wooden plates.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: While Count William V was besieging the Binckhorst, his chamberlain bought 50 pieces of wooden plates.

features.name: Kloosterkerk
features.opening: The Kloosterkerk (or Cloister Church) is a church on the Lange Voorhout in The Hague, Netherlands.

facts.text: The original Dominican monastery and church were first constructed in The Hague around the year 1397.
facts.sourceQuote: Reforms undertaken by Raymond of Capua, brought a renewed growth to the order, and it is around this time in 1397 that a monastery and church was first built for the Dominicans in The Hague.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Reforms undertaken by Raymond of Capua, brought a renewed growth to the order, and it is around this time in 1397 that a monastery and church was first built for the Dominicans in The Hague.

features.name: Bevrijdingsmonument
features.opening: Het bevrijdingsmonument in Loosduinen herdenkt 24 verzetsmensen uit het Nederlandse voormalige dorp Loosduinen die het leven lieten gedurende de Tweede…

facts.text: The monument features a rising bronze phoenix standing atop a stone obelisk.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is een uit de as herrijzende bronzen feniks op een stenen obilisk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is a phoenix made of bronze rising from the ashes on a stone obelisk.

features.name: CBG Centrum voor familiegeschiedenis
features.opening: The CBG Centrum voor familiegeschiedenis, formerly known as the Centraal Bureau voor Genealogie (CBG), is the Dutch research centre for genealogical and…

facts.text: The foundation was established on May 15, 1945 to unite archive collections.
facts.sourceQuote: It is a non-profit foundation that was founded on May 15, 1945, with the aim of bringing together a number of archive collections and making research of genealogy and related studies easier.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is a non-profit foundation that was founded on May 15, 1945, with the aim of bringing together a number of archive collections and making research of genealogy and related studies easier.

facts.text: The centre publishes genealogy books like Nederland's Adelsboek and Nederland's Patriciaat.
facts.sourceQuote: The CBG publishes many books pertaining to genealogy, for instance the Nederland's Adelsboek and the Nederland's Patriciaat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The CBG publishes many books pertaining to genealogy, for instance the Nederland's Adelsboek and the Nederland's Patriciaat.

features.name: 'De Wachter'
features.opening: Nassauplein is een lang rechthoekig plein in de Archipelbuurt in Den Haag met maar 43 huisnummers.

facts.text: Crown lanterns were reinstalled to connect the square's allure with nearby areas like Vijverberg.
facts.sourceQuote: Er kwamen aan beide zijden van het plein (binnenplantsoen) weer kroontjeslantaarns, zodat het monumentale plein in allure weer aansluit bij de Vijverberg, Voorhout en Willemspark.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Crown lanterns have been installed again on both sides of the square (inner courtyard), so that the monumental square once again connects in allure with the Vijverberg, Voorhout and Willemspark.

facts.text: Hedgebeeches line the outer edge to divert attention away from parked cars.
