facts.sourceQuote: Langs de buitenrand zijn haagbeuken geplant die de geparkeerde auto's aan het oog onttrekken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Hedgebeeches are planted along the outer edge to divert the eye from the parked cars.

facts.text: Water from the Haagse Beek still flows under a nearby intersection via a small waterfall.
facts.sourceQuote: Een klein gedeelte is nog overkluisd en water van de Haagse Beek stroomt vanuit laatste deel Nassauplein onder de Javatraat kruising door en met een watervalletje komt de beek uit in het Willemspark en van daar in de Singelgracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A small part is still locked and water from the Haagse Beek flows from the last part of Nassauplein under the Javatraat intersection and with a waterfall the stream flows into the Willemspark and from there into the Singelgracht.

features.name: Pulchri Studio
features.opening: Pulchri Studio (Latin: "For the study of the beautiful") is a Dutch art society, art institution and art studio based in The Hague ('s-Gravenhage), Netherlands.

facts.text: The group modeled their colony after the successful artist community in Barbizon near Paris.
facts.sourceQuote: The model was the successful artist colony of Barbizon south of Paris in the forest of Fontainebleau.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The model was the successful artist colony of Barbizon south of Paris in the forest of Fontainebleau.

facts.text: The group held gatherings called Kunstbeschouwingen to exchange information and present works.
facts.sourceQuote: A special role has played gatherings, which were called art considerations (Kunstbeschouwingen). They offered the artists the opportunity to present their own works the other members and to exchange information with the other painters.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A special role has played gatherings, which were called art considerations (Kunstbeschouwingen). They offered the artists the opportunity to present their own works the other members and to exchange information with the other painters.

features.name: Our Lady of Good Counsel Church
features.opening: De Onze-Lieve-Vrouw-van-Goede-Raadkerk, of kortweg de Goede-Raadkerk is een rooms-katholiek kerkgebouw aan de Bezuidenhoutseweg in de Haagse wijk Bezuidenhout.

facts.text: The original church was destroyed in 1945 during the bombing of Bezuidenhout.
facts.sourceQuote: De voorloper van deze kerk, eveneens met de naam Onze-Lieve-Vrouw-van-Goede-Raadkerk werd in 1945 verwoest tijdens het bombardement op het Bezuidenhout.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The predecessor of this church, also named Onze-Lieve-Vrouw-van-Goede-Raadkerk, was destroyed in 1945 during the bombing of Bezuidenhout.

facts.text: Architect Jan van der Laan designed a square central building rather than a neo-Gothic replica.
facts.sourceQuote: In plaats van een exacte herbouw van de neogotische kruisbasiliek werd er gekozen voor een nieuw ontwerp door Jan van der Laan in de stijl van de Bossche School. De vierkante centraalbouw paste beter bij de nieuwe liturgische ideeën van na de oorlog.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Instead of an exact reconstruction of the neo-Gothic cruciform basilica, a new design by Jan van der Laan in the style of the Bossche School was chosen. The square central building suited the new liturgical ideas of the post-war period better.

facts.text: Construction on the new structure began in 1946 and finished eight years later in 1954.
facts.sourceQuote: De bouw begon in 1946 en was voltooid in 1954.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Construction began in 1946 and was completed in 1954.

features.name: Eben Haëzerkerk
features.opening: De Eben-Haëzerkerk is het kerkgebouw van de Gereformeerde Gemeente in Scheveningen.

facts.text: Since late 2019, the building has housed the Christian center Het Kompas.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds het najaar van 2019 is christelijk ontmoetingscentrum Het Kompas in het kerkgebouw gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since the fall of 2019, the Christian meeting center Het Kompas has been located in the church building.

facts.text: The congregation sold the building for 18,000 guilders in 1938 after a lawsuit over ownership.
facts.sourceQuote: Na een rechtszaak kregen zij in 1938 het kerkgebouw toegekend. Zij verkochten dit daarna voor 18.000 gulden aan de grotere Gereformeerde Gemeente, die de kerk was blijven gebruiken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After a lawsuit, they were awarded the church building in 1938. They then sold this for 18,000 guilders to the larger Reformed Church, which had continued to use the church.

facts.text: Temporary services returned here in early 2020 while the Bethaniëkerk hall underwent renovation.
facts.sourceQuote: Van zondag 2 februari tot en met 4 april 2020 worden er in deze kerk tijdelijk diensten gehouden vanwege de verbouwing van de kerkzaal van de Bethaniëkerk in Den Haag.[1]
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From Sunday, February 2 to April 4, 2020, temporary services will be held in this church due to the renovation of the church hall of the Bethaniëkerk in The Hague.[1]

features.name: Evangelisch Lutherse Gemeente
features.opening: De Evangelische Lutherse kerk in Den Haag ligt aan de Lutherse Burgwal.

facts.text: A secret church stood on this site as early as 1615.
facts.sourceQuote: Waar de kerk staat, bevond zich sinds 1615 een schuilkerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Where the church stands, there has been a secret church since 1615.

facts.text: Land purchases between the 1620s and 1656 created a complex with annexes.
facts.sourceQuote: In de jaren 1620-1656 werden stukken grond rond dat gebouw opgekocht en zo ontstond een complex van een kerk met bijgebouwen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 1620s-1656, plots of land around that building were purchased and thus a complex of a church with annexes was created.

facts.text: Construction finished in 1761, with the building officially inaugurated on December 13 of that year.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1761 was de kerk klaar en op 13 december werd het kerkgebouw ingewijd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1761 the church was ready and on December 13 the church building was inaugurated.

features.name: H.V. & C.V. Quick
features.opening: HV & CV Quick, also known as Quick Den Haag, is a Dutch football and cricket club from The Hague.

facts.text: The club claimed the Dutch national football title in 1908 and won the National Cup four times between 1909 and 1916.
facts.sourceQuote: Quick is the Dutch national football champion of 1908 and Dutch National Cup winner of 1909, 1910, 1911, and 1916.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Quick is the Dutch national football champion of 1908 and Dutch National Cup winner of 1909, 1910, 1911, and 1916.

features.name: Grote of Sint-Jacobskerk (The Hague)
features.opening: The Great Church or St. James's Church (Dutch: Grote- of Sint-Jacobskerk, pronounced [ˌɣroːtə ʔɔf sɪɲˈtɕaːkɔpsˌkɛr(ə)k]) is a landmark Reformed Protestant…

facts.text: A cenotaph for Jacob van Wassenaer Obdam was sculpted by Bartholomeus Eggers in 1667.
facts.sourceQuote: The church is remarkable for its fine tower and chime of bells, and contains the cenotaph monument of Jacob van Wassenaer Obdam, designed and sculpted by Bartholomeus Eggers in 1667, and the renaissance tomb of Gerrit van Assendelft (1487–1558).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church is remarkable for its fine tower and chime of bells, and contains the cenotaph monument of Jacob van Wassenaer Obdam, designed and sculpted by Bartholomeus Eggers in 1667, and the renaissance tomb of Gerrit van Assendelft (1487–1558).

facts.text: Members of the House of Orange-Nassau have been baptized and married within its walls.
facts.sourceQuote: Members of the House of Orange-Nassau have been baptised and married there.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Members of the House of Orange-Nassau have been baptised and married there.

features.name: Kinderboekenmuseum
features.opening: The Kinderboekenmuseum (Children's Book Museum) is a museum in The Hague, Netherlands, dedicated to Dutch language children's books.

facts.text: Plans were made in 2023 to relocate both this museum and the Literatuurmuseum to Utrecht.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2023, it was decided that the Literatuurmuseum and the Kinderboekenmuseum would move to Utrecht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2023, it was decided that the Literatuurmuseum and the Kinderboekenmuseum would move to Utrecht.

features.name: Church of St. John & St. Philip
features.opening: De Church of St. John and St. Philip, kortweg de Engelse kerk, is een anglicaans kerkgebouw aan de Ary van der Spuyweg in Den Haag.

facts.text: A bell dating back to 1586 still calls believers to service despite the church's multiple relocations.
facts.sourceQuote: De bel die de gelovigen oproept voor de diensten is nog afkomstig uit de kerk aan het Noordeinde en dateert uit 1586.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bell that calls the believers to the services still comes from the church at Noordeinde and dates back to 1586.

facts.text: King William I closed the church in 1822, but his son reopened it in a temporary wooden building in 1844.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1822 werd deze kerk gesloten op bevel van koning Willem I. Zijn zoon koning Willem II, die het vaak met zijn vader oneens was, stond in 1844 toe dat de kerk heropend werd. Dit gebeurde in een tijdelijk houten gebouw naast de koninklijke bibliotheek in de tuin van Paleis Noordeinde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1822, this church was closed at the orders of King William I. His son King William II, who often disagreed with his father, allowed the church to be reopened in 1844. This took place in a temporary wooden building next to the royal library in the garden of Noordeinde Palace.

features.name: Nationaal Bahá'í-centrum
features.opening: The first mentions of the Baháʼí Faith in the Netherlands were in Dutch newspapers which in 1852 covered some of the events relating to the Bábí movement which…

facts.text: The first Dutch Baháʼí, Hajo Mesdag, visited the religion's head in Haifa in 1925.
facts.sourceQuote: The first Dutch Baháʼí appears to have been Hajo Mesdag, who became a Baháʼí in Egypt after meeting Martha Root and reading John Esslemont's book titled Baháʼu'llah and the New Era, and visited Shoghi Effendi, then head of the religion, in Haifa in 1925.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first Dutch Baháʼí appears to have been Hajo Mesdag, who became a Baháʼí in Egypt after meeting Martha Root and reading John Esslemont's book titled Baháʼu'llah and the New Era, and visited Shoghi Effendi, then head of the religion, in Haifa in 1925.

facts.text: Rita van Bleyswijk Sombeek arrived in October 1946 to pioneer the faith, setting up her home in Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: In June of that year, the committee asked Rita van Bleyswijk Sombeek, a Dutch woman who had spent World War II in the United States and became a Baháʼí during that time, to return to the Netherlands to pioneer. She arrived in October 1946 and set up her home in Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In June of that year, the committee asked Rita van Bleyswijk Sombeek, a Dutch woman who had spent World War II in the United States and became a Baháʼí during that time, to return to the Netherlands to pioneer. She arrived in October 1946 and set up her home in Amsterdam.

facts.text: The first Local Spiritual Assembly was elected in Amsterdam in 1948 when there were only eleven Baháʼís in the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuote: With this mixture of pioneers and Dutch converts the first Baháʼí Local Spiritual Assembly was elected in Amsterdam in 1948. At this time there were 11 Baháʼís in the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With this mixture of pioneers and Dutch converts the first Baháʼí Local Spiritual Assembly was elected in Amsterdam in 1948. At this time there were 11 Baháʼís in the Netherlands.

features.name: Sint Paschalis Baylon
features.opening: De Sint-Paschalis Baylonkerk aan de Wassenaarseweg in Den Haag is gebouwd tussen 1919 en 1921.

facts.text: The wide nave ensures the priest and altar remain clearly visible to all congregants.
facts.sourceQuote: Het schip van de kerk is zeer breed, omdat Kropholler wilde dat de priester en het altaar voor iedereen goed zichtbaar moesten zijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The ship of the church is very wide, because Kropholler wanted the priest and the altar to be clearly visible to everyone.

facts.text: A side altar features a painting of the saint by Lodewijk Schelfhout.
facts.sourceQuote: De noordelijke eindigt in de preekstoel, de zuidelijke in een zijaltaar met retabel gewijd aan de heilige Paschalis Baylon met een schildering door Lodewijk Schelfhout.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The northern one ends in the pulpit, the southern one in a side altar with a retable dedicated to the holy Paschalis Baylon with a painting by Lodewijk Schelfhout.

facts.text: The chapel became an independent parish in 1922.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1922 wordt de bijkerk een zelfstandige parochie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1922, the chapel becomes an independent parish.

facts.text: Plans for this new church began in 1910 alongside housing plans.
facts.sourceQuote: Plannen voor deze nieuwe kerk beginnen in 1910, tegelijk met de eerste plannen voor nieuwe woningbouw in Benoordenhout.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Plans for this new church began in 1910, at the same time as the first plans for new housing in Benoordenhout.

features.name: Prinses Julianakerk
features.opening: De Prinses Julianakerk in Den Haag is een kerk in de Scheveningense wijk Duindorp.

facts.text: Queen Wilhelmina and Princess Juliana attended its first service in 1928.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste dienst in de Nederlands Hervormde Julianakerk, in 1928, werd bijgewoond door Wilhelmina der Nederlanden, de Koningin-Moeder Emma van Waldeck-Pyrmont en Prinses Juliana.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first service in the Reformed Julianakerk in the Netherlands, in 1928, was attended by Wilhelmina of the Netherlands, Queen Mother Emma of Waldeck-Pyrmont and Prinses Juliana.

features.name: Luchtwachttoren 5C1
features.opening: Luchtwachttoren 5C1 is een luchtwachttoren in de zeereep aan het Zwartepad in de wijk Oostduinen in Scheveningen, in de duinen ten noorden van Scheveningen,…

facts.text: The Air Defense Corps operated the tower from 1953 until its size was reduced in 1964.
facts.sourceQuote: De toren werd gebruikt door het Korps Luchtwachtdienst van 1953 tot 1964, toen dit korps sterk werd ingekrompen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The tower was used by the Air Defense Corps from 1953 to 1964, when this corps was greatly reduced in size.

features.name: Korzo Theater
features.opening: Korzo is een theater en productiehuis uit Den Haag.

facts.text: The venue was established in the early 1910s as a theater and production house.
facts.sourceQuote: Het theater en productiehuis werd begin jaren tien van de 20e eeuw opgericht en organiseert muziek- en dansvoorstellingen uit Australië, Azië, Europa, Noord, Zuid- en Midden-Amerika.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The theater and production house was founded in the early 1910s and organizes music and dance performances from Australia, Asia, Europe, North, South and Central America.

features.name: Joods Kindermonument
features.opening: Het Joods Kindermonument in Den Haag is een monument op het Rabbijn Maarsenplein ter nagedachtenis aan de Haagse Joodse kinderen die in de Tweede Wereldoorlog…

facts.text: Dismissed university professors joined teachers who had lost their posts to teach at this segregated school.
facts.sourceQuote: Sommige Joodse leraren, die van de Duitsers niet meer mochten werken op hun oude scholen, gingen hier onderwijs geven. Ook Joodse professoren die bij de universiteit waren ontslagen, gingen op het Joods Lyceum lesgeven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Some Jewish teachers, who were no longer allowed to work at their old schools by the Germans, went to teach here. Jewish professors who had been dismissed from the university also went to teach at the Joods Lyceum.

facts.text: The monument was unveiled on November 20, 2006, which coincides with International Children's Day.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Joods Kindermonument is onthuld op 20 november 2006, de Internationale Dag van de Rechten van het Kind.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Joods Kindermonument was unveiled on November 20, 2006, International Children's Day.

facts.text: A replica of a bronze plaque originally housed in the museum since 1952 now stands on the square.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het plein bevindt zich ook een replica van de bronzen plaquette die zich sinds 1952 in het Museon bevindt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the square there is also a replica of the bronze plaque that has been in the Museum since 1952.

features.name: Indisch monument
features.opening: The Indies Monument (Dutch: Indisch Monument) is a memorial in The Hague in memory of all Dutch citizens and soldiers killed during World War II as a result of…

facts.text: In 1991, a wreath laid by Japanese Prime Minister Toshiki Kaifu was thrown into the water by a Dutch Indo demonstrator.
facts.sourceQuote: Three years after the monument was unveiled, Japanese Prime Minister Toshiki Kaifu laid a decorative garland at the monument on July 19, 1991 during his state visit. Later that day, the wreath was thrown into the water by a Dutch Indo demonstrator.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Three years after the monument was unveiled, Japanese Prime Minister Toshiki Kaifu laid a decorative garland at the monument on July 19, 1991 during his state visit. Later that day, the wreath was thrown into the water by a Dutch Indo demonstrator.

facts.text: Jaroslawa Dankowa designed the Indisch monument, which Queen Beatrix unveiled in 1988.
facts.sourceQuote: Designed by Jaroslawa Dankowa, the monument was unveiled on August 15, 1988 by Queen Beatrix.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Designed by Jaroslawa Dankowa, the monument was unveiled on August 15, 1988 by Queen Beatrix.

facts.text: The Indisch monument features seventeen bronze sculptures alongside a map of Southeast Asia.
facts.sourceQuote: It consists of 17 bronze sculptures, a map of Southeast Asia and the inscription, "The spirit conquers".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It consists of 17 bronze sculptures, a map of Southeast Asia and the inscription, "The spirit conquers".

facts.text: Amsterdam officials with Dutch East Indies or resistance backgrounds selected the design in 1986.
facts.sourceQuote: Its design was chosen in 1986 by the Mayor of Amsterdam (a former government official in the Dutch East Indies) and the Deputy Mayor of Amsterdam (a former resistance fighter).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Its design was chosen in 1986 by the Mayor of Amsterdam (a former government official in the Dutch East Indies) and the Deputy Mayor of Amsterdam (a former resistance fighter).

features.name: Christus Triumfatorkerk
features.opening: De Christus Triumfatorkerk aan de Juliana van Stolberglaan 154 (hoek Laan van Nieuw Oost-Indië) in het Bezuidenhout in Den Haag is een protestantse kerk.

facts.text: Christus Triumfatorkerk derives its name from a specific text found in the Bible.
facts.sourceQuote: De Christus Triumfatorkerk ontleent zijn naam aan een tekst uit de Bijbel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Christus Triumfatorkerk derives its name from a text in the Bible.

facts.text: Architect Geert Drexhage, who lived from 1914 to 1982, designed the structure.
facts.sourceQuote: De architect Geert Drexhage (1914-1982) kreeg als richtlijnen mee: de preekstoel moet een centrale plaats innemen, het liturgisch centrum en doopvont moeten duidelijk zichtbaar zijn en de geluidsisolatie moet goed zijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The architect Geert Drexhage (1914-1982) was given the following guidelines: the pulpit must occupy a central place, the liturgical center and baptismal font must be clearly visible and the sound insulation must be good.

facts.text: The pulpit was required to sit centrally while the baptismal font remained clearly visible.
facts.sourceQuote: De architect Geert Drexhage (1914-1982) kreeg als richtlijnen mee: de preekstoel moet een centrale plaats innemen, het liturgisch centrum en doopvont moeten duidelijk zichtbaar zijn en de geluidsisolatie moet goed zijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The architect Geert Drexhage (1914-1982) was given the following guidelines: the pulpit must occupy a central place, the liturgical center and baptismal font must be clearly visible and the sound insulation must be good.

facts.text: Construction plans for this church date back as far as 1957.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste plannen voor de bouw dateren uit 1957.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first plans for construction date back to 1957.

features.name: Emmauskerk
features.opening: De Emmauskerk is een rooms-katholieke parochiekerk aan de Leyweg in de Nederlandse stad Den Haag.

facts.text: Franciscans from the Boskantkerk founded its parish in the 1950s for the Morgenstond neighborhood.
facts.sourceQuote: De parochie werd in de jaren 50 opgericht door de franciscanen vanuit de Boskantkerk voor de nieuwe wijk Morgenstond.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The parish was founded in the 1950s by the Franciscans from the Boskantkerk for the new neighborhood Morgenstond.

facts.text: In 1995, three other parishes merged with this church to form the Emmaus parish due to declining attendance.
facts.sourceQuote: Wegens teruglopend kerkbezoek fuseerde de parochie in 1995 met de parochies van O.L.V. van Altijddurende Bijstand, Pius X en O.L.V. van het Allerheiligst Sacrament tot de Emmausparochie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Due to declining church attendance, the parish merged in 1995 with the parishes of O.L.V. van Altijddurende Bijstand, Pius X and O.L.V. van het Allerheiligst Sacrament to form the Emmaus parish.

features.name: Leiden University College The Hague
features.opening: Leiden University College The Hague (LUC) is a small interdisciplinary Liberal Arts and Sciences honours college, part of the Faculty of Governance and Global…

facts.text: Former NATO Secretary-General Jaap de Hoop Scheffer serves as a Professor Emeritus of International Relations.
facts.sourceQuote: Jaap de Hoop Scheffer, former Dutch politician, former Secretary-General of NATO, and Professor Emeritus of International Relations and Diplomatic Practice Dan Saxon, former prosecutor at the United Nations International Criminal Tribunal for the Former Yugoslavia (ICTY) in The Hague
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Jaap de Hoop Scheffer, former Dutch politician, former Secretary-General of NATO, and Professor Emeritus of International Relations and Diplomatic Practice Dan Saxon, former prosecutor at the United Nations International Criminal Tribunal for the Former Yugoslavia (ICTY) in The Hague

facts.text: Jet Bussemaker, a former Dutch Minister of Education, holds a professorship in healthcare policy and societal impact.
facts.sourceQuote: Giles Scott-Smith, Dean and Professor Transnational Relations and New Diplomatic History Aernout van Lynden, former war correspondent Jet Bussemaker, former Dutch Minister of Education, Culture and Science and Professor Science, Policy and Societal Impact in Healthcare The college also has several Distinguished Fellows, who are not employed full-time at the institution but contribute to the programme via guest lectures, thesis supervision and advice.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Giles Scott-Smith, Dean and Professor Transnational Relations and New Diplomatic History Aernout van Lynden, former war correspondent Jet Bussemaker, former Dutch Minister of Education, Culture and Science and Professor Science, Policy and Societal Impact in Healthcare The college also has several Distinguished Fellows, who are not employed full-time at the institution but contribute to the programme via guest lectures, thesis supervision and advice.

facts.text: Students typically reside on campus during their first two years of study.
facts.sourceQuote: The college has a residential concept in which students typically live on campus for the first two years of the programme.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The college has a residential concept in which students typically live on campus for the first two years of the programme.

facts.text: The college is part of the European Colleges of Liberal Arts and Sciences network.
facts.sourceQuote: It is a member of the European Colleges of Liberal Arts and Sciences.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is a member of the European Colleges of Liberal Arts and Sciences.

features.name: De Drie Stoepen
features.opening: De Drie Stoepen is de gezamenlijke naam van drie naast elkaar gelegen rijksmonumenten uit de eerste helft van de achttiende eeuw, in het centrum van Den Haag.

facts.text: Master mason Frans van Braxhoofden built houses 69 and 71 between 1726 and 1728.
facts.sourceQuote: De meestermetselaar Frans van Braxhoofden liet tussen 1726 en 1728 de nummers 69 en 71 bouwen naar een ontwerp van eigen hand.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The master mason Frans van Braxhoofden had numbers 69 and 71 built between 1726 and 1728 according to a design of his own.

facts.text: Van Braxhoofden chose a Louis XIV facade with a Louis XVI central decoration for each house.
facts.sourceQuote: Hij koos daarbij voor elk huis een gevel in Lodewijk XIV-stijl, met een versierde middenpartij in een Lodewijk XVI-stijl en een kroonlijst op gesneden consoles, een hardstenen plint en hardstenen stoep.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: He chose a facade in Louis XIV style for each house, with a decorated central part in a Louis XVI style and a cornice on carved consoles, a stone base and stone pavement.

facts.text: Three Hague mayors once lived here, including Jacobus van Neck who served from 1702 to 1752.
facts.sourceQuote: Onder de achttiende-eeuwse bewoners bevonden zich de secretaris van de Sociëteit van de Hoge Collegiën en van Den Haag, Paulus van Assendelft, de griffier van de Hoge Raad van Holland, Zeeland en West-Friesland, Nicolaas van der Haar, alsmede drie Haagse burgemeesters: Jacobus van Neck (1702-1752), diens zoon Abraham van Neck (1734-1789) en Johan Patijn (1723-1787).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Among the eighteenth-century residents were the secretary of the Society of the High Colleges and of The Hague, Paulus van Assendelft, the clerk of the High Council of Holland, Zeeland and West Friesland, Nicolaas van der Haar, as well as three Hague mayors: Jacobus van Neck (1702-1752), his son Abraham van Neck (1734-1789) and Johan Patijn (1723-1787).

facts.text: Count of Spaen resided at number 69 with his wife Elisabeth Agnes Jacoba Countess of Nassau la Lecq.
facts.sourceQuote: Rijksvrijheer van Spaen (1703-1768), generaal-majoor in het Staatse leger, woonde hier vanaf 1749 op nummer 69 met zijn vrouw Elisabeth Agnes Jacoba gravin van Nassau la Lecq, afstammelinge van stadhouder Maurits van Oranje en diens geliefde Margaretha van Mechelen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Count of Spaen (1703-1768), major general in the State army, lived here from 1749 at number 69 with his wife Elisabeth Agnes Jacoba Countess of Nassau la Lecq, descendant of Stadtholder Maurice of Orange and his beloved Margaretha of Mechelen.

features.name: Museum Bredius
features.opening: Museum Bredius is a museum showing the collection of the early twentieth century Dutch art historian Abraham Bredius.

facts.text: The collection was originally housed in the Amsterdam home of its donor, Abraham Bredius.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1955 the house was purchased by the city of The Hague for the Bredius collection, which until then was housed in the former home of its donor, Abraham Bredius (Amsterdam, 1855 - Monaco, 1946).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1955 the house was purchased by the city of The Hague for the Bredius collection, which until then was housed in the former home of its donor, Abraham Bredius (Amsterdam, 1855 - Monaco, 1946).

facts.text: Visitors enjoy an accurate restoration of an eighteenth-century Herenhuis interior with period furnishings.
facts.sourceQuote: The collection is remarkable for its seventeenth-century etchings and paintings, but is most attractive to visitors for its accurate restoration of the 18th-century Herenhuis interior with period furnishings.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The collection is remarkable for its seventeenth-century etchings and paintings, but is most attractive to visitors for its accurate restoration of the 18th-century Herenhuis interior with period furnishings.

features.name: Heilige Martha Kerk
features.opening: De Sint-Marthakerk is een rooms-katholieke kerk in Den Haag.

facts.text: Nicolaas Molenaar sr. designed the church, basing his plan on The Hague's Great Kerk.
facts.sourceQuote: Nicolaas Molenaar sr. ontwierp een hallenkerk in neogotische stijl. Zijn ontwerp was gebaseerd op de Grote Kerk in het centrum van Den Haag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Nicolaas Molenaar sr. designed a hall church in neo-Gothic style. His design was based on the Great Kerk in the center of The Hague.

facts.text: Mortared pillars are covered in colored slate while windows feature stained glass.
facts.sourceQuote: De gemetselde pilaren zijn bekleed met gekleurde leisteen. De vensters zijn voorzien van glas-in-loodramen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The mortared pillars are covered with colored slate. The windows are equipped with stained glass windows.

features.name: Hogeschool Inholland
features.opening: Inholland University of Applied Sciences (Dutch: Hogeschool Inholland; French: Université des sciences appliquées d'Inholland; German: Hochschule Inholland) is…

facts.text: Jet de Ranitz became chairman on December 1, 2014, succeeding Doekle Terpstra.
facts.sourceQuote: In the period 2010 to December 2014, the position was filled by Doekle Terpstra. He was succeeded on 1 December 2014 by Jet de Ranitz.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the period 2010 to December 2014, the position was filled by Doekle Terpstra. He was succeeded on 1 December 2014 by Jet de Ranitz.

facts.text: The student body includes over 37,000 individuals from more than 100 different countries.
facts.sourceQuote: With over 37,000 students from more than 100 countries, the university follows the applied sciences mode of education.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With over 37,000 students from more than 100 countries, the university follows the applied sciences mode of education.

features.name: Sint Agneskerk
features.opening: De Sint-Agneskerk is een rooms-katholieke kerk aan de Beeklaan in Den Haag.

facts.text: Architects Margry and Snickers designed a neo-Gothic church with an octagonal tower beside the façade.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk werd in 1902 en 1903 gebouwd onder regie van het architectenbureau van Albert Margry en Jozef Snickers. Margry ontwierp een driebeukige kruiskerk in neogotische stijl, met een achthoekige toren direct naast de façade.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was built in 1902 and 1903 under the direction of the architectural firm of Albert Margry and Jozef Snickers. Margry designed a three-aisled cruciform church in neo-Gothic style, with an octagonal tower directly next to the façade.

features.name: Oorlogsmonument 'Grenadiers en Jagers'
features.opening: Het Monument Grenadiers en Jagers is een monument ter nagedachtenis aan militairen uit het Regiment Garde Grenadiers en Jagers die sinds 1940 omgekomen zijn.

facts.text: Seventh-grade students from Basisschool De Startbaan maintain the site and attend its annual May 10 ceremony.
facts.sourceQuote: Leerlingen van Basisschool De Startbaan hebben het monument geadopteerd: kinderen van groep 7 verzorgen het monument en zijn bij de herdenking aanwezig.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Students of Basisschool De Startbaan have adopted the monument: children from group 7 take care of the monument and are present at the commemoration.

facts.text: Oorlogsmonument 'Grenadiers en Jagers' was unveiled in 1951.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld werd gemaakt door kunstenaar Dirk Bus en is onthuld in 1951.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The image was created by artist Dirk Bus and was unveiled in 1951.

features.name: Haags Openbaar Vervoer Museum
features.opening: Het Haags Openbaar Vervoer Museum (HOVM) is sinds 1989 gevestigd in een oude tramremise, de remise Frans Halsstraat te Den Haag.

facts.text: A major restoration completed in 1990 returned the complex to its original 1906 state.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1990 werd een omvangrijke restauratie afgerond zodat het gebouw nu weer te bewonderen is in de oorspronkelijke staat van 1906.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1990, a major restoration was completed so that the building can now be admired in its original state of 1906.

facts.text: Construction of this historic tram facility was completed in 1906.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze remise is gebouwd in 1906 en is tot 1983 in gebruik geweest bij de Haagsche Tramweg Maatschappij (HTM).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This depot was built in 1906 and was in use until 1983 by the Haagsche Tramweg Maatschappij (HTM).

features.name: KM21
features.opening: KM21 is a museum for contemporary visual art in The Hague in the Netherlands.

facts.text: The venue was established in 2002 by the Kunstmuseum Den Haag to showcase contemporary visual art.
facts.sourceQuote: KM21 was set up in 2002 by the Kunstmuseum Den Haag under the name Gem, Contemporary Art, (abbreviated to GEM) to display the contemporary visual art held by the museum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: KM21 was set up in 2002 by the Kunstmuseum Den Haag under the name Gem, Contemporary Art, (abbreviated to GEM) to display the contemporary visual art held by the museum.

facts.text: In 2016, the space swapped locations with the Museum of Photography to provide it more room.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2016 the GEM and the Museum of Photography traded placed to give more room to the Museum of Photography.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2016 the GEM and the Museum of Photography traded placed to give more room to the Museum of Photography.

facts.text: The institution opened its doors in 2002 as part of the Kunstmuseum Den Haag.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum was established in 2002 as part of the Kunstmuseum Den Haag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was established in 2002 as part of the Kunstmuseum Den Haag.

facts.text: Visitors can attend lectures, film screenings, and book presentations alongside exhibitions.
facts.sourceQuote: In addition to exhibitions, activities such as lectures, discussions, performances, film screenings and book presentations also take place.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In addition to exhibitions, activities such as lectures, discussions, performances, film screenings and book presentations also take place.

features.name: Muzee Scheveningen
features.opening: Muzee Scheveningen is een cultuur- en natuurhistorisch museum in de Nederlandse badplaats Scheveningen, een stadsdeel van Den Haag, dat de geschiedenis,…

facts.text: The institution emerged in 2006 when the Museum Scheveningen merged with the Maritime Museum.
facts.sourceQuote: Muzee Scheveningen ontstond in 2006 na het samengaan van Museum Scheveningen en het Zeemuseum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Muzee Scheveningen was founded in 2006 after the merger of Museum Scheveningen and the Maritime Museum.

facts.text: Visitors can explore a tropical marine aquarium alongside a vast global shell collection.
facts.sourceQuote: Het museum beschikt over een grote collectie schelpen vanuit de hele wereld. Een tropisch zeeaquarium maakt eveneens deel uit van de vaste tentoonstelling.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum has a large collection of shells from all over the world. A tropical marine aquarium is also part of the permanent exhibition.

features.name: Koningin Regentes Emma van Waldeck Pyrmont
features.opening: Het Monument voor koningin Emma staat in Benoordenhout in Den Haag, in het Rosarium aan het Jozef Israëlsplein.

facts.text: The original stone statue suffered a broken nose until replaced by bronze in 2001.
facts.sourceQuote: Omdat het beeld in steeds slechtere staat verkeerde en bovendien de neus van het beeld steeds werd afgebroken, werd het in 2001 vervangen door een bronzen afgietsel van het oorspronkelijke beeld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Because the image was in increasingly poor condition and in addition the nose of the image was constantly being broken off, it was replaced in 2001 by a bronze cast of the original image.

facts.text: Sculptor Toon Dupuis designed the work with architect Co Brandes.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld van de koningin is van de Belgisch-Nederlandse beeldhouwer Toon Dupuis. Het ontwerp voor het monument maakte hij in samenspraak met de architect Co Brandes.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The image of the queen is by the Belgian-Dutch sculptor Toon Dupuis. He designed the monument in consultation with the architect Co Brandes.

features.name: Vredeskapel
features.opening: De Vredeskapel is een voormalig kerkgebouw van de Hervormde Gemeente in de Malakkastraat (Archipelbuurt) in de Nederlandse plaats Den Haag.

facts.text: The chapel survived World War II damage and underwent a major restoration at the start of the twenty-first century.
facts.sourceQuote: Tweemaal werd de kapel als kerkgebouw gerestaureerd, eerst na de schade die was opgelopen tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog, en begin 21e eeuw weer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The chapel was restored twice as a church building, first after the damage suffered during World War II, and again at the beginning of the 21st century.

facts.text: While other items left, the Statenbijbel Bible remained inside the chapel for a time.
facts.sourceQuote: Het doopvont en het avondmaal-servies zijn na de sluiting in de Duinzigtkerk geplaatst, de Statenbijbel bleef vooralsnog in de Vredeskapel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The baptismal font and the communion service were placed in the Duinzigt church after closing, the Statenbijbel remained in the Vredeskapel for the time being.

features.name: Ridderzaal
features.opening: The Ridderzaal (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈrɪdərzaːl]; English: Hall of Knights) is the main building of the 13th-century inner square of the former castle of the…

facts.text: Floris V, grandson of Floris IV, built the hall on his family's estate in the 13th century.
facts.sourceQuote: The Ridderzaal, the manorial hall of Floris V, grandson of Floris IV, was built on this estate in the 13th century.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Ridderzaal, the manorial hall of Floris V, grandson of Floris IV, was built on this estate in the 13th century.

facts.text: The hall once functioned as a hospital ward and even housed offices for the state lottery.
facts.sourceQuote: In later centuries it served a variety of purposes - as a market hall, a promenade, a drill hall, a public record office, a hospital ward, even the offices of the state lottery.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In later centuries it served a variety of purposes - as a market hall, a promenade, a drill hall, a public record office, a hospital ward, even the offices of the state lottery.

facts.text: The Dutch monarch delivers the speech from the throne during the annual Prinsjesdag state opening.
facts.sourceQuote: It is used for the annual state opening of Parliament on Prinsjesdag, when the Dutch monarch drives to Parliament in the Golden Coach and delivers the speech from the throne.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is used for the annual state opening of Parliament on Prinsjesdag, when the Dutch monarch drives to Parliament in the Golden Coach and delivers the speech from the throne.

features.name: Peace Palace
features.opening: The Peace Palace (Dutch: Vredespaleis [ˈvreːdəspaːˌlɛis]; French: Palais de la Paix) is an international courthouse in The Hague, Netherlands.

facts.text: Andrew Carnegie donated $1.5 million to fund the building and its international law library.
facts.sourceQuote: Andrew Dickson White, whose efforts were instrumental in creating the court, secured US$1.5 million ($50,000,000, adjusted for inflation) from Scottish-American steel magnate Andrew Carnegie to build the Peace Palace to house the court as well as to endow it with a library of international law.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Andrew Dickson White, whose efforts were instrumental in creating the court, secured US$1.5 million ($50,000,000, adjusted for inflation) from Scottish-American steel magnate Andrew Carnegie to build the Peace Palace to house the court as well as to endow it with a library of international law.

facts.text: The Permanent Court of Arbitration was established by the 1899 Convention for Pacific Settlement.
facts.sourceQuote: The crowning achievement of the Conference was the 1899 Convention for the Pacific Settlement of International Disputes. The Convention recognized arbitration as “the most effective, and at the same time the most equitable means of settling disputes which diplomacy has failed to settle.” To that end, the Convention established the Permanent Court of Arbitration, to be “accessible to all” and “accessible at all times”.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The crowning achievement of the Conference was the 1899 Convention for the Pacific Settlement of International Disputes. The Convention recognized arbitration as “the most effective, and at the same time the most equitable means of settling disputes which diplomacy has failed to settle.” To that end, the Convention established the Permanent Court of Arbitration, to be “accessible to all” and “accessible at all times”.

facts.text: The first stone was symbolically placed during the Second Hague Conference in 1907.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1907, the first stone was symbolically placed during the Second Hague Conference.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1907, the first stone was symbolically placed during the Second Hague Conference.

facts.text: A Russian gift includes a massive vase weighing over three tonnes.
facts.sourceQuote: Among the gifts are a 3.2-tonne (3.1-long-ton; 3.5-short-ton) vase from Russia, doors from Belgium, marble from Italy, a fountain from Denmark, the clock for the clock tower from Switzerland, Persian rugs from Persia, wood from Malaysia, Indonesia, Brazil and the United States of America and wrought-iron fences from Germany.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Among the gifts are a 3.2-tonne (3.1-long-ton; 3.5-short-ton) vase from Russia, doors from Belgium, marble from Italy, a fountain from Denmark, the clock for the clock tower from Switzerland, Persian rugs from Persia, wood from Malaysia, Indonesia, Brazil and the United States of America and wrought-iron fences from Germany.

facts.text: Wood for the structure came from Malaysia, Indonesia, Brazil, and the United States.
facts.sourceQuote: Among the gifts are a 3.2-tonne (3.1-long-ton; 3.5-short-ton) vase from Russia, doors from Belgium, marble from Italy, a fountain from Denmark, the clock for the clock tower from Switzerland, Persian rugs from Persia, wood from Malaysia, Indonesia, Brazil and the United States of America and wrought-iron fences from Germany.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Among the gifts are a 3.2-tonne (3.1-long-ton; 3.5-short-ton) vase from Russia, doors from Belgium, marble from Italy, a fountain from Denmark, the clock for the clock tower from Switzerland, Persian rugs from Persia, wood from Malaysia, Indonesia, Brazil and the United States of America and wrought-iron fences from Germany.

features.name: Binnenpoort
features.opening: De Binnenpoort of Middenpoort is een van de vier bewaard gebleven toegangspoorten die toegang geven tot het Binnenhof in Den Haag.

facts.text: The gate was constructed in 1634 alongside the nearby Mauritspoort to enclose the Binnenhof.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze is samen met de nabijgelegen Mauritspoort gebouwd in 1634 en werd gebruikt om het Binnenhof af te sluiten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was built in 1634 together with the nearby Mauritspoort and was used to enclose the Binnenhof.

facts.text: A meeting room sits directly above the gate and is accessible via the white gallery.
facts.sourceQuote: Boven de poort bevindt zich een vergaderruimte bereikbaar vanuit de witte galerij.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Above the gate is a meeting room accessible from the white gallery.

features.name: Louwman Museum
features.opening: The Louwman Museum is a museum for historic cars, coaches, and motorcycles in The Hague, Netherlands.

facts.text: Founder Pieter Louwman started the collection in 1934 by buying a 20-year-old Dodge.
facts.sourceQuote: It was founded in 1934 with the purchase of a 20-year-old Dodge by Dodge importer Pieter Louwman, the father of the current owner.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was founded in 1934 with the purchase of a 20-year-old Dodge by Dodge importer Pieter Louwman, the father of the current owner.

facts.text: The venue was formerly known as the Nationaal Automobiel Museum and Louwman Collection.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum's former names are "Nationaal Automobiel Museum" and "Louwman Collection".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum's former names are "Nationaal Automobiel Museum" and "Louwman Collection".

facts.text: Since 2010, the collection has resided on Leidsestraatweg near the A44 motorway.
facts.sourceQuote: It has been situated on the Leidsestraatweg near the A44 motorway since 2010.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It has been situated on the Leidsestraatweg near the A44 motorway since 2010.

features.name: Bethlehemkerk
features.opening: De Bethlehemkerk aan de Laan van Meerdervoort 627 in Den Haag is een kerkgebouw van de Protestantse Gemeente ‘s Gravenhage.

facts.text: Rotterdam architects Johan Coenraad Meischke and Pieter Schmidt designed this structure for use in 1931.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kerkgebouw werd door de Rotterdamse architecten Johan Coenraad Meischke en Pieter Schmidt van het Architectenbureau Meischke en Schmidt ontworpen, en kon in 1931 in gebruik worden genomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church building was designed by the Rotterdam architects Johan Coenraad Meischke and Pieter Schmidt of the Architectenbureau Meischke and Schmidt, and could be put into use in 1931.

facts.text: Princess Juliana and Prince Bernhard visited here as an engaged couple with Queen Wilhelmina.
facts.sourceQuote: Prinses Juliana en prins Bernhard brachten hier als jong verloofd paar hun eerste kerkbezoek samen met koningin Wilhelmina.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Princess Juliana and Prince Bernhard brought their first church visit here as a young engaged couple together with Queen Wilhelmina.

facts.text: Until 1970, the church contained a dedicated box for the royal family.
facts.sourceQuote: Naast de kansel bevond zich - tot 1970 - een loge voor de kerkenraad en aan de andere zijde voor de koninklijke familie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In addition to the throne, there was - until 1970 - a box for the church council and on the other side for the royal family.

facts.text: The interior pews are crafted from teak wood.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerkbanken zijn van teakhout.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The pews are made of teak wood.

features.name: Paard
features.opening: PAARD, formerly known as Paard van Troje (Dutch for Trojan Horse), is a venue in The Hague, Netherlands founded on 18 June 1972 with the support of the…

facts.text: The venue began as a youth culture center before evolving into a music hub.
facts.sourceQuote: The Paard van Troje began as a centre for youth culture.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Paard van Troje began as a centre for youth culture.

facts.text: Early years featured a permissive cannabis policy while strictly banning hard drugs.
facts.sourceQuote: In its early years, the venue was noted for its permissive policy on use of cannabis which was also sold in the venue, although use of hard drugs was not allowed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In its early years, the venue was noted for its permissive policy on use of cannabis which was also sold in the venue, although use of hard drugs was not allowed.

facts.text: The venue was formerly known as Paard van Troje, the Dutch term for Trojan Horse.
facts.sourceQuote: PAARD, formerly known as Paard van Troje (Dutch for Trojan Horse), is a venue in The Hague, Netherlands founded on 18 June 1972 with the support of the alderman of culture from The Hague.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: PAARD, formerly known as Paard van Troje (Dutch for Trojan Horse), is a venue in The Hague, Netherlands founded on 18 June 1972 with the support of the alderman of culture from The Hague.

facts.text: A separate café named Paardcafe offers seating for approximately 200 guests.
facts.sourceQuote: Additionally, there is a café named Paardcafe with space for approximately 200 people.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Additionally, there is a café named Paardcafe with space for approximately 200 people.

features.name: Amare
features.opening: Amare is het onderwijs- en cultuurgebouw aan het Spuiplein in Den Haag.

facts.text: Neutelings Riedijk Architects won the design competition against Zaha Hadid and RAU.
facts.sourceQuote: Neutelings Riedijk Architecten won het uiteindelijk van Zaha Hadid en RAU.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Neutelings Riedijk Architects ultimately won against Zaha Hadid and RAU.

facts.text: The municipal council approved construction on November 8, 2012 after a year-long postponement.
facts.sourceQuote: Die besloot daarom in 2011 de keuze tussen nieuwbouw of renovatie een jaar uit te stellen, zodat het ontwerp voor nieuwbouw kon worden versimpeld om de kosten te drukken. Op 8 november 2012 stemde de gemeenteraad in met de bouw van het Spuiforum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Therefore, in 2011, it decided to postpone the choice between new construction or renovation for a year, so that the design for new construction could be simplified to reduce costs. On November 8, 2012, the municipal council approved the construction of the Spuiforum.

facts.text: All college parties voted in favor while every opposition party voted against the project.
facts.sourceQuote: Alle collegepartijen stemden voor, alle oppositiepartijen tegen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: All college parties voted in favor, all opposition parties against.

facts.text: Cadanz, a joint venture of Boele & Van Eesteren and Visser & Smit Bouw, constructed the complex.
facts.sourceQuote: Het complex wordt gebouwd door Cadanz, een samenwerking van Boele & Van Eesteren en Visser & Smit Bouw.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The complex is being built by Cadanz, a collaboration of Boele & Van Eesteren and Visser & Smit Bouw.

facts.text: A construction error caused the floor to sink, jamming doors until it was raised by two centimeters in 2022.
facts.sourceQuote: Kort na de oplevering, begin 2022, bleek de vloer van het gebouw door een bouwfout te zijn verzakt, waardoor deuren klem kwamen te zitten. Eind juli 2022 werd bekendgemaakt dat de vloer met twee centimeter zou worden opgehoogd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Shortly after delivery, early 2022, it was discovered that the floor of the building had sunk due to a construction error, causing doors to jam. At the end of July 2022, it was announced that the floor would be raised by two centimeters.

facts.text: Four massive roof trusses weighing 45,000 kg each were hoisted into place during the second quarter of 2019.
facts.sourceQuote: In het tweede kwartaal van 2019 was de bouw halverwege en werden vier dakspanten van elk 45.000 kg ingehesen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the second quarter of 2019, construction was halfway through and four roof trusses of 45,000 kg each were hoisted into place.

features.name: Laaktheater
features.opening: Het Laaktheater is een lijsttheater gelegen aan de Ferrandweg in de wijk Spoorwijk in Den Haag.

facts.text: The venue emerged in 2012 after its predecessor, Theater Pierrot, was dissolved due to mismanagement.
facts.sourceQuote: Na mismanagement werd het Theater Pierrot ontbonden en ging in 2012 door als "Laaktheater".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After mismanagement, the Theater Pierrot was dissolved and continued as "Laaktheater" in 2012.

facts.text: Regular users include the Laaks Youth Theater, Medea theater, and Filmclub Laak.
facts.sourceQuote: Vaste gebruikers zijn het Laaks Jeugdtheater, Medea-theater en Filmclub Laak.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Regular users are Laaks Youth Theater, Medea theater and Filmclub Laak.

features.name: Monument van Puin
features.opening: Het 'Monument van Puin' herinnert de inwoners van Den Haag aan de op duinen gelijkende puinbergen nabij Kijkduin die tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog zijn…

facts.text: The artist Donald Duk, born in Groningen, created this unique sculpture.
facts.sourceQuote: Het 'Monument van Puin' is ontworpen door de in Groningen geboren kunstenaar Donald Duk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The 'Monument van Puin' was designed by the artist Donald Duk, born in Groningen.

features.name: Nationaal Onafhankelijkheidsmonument
features.opening: Het Nationaal Monument op het Plein 1813 in Den Haag werd in 1869 onthuld ter nagedachtenis aan de overwinning op Napoleon, het einde van de Franse tijd in…

facts.text: Eben-Ezer is inscribed on the pedestal, referencing a biblical victory over the Philistines.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de sokkel staat in grote zwarte letters de naam Eben-Haëzer, die verwijst naar de overwinning van de Israëlieten op de Filistijnen in het Bijbelboek 1 Samuel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the pedestal is the name Eben-Ezer in large black letters, which refers to the victory of the Israelites over the Philistines in the book of 1 Samuel in the Bible.

facts.text: Queen Juliana laid a wreath there on November 30, 1963.
facts.sourceQuote: Op zaterdag 30 november 1963 legde koningin Juliana een krans bij het monument om te herdenken dat de Prins van Oranje 150 jaar eerder in Scheveningen was aangekomen en Nederland 150 jaar onafhankelijk was.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On Saturday, November 30, 1963, Queen Juliana laid a wreath at the monument to commemorate that the Prince of Orange had arrived in Scheveningen 150 years earlier and that the Netherlands had been 150 years independent.

facts.text: The ceremony marked 150 years since the Prince of Orange arrived in Scheveningen.
facts.sourceQuote: Op zaterdag 30 november 1963 legde koningin Juliana een krans bij het monument om te herdenken dat de Prins van Oranje 150 jaar eerder in Scheveningen was aangekomen en Nederland 150 jaar onafhankelijk was.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On Saturday, November 30, 1963, Queen Juliana laid a wreath at the monument to commemorate that the Prince of Orange had arrived in Scheveningen 150 years earlier and that the Netherlands had been 150 years independent.

features.name: Oorlogsmonument 'Dwangarbeiders'
features.opening: Dwangarbeiders is een oorlogsmonument in Den Haag.

facts.text: A raised stainless steel ring holds small human figures and sits atop a brick embankment surrounding a tree.
facts.sourceQuote: Het bestaat uit een boom die omringd wordt door een bakstenen verhoging, waarop een opstaande roestvrijstalen ring is bevestigd. Aan de binnenkant van die ring zijn kleine mensenfiguren aangebracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It consists of a tree surrounded by a brick embankment, on which a raised stainless steel ring is attached. Small human figures are attached to the inside of that ring.

features.name: Theater aan het Spui
features.opening: Theater aan het Spui is een middelgroot vlakkevloertheater gelegen aan het Spui, het culturele hart van Den Haag.

facts.text: Architect Herman Hertzberger designed the venue's two distinct performance rooms.
facts.sourceQuote: Het theater is een ontwerp van architect Herman Hertzberger en beschikt over twee zalen: de grote zaal met 360 stoelen en de kleine zaal met 170 stoelen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The theater is a design by architect Herman Hertzberger and has two rooms: the large room with 360 seats and the small room with 170 seats.

facts.text: Festivals like Movies that Matter and Holland Dance Festival regularly take place here.
facts.sourceQuote: Het theater huisvest een aantal festivals als Todaysart, CaDance, Movies that Matter, Holland Dance Festival en Writers Unlimited (voorheen Winternachten).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The theater hosts a number of festivals such as Todaysart, CaDance, Movies that Matter, Holland Dance Festival and Writers Unlimited (formerly Winternachten).

features.name: Paleiskerk
features.opening: De Paleiskerk of doopsgezinde kerk in Den Haag is een neoromaanse kerk uit 1886 aan de Paleisstraat, vlak bij Paleis Noordeinde.

facts.text: The hall church was designed by Hague architect Klaas Stoffels for the Baptist community.
facts.sourceQuote: De eenbeukige zaalkerk is voor de doopsgezinde gemeenschap ontworpen door de Haagse architect Klaas Stoffels.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The hall church with a single nave was designed for the Baptist community by the Hague architect Klaas Stoffels.

facts.text: Since restoration, the church rents space for weddings and concerts alongside services.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds de restauratie wordt de kerk beheerd door een stichting die de kerk, naast de reguliere kerkdiensten, verhuurt voor huwelijken, concerten, etc.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since the restoration, the church has been managed by a foundation that rents the church, in addition to regular church services, for weddings, concerts, etc.

features.name: Heilige Pastoor van Arskerk
features.opening: De Pastoor van Arskerk is een moderne rooms-katholieke kerk aan het begin van de Aaltje Noordewierstraat in het Haagse stadsdeel Loosduinen, op de hoek met het…

facts.text: Heilige Pastoor van Arskerk honors John Maria Vianney, a pastor in Ars near Lyon.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk is gewijd aan de Franse rooms-katholieke heilige Johannes Maria Vianney die pastoor was te Ars bij Lyon.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church is dedicated to the French Roman Catholic saint John Maria Vianney who was a pastor in Ars near Lyon.

facts.text: A separate exit allows worshippers to leave without turning their backs on sacred matters.
facts.sourceQuote: Door de aparte uitgang hoeft de kerkganger zijn rug na de dienst niet naar heilige zaken toe te keren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Due to the separate exit, the churchgoer does not have to turn his back to sacred matters after the service.

features.name: Nieuwe Badkapel
features.opening: De Nieuwe Badkapel is een kerk van de protestantse gemeente te Scheveningen.

facts.text: Queen Wilhelmina regularly visited with her parents and daughter.
facts.sourceQuote: Koningin Wilhelmina kwam hier regelmatig met haar ouders en dochter.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Queen Wilhelmina regularly came here with her parents and daughter.

facts.text: Seven copper lamps hang from wooden barrel vault ceilings.
facts.sourceQuote: De plafonds zijn houten tongewelven, waaraan zeven koperen lampen hangen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The ceilings are wooden barrel vaults, on which seven copper lamps hang.

features.name: Theater De Regentes
features.opening: Theater De Regentes (na een herstart officieel "De Nieuwe Regentes") in Den Haag heette oorspronkelijk Theater Zwembad de Regentes en is opgericht in 1996.

facts.text: The swimming pool closed in the 1980s due to stricter environmental laws.
facts.sourceQuote: In de jaren tachtig is het zwembad afgekeurd als gevolg van aangescherpte wetgevingen op het gebied van het milieubeleid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 1980s, the swimming pool was rejected due to stricter environmental policy legislation.

facts.text: The 1920s structure features distinctive art deco architectural elements.
facts.sourceQuote: In het uit 1920 daterende gebouw met art-deco-elementen heeft menig Hagenaar zijn zwemdiploma behaald of de op de eerste etage gelegen tearoom bezocht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Many Hagenaars have obtained their swimming diploma or visited the tearoom on the first floor in the 1920s building with art deco elements.

facts.text: Residents could access reduced rates through a special Neighborhood Pass.
facts.sourceQuote: De Regentes ontwikkelde een Buurtpas waarmee de bewoners uit het Regentessekwartier voor gereduceerde tarieven naar ‘hun eigen theater' konden gaan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Regentes developed a Neighborhood Pass with which residents from the Regentessekwartier could go to 'their own theater' at reduced rates.

facts.text: At its opening, this facility was the largest covered swimming complex in Europe.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de oprichting was De Regentes de grootste overdekte zwem- en badinrichting van Europa.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the time of its establishment, De Regentes was the largest covered swimming and bathing facility in Europe.

facts.text: The Great Hall was originally a swimming pool hall.
facts.sourceQuote: Dat geldt ook voor de vijf zalen: De Grote zaal (de voormalige zwembadhal) De Kleine zaal (het voormalige kikkerbad) Het Ketelhuis (de voormalige ketelruimte) Het Diepe (voorheen het bassin van het zwembad) De Studio
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This also applies to the five rooms: The Great Hall (the former swimming pool hall) The Small Hall (the former frog pool) The Kettle House (the former boiler room) The Deep (formerly the pool's basin) The Studio

facts.text: One room is called The Kettle House because it was the former boiler room.
facts.sourceQuote: Dat geldt ook voor de vijf zalen: De Grote zaal (de voormalige zwembadhal) De Kleine zaal (het voormalige kikkerbad) Het Ketelhuis (de voormalige ketelruimte) Het Diepe (voorheen het bassin van het zwembad) De Studio
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This also applies to the five rooms: The Great Hall (the former swimming pool hall) The Small Hall (the former frog pool) The Kettle House (the former boiler room) The Deep (formerly the pool's basin) The Studio

features.name: Oranjehotel
features.opening: The Hague Penitentiary Institution (Dutch: Penitentiaire Inrichting Haaglanden) is a Dutch prison that is part of the Judicial Institutions Department (Dienst…

facts.text: The Scheveningen site houses a UN Detention Unit for international suspects like those at the ICTY and ICC.
facts.sourceQuote: A special independent unit in the Scheveningen location serves as a United Nations Detention Unit (UNDU) for international offenders where they remain in pre-trial detention under the responsibility of the United Nations like suspects of the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia (ICTY) and of the International Criminal Court (ICC).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A special independent unit in the Scheveningen location serves as a United Nations Detention Unit (UNDU) for international offenders where they remain in pre-trial detention under the responsibility of the United Nations like suspects of the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia (ICTY) and of the International Criminal Court (ICC).

features.name: Heilige Familiekerk
features.opening: De Heilige Familiekerk is een rooms-katholieke kerk aan het Kamperfoelieplein in Den Haag.

facts.text: Construction of the church took place between 1921 and 1922.
facts.sourceQuote: De Heilige Familiekerk werd tussen 1921 en 1922 gebouwd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Heilige Familiekerk was built between 1921 and 1922.

facts.text: Architect Jan Stuyt designed this large three-aisled cruciform structure.
facts.sourceQuote: Architect Jan Stuyt ontwierp een grote driebeukige kruiskerk in neoromaanse stijl.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Architect Jan Stuyt designed a large three-aisled cruciform church in neo-Romanesque style.

facts.text: The facade features two identical towers topped by a pediment with a mosaic.
facts.sourceQuote: De voorzijde van de kerk is voorzien van twee identieke torens. De gevel wordt bekroond door een fronton, met een mozaïek waarop de Heilige Familie staat afgebeeld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The front of the church is equipped with two identical towers. The facade is crowned by a pediment, with a mosaic depicting the Heilige Family.

facts.text: Adriaan van der Plas painted biblical scenes inside the church in 1952.
facts.sourceQuote: Het interieur van de kerk wordt gesierd door Bijbelse taferelen, die in 1952 zijn geschilderd door Adriaan van der Plas.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The interior of the church is adorned with biblical scenes, painted in 1952 by Adriaan van der Plas.

features.name: Constantyn Huygens
features.opening: Het gedenkmonument Constantijn Huygens werd in 1897 opgericht in Scheveningen.

facts.text: Sculptor Arend Odé created the three-meter bronze monument while working in The Hague.
facts.sourceQuote: Het drie meter hoge gedenkteken werd ontworpen door de in Den Haag werkzame beeldhouwer Arend Odé. Hij maakte een buste van Huygens, die in brons werd gegoten bij Petermann in Sint-Gillis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The three-meter-high monument was designed by the sculptor Arend Odé, who works in The Hague. He made a bust of Huygens, which was cast in bronze by Petermann in Sint-Gillis.

facts.text: The bust features a cloak loosely draped over one shoulder with the head turned slightly.
facts.sourceQuote: Het gedenkteken bestaat uit een buste van Huygens, die zijn hoofd enigszins heeft gedraaid en een mantel losjes over de schouder heeft hangen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument consists of a bust of Huygens, who has turned his head slightly and has a cloak loosely hanging over his shoulder.

facts.text: A neo-baroque stone pedestal supports the sculpture and displays the family coat of arms.
facts.sourceQuote: De buste is geplaatst op een neobarokke, hardstenen sokkel, waarop in een cartouche Huygens' familiewapen is aangebracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bust is placed on a neo-baroque, stone pedestal, on which Huygens's family coat of arms is engraved in a cartouche.

features.name: Stadhouderspoort
features.opening: De Stadhouderspoort is een poort die het Binnenhof en Buitenhof in Den Haag met elkaar verbindt.

facts.text: Stadhouderspoort was originally known as the Middelpoort before its name changed.
facts.sourceQuote: Oorspronkelijk werd de poort de Middelpoort genoemd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Originally, the gate was called the Middelpoort.

facts.text: Historian Jacob de Riemer suggests only the stadtholder was permitted to use this entrance.
facts.sourceQuote: Volgens historicus Jacob de Riemer ontleent het zijn naam eraan dat deze, mogelijk vanaf 1634, toen de andere poorten waren vernieuwd, alleen door de stadhouder gebruikt mocht worden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: According to historian Jacob de Riemer, its name derives from the fact that it was only allowed to be used by the stadtholder, possibly from 1634, when the other gates were renewed.

features.name: Spinoza
features.opening: Het standbeeld van Spinoza is een 19e-eeuws gedenkteken in Den Haag, ter nagedachtenis aan de filosoof Benedictus de Spinoza.

facts.text: A theologian opposed the statue's arrival, arguing it fused pantheism with natural science.
facts.sourceQuote: Gunning jr. zag bij Spinoza een versmelting van het pantheïsme en natuurwetenschap en verzette zich via de dagbladen, een pamflet en zijn preken tegen de komst van een standbeeld in de openbare ruimte.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Gunning jr. saw a fusion of pantheism and natural science at Spinoza and opposed the arrival of a statue in public space through newspapers, a pamphlet and his sermons.

facts.text: The statue's pedestal is made of red Swedish granite that was cut and polished in Berlin.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld staat op een sokkel van rood Zweeds graniet, gehakt en gepolijst in Berlijn, met de inscriptie SPINOZA Het geheel wordt omgeven door een hekwerk, dat werd gemaakt bij de Haagse firma Enthoven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The image stands on a pedestal of red Swedish granite, cut and polished in Berlin, with the inscription SPINOZA The whole is surrounded by a fence, which was made by the Hague company Enthoven.

facts.text: A fence surrounding the monument was crafted by the local Hague company Enthoven.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld staat op een sokkel van rood Zweeds graniet, gehakt en gepolijst in Berlijn, met de inscriptie SPINOZA Het geheel wordt omgeven door een hekwerk, dat werd gemaakt bij de Haagse firma Enthoven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The image stands on a pedestal of red Swedish granite, cut and polished in Berlin, with the inscription SPINOZA The whole is surrounded by a fence, which was made by the Hague company Enthoven.

features.name: Theater PePijn
features.opening: PePijn is een theater in Den Haag dat zich heeft toegespitst op cabaret, stand-upcomedy en kleinkunst.

facts.text: Paul van Vliet founded the group in 1964 with his wife Liselore and pianist Rob van Kreeveld.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1964 richtte Paul van Vliet met Liselore, inmiddels zijn echtgenote, en Ferd Hugas en de pianist Rob van Kreeveld de cabaretgroep PePijn (1964-1970) en het theater PePijn op.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1964, Paul van Vliet founded the cabaret group PePijn (1964-1970) and the theater PePijn with Liselore, now his wife, and Ferd Hugas and the pianist Rob van Kreeveld.

facts.text: Mayor Kolfschoten opened the venue on December 18, 1964, hours after a nearby arts building burned down.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 18 december 1964 opende burgemeester Kolfschoten het theater PePijn van Paul van Vliet met de woorden: "La Reine est morte, vive le petit prince" want enkele uren eerder was het Gebouw voor Kunsten en Wetenschappen afgebrand.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On December 18, 1964, Mayor Kolfschoten opened the PePijn theater by Paul van Vliet with the words: "La Reine est morte, vive le petit prince" because a few hours earlier the Building for Arts and Sciences had been burned down.

facts.text: Initially, performers handled ticket sales and wardrobe duties because no staff was employed at all.
facts.sourceQuote: In het begin was er geen personeel, de cabaretiers zorgden voor de kaartverkoop en de garderobe en ontvingen zelf de bezoekers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At first there was no staff, the cabaret performers took care of ticket sales and the wardrobe and received the visitors themselves.

features.name: O.L.V. Onbevlekt Ontvangen / Elandstraatkerk
features.opening: De Onze Lieve Vrouw Onbevlekt Ontvangenkerk, ook bekend als de Elandkerk of Elandstraatkerk, is een rooms-katholieke kerk aan de Elandstraat in het…

facts.text: The auxiliary church became an independent parish on June 5, 1878, blessed by Bishop Snickers of Haarlem.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 5 juni 1878 werd de hulpkerk een zelfstandige parochiekerk, ingezegend door bisschop Snickers van Haarlem.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On June 5, 1878, the auxiliary church became an independent parish church, blessed by Bishop Snickers of Haarlem.

facts.text: Father Marijnen purchased the land from Sophie van Sachsen-Weimar, daughter of King William II.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1877 kocht pater Marijnen van de Teresia van Avilakerk grond van Sophie van Sachsen-Weimar, de enige dochter van koning Willem II.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1877, Father Marijnen van de Teresia van Avilakerk bought land from Sophie van Sachsen-Weimar, the only daughter of King William II.

features.name: Vrijmetselarij Museum
features.opening: Het Cultureel Maçonniek Centrum 'Prins Frederik' (CMC) te Den Haag, in de Nederlandse provincie Zuid-Holland, is een museum, archief en bibliotheek van de Orde…

facts.text: Frederick donated the Bibliotheca Klossiana library to the Order in 1866 for their collection.
facts.sourceQuote: Prins Frederik was van 1816 tot 1881 Grootmeester van de Orde van Vrijmetselaren onder het Grootoosten der Nederlanden en schonk de Orde in 1866 de Bibliotheca Klossiana, die een belangrijk onderdeel werd van de collectie van het CMC.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Prince Frederick was Grand Master of the Order of Freemasons under the Grand Orient of the Netherlands from 1816 to 1881 and donated the Bibliotheca Klossiana to the Order in 1866, which became an important part of the CMC's collection.

facts.text: The center relocated to a new building at Javastraat 2B in The Hague during 2017.
facts.sourceQuote: Het CMC verhuisde in 2017 met de orde mee naar een nieuw gebouw aan de Javastraat 2B in Den Haag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2017, the CMC moved with the order to a new building at Javastraat 2B in The Hague.

facts.text: The facility bears the name of Prince Frederik as part of its official title.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Cultureel Maçonniek Centrum 'Prins Frederik' (CMC) te Den Haag, in de Nederlandse provincie Zuid-Holland, is een museum, archief en bibliotheek van de Orde van Vrijmetselaren onder het Grootoosten der Nederlanden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Cultureel Maçonniek Centrum 'Prins Frederik' (CMC) in The Hague, in the Dutch province of South Holland, is a museum, archive and library of the Order of Freemasons under the Grand Orient of the Netherlands.

features.name: Museum Beelden aan Zee
features.opening: Beelden aan Zee ("Images/sculptures by the sea") museum in the Scheveningen district of The Hague, founded in 1994 by the sculpture collectors Theo and Lida…

facts.text: Sculpture collectors Theo and Lida Scholten founded the museum in 1994.
facts.sourceQuote: Beelden aan Zee ("Images/sculptures by the sea") museum in the Scheveningen district of The Hague, founded in 1994 by the sculpture collectors Theo and Lida Scholten, is the only Dutch museum which specialises in only exhibiting sculpture.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Beelden aan Zee ("Images/sculptures by the sea") museum in the Scheveningen district of The Hague, founded in 1994 by the sculpture collectors Theo and Lida Scholten, is the only Dutch museum which specialises in only exhibiting sculpture.

facts.text: The Sculptuur Instituut research institute has shared the building since 2004.
facts.sourceQuote: Since 2004, the museum building also houses the Sculptuur Instituut ("Sculpture Institute"), a research institute on contemporary sculpture.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2004, the museum building also houses the Sculptuur Instituut ("Sculpture Institute"), a research institute on contemporary sculpture.

facts.text: Visitors can see the sea from the roof but cannot view the nearby Scheveningen beach.
facts.sourceQuote: From the roof of the museum one can see the sea, but not the boulevard nor the Scheveningen beach.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From the roof of the museum one can see the sea, but not the boulevard nor the Scheveningen beach.

features.name: Onbevlekt Hart van Maria
features.opening: De Onbevlekt Hart van Mariakerk, ook wel bekend als de Marlotkerk is een rooms-katholieke kerkgebouw aan het Bloklandenplein in Den Haag.

facts.text: Before this church existed, believers gathered at changing locations including a farm in Wassenaar.
facts.sourceQuote: Tot die tijd kwamen de gelovingen uit die wijk bijeen op wisselende lokaties, waaronder boerderij Welgelegen aan de Zijdeweg 56, net over de gemeentegrens in Wassenaar.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until then, the believers from that neighborhood gathered at changing locations, including Welgelegen farm at Zijdeweg 56, just across the municipal border in Wassenaar.

features.name: Sint-Jacobus de Meerderekerk
features.opening: De Sint-Jacobus de Meerderekerk (ook: Jacobuskerk) is een rooms-katholieke kerk aan de Parkstraat in het Centrum van Den Haag.

facts.text: Famous architect Pierre Cuypers designed this church between 1875 and 1878.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk werd in 1875-1878 gebouwd naar een ontwerp van de bekende architect Pierre Cuypers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was built in 1875-1878 according to a design by the famous architect Pierre Cuypers.

facts.text: Cuypers placed structural buttresses inside the walls to maximize interior space.
facts.sourceQuote: Bijzonder is dat de architect de steunberen aan de binnenkant van de muren plaatste om de beschikbare ruimte optimaal te kunnen benutten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: What is special is that the architect placed the buttresses on the inside of the walls in order to make the most of the available space.

features.name: Atlantikwall Museum Scheveningen
features.opening: Het Atlantikwall Museum Scheveningen is een in het stadsdeel Scheveningen (Den Haag) gevestigd museum, waarbij overgebleven delen van de Atlantikwall worden…

facts.text: Construction began in December 1941 but mostly occurred from autumn 1942 until the Normandy invasion halted work.
facts.sourceQuote: Formeel begon de aanleg in december 1941, maar het meeste werk is verricht vanaf herfst 1942. Na de geallieerde invasie in Normandië kwam het werk goeddeels stil te liggen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Construction formally began in December 1941, but most of the work was carried out from autumn 1942 onwards. After the Allied invasion of Normandy, work largely came to a standstill.

facts.text: The heavy fortification here protected the nearby German civil administration headquarters at Clingendael.
facts.sourceQuote: Scheveningen beschikte niet over een belangrijke haven, maar het Duitse civiel bestuur in Nederland met het hoofdkwartier van de Rijkscommissaris Arthur Seyss-Inquart, op Clingendael, lag niet ver landinwaarts. Daarom was zij kwetsbaar voor verrassingsaanvallen en werd de verdedigingslinie in Scheveningen een van de zwaarder uitgevoerde delen ervan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Scheveningen did not have an important port, but the German civil administration in the Netherlands with the headquarters of the Reich Commissioner Arthur Seyss-Inquart, at Clingendael, was not far inland. Therefore, it was vulnerable to surprise attacks and the defensive line in Scheveningen became one of the most heavily fortified parts of it.

facts.text: Building this line forced 138,000 people in Scheveningen and The Hague to leave their homes.
facts.sourceQuote: Alleen al in Scheveningen en Den Haag werden 138.000 mensen uit hun woning verdreven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In Scheveningen and The Hague alone, 138,000 people were evicted from their homes.

facts.text: The Atlantikwall Museum Scheveningen Foundation was established on January 1, 2005 without receiving subsidies.
facts.sourceQuote: Eén zo'n organisatie is de Stichting Atlantikwall Museum Scheveningen, opgericht op 1 januari 2005. Zij ontvangt geen subsidie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: One such organization is the Atlantikwall Museum Scheveningen Foundation, founded on January 1, 2005. She does not receive a subsidy.

features.name: Oorlogsmonument 'De Ooievaars'
features.opening: Monument De Ooievaars is een marmeren gedenksteen op het clubgebouw van de Haagse Scheidsrechtersvereniging, gelegen aan de Kijkduinsestraat te Den Haag.

facts.text: Only four members survived the war, including Hans Kattenburg and Joop Wurms, while the rest were killed.
facts.sourceQuote: Toen de oorlog in 1945 was afgelopen waren er nog maar vier leden over waaronder: Hans Kattenburg en Joop Wurms, de rest was door de Duitsers vermoord.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When the war ended in 1945, there were only four members left, including: Hans Kattenburg and Joop Wurms, the rest had been killed by the Germans.

facts.text: The German occupiers disbanded the club in summer 1941 due to a specific ordinance.
facts.sourceQuote: In de zomer van 1941 werd ‘De Ooievaars’ wegens een verordening van de Duitse bezetter opgeheven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the summer of 1941, 'De Ooievaars' was disbanded due to an ordinance of the German occupiers.

facts.text: The stone moved to the Hague Football History Museum in 2020.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 2020 bevindt de gedenksteen zich in het Haagse Voetbalhistorie museum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2020, the memorial stone has been located in the Hague Football History Museum.

features.name: HDV Mescid-I Aksa Camii
features.opening: The Aqsa Mosque (Dutch: Mescidi Aksamoskee) is a mosque, located on the Wagenstraat, in the city of The Hague, in the Netherlands.
