facts.text: Turkish Muslims used the building without permission during Ramadan 1979 due to safety concerns at their previous mosque.
facts.sourceQuote: The city's Turkish Muslim community began using it without permission during Ramadan 1979 due to safety concerns over their previous mosque.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The city's Turkish Muslim community began using it without permission during Ramadan 1979 due to safety concerns over their previous mosque.

features.name: Abdijkerk Loosduinen
features.opening: De Abdij van Loosduinen was een cisterciënzer nonnenklooster in Loosduinen.

facts.text: The tower owned by The Hague municipality was restored in 1941.
facts.sourceQuote: De toren, eigendom van de gemeente Den Haag, werd in 1941 gerestaureerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The tower, owned by the municipality of The Hague, was restored in 1941.

facts.text: The abbey was destroyed by the Geuzen in 1574 before its remains were finished off by the Spanish.
facts.sourceQuote: De abdij werd in 1574 door de Geuzen vernield, en daarna werden de restanten nog eens door de Spanjaarden verwoest.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The abbey was destroyed by the Geuzen in 1574, and then the remains were destroyed again by the Spanish.

facts.text: Count Floris IV and Countess Machteld of Brabant made many donations to support the abbey.
facts.sourceQuote: Graaf Floris IV en gravin Machteld van Brabant deden veel schenkingen aan de abdij.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Count Floris IV and Countess Machteld of Brabant made many donations to the abbey.

features.name: De Vulkaan
features.opening: De Vulkaan is de hoogste duintop van het Westduinpark in Den Haag.

facts.text: Year-round bird migration counts have been conducted here since the early 1980s.
facts.sourceQuote: Op deze locatie worden vanaf begin jaren 1980 jaarrond systematisch vogeltrektellingen verricht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Systematic bird migration counts have been carried out on this site year-round since the early 1980s.

features.name: Pathé Buitenhof
features.opening: Pathé Buitenhof is een bioscoop in Den Haag aan het Buitenhof van Pathé Nederland.

facts.text: The venue underwent a thorough renovation in 1966 to update its facilities.
facts.sourceQuote: Het werd grondig verbouwd in 1966.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was thoroughly renovated in 1966.

facts.text: In 2009 the old ticket hall became a café while the former exit hallway turned into the main entrance.
facts.sourceQuote: De hal met de balie voor de kaartverkoop is in 2009 verbouwd tot café met op de eerste etage een restaurant. De gang die uitgang was van de bioscoop dient als ingang, de kaartverkoop is bij de automaten in de voorhal en aan de balie van de foyer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The hall with the ticket office was converted into a café with a restaurant on the first floor in 2009. The hallway that was the exit from the cinema serves as the entrance, ticket sales are at the vending machines in the lobby and at the counter of the foyer.

facts.text: The Maxime restaurant branch operating here went bankrupt in 2010 yet later returned to service.
facts.sourceQuote: Dit café-restaurant (een vestiging van Maxime) ging in 2010 failliet maar maakte een doorstart.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This café-restaurant (a branch of Maxime) went bankrupt in 2010 but made a comeback.

features.name: Huis ten Bosch
features.opening: Huis ten Bosch (Dutch: Paleis Huis ten Bosch, pronounced [paːˈlɛis ˌɦœys tɛm ˈbɔs]; English: "House in the Woods") is a royal palace in The Hague, Netherlands.

facts.text: The palace received a new sandstone color and green window frames to match its nineteenth-century appearance.
facts.sourceQuote: The palace was also given a new sandstone colour and green window frames, to restore its nineteenth-century appearance.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The palace was also given a new sandstone colour and green window frames, to restore its nineteenth-century appearance.

facts.text: Costs rose by an extra 4.1 million euros beyond the original 59 million euro budget for the project.
facts.sourceQuote: Over time, an additional 4.1 million euros was added on top of the 59 million that had already been budgeted.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Over time, an additional 4.1 million euros was added on top of the 59 million that had already been budgeted.

facts.text: Queen Beatrix lived here from 1981 until her abdication in 2013.
facts.sourceQuote: Huis ten Bosch was the home of Queen Beatrix from 1981 to her abdication in 2013; King Willem-Alexander and his family moved in on 13 January 2019.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Huis ten Bosch was the home of Queen Beatrix from 1981 to her abdication in 2013; King Willem-Alexander and his family moved in on 13 January 2019.

features.name: Watertoren van Scheveningen
features.opening: De watertoren staat in de Oostduinen bij Scheveningen, ter hoogte van de Pompstationsweg.

facts.text: Architect Bert Brouwer and engineer Theodor Stang designed this structure in 1874.
facts.sourceQuote: De watertoren is ontworpen in eclectische stijl door architect Bert Brouwer en civiel ingenieur Theodor Stang en werd in 1874 gebouwd door het Haagse Duinwaterleidingbedrijf (tegenwoordig Dunea genaamd).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The water tower was designed in an eclectic style by architect Bert Brouwer and civil engineer Theodor Stang and was built in 1874 by the Hague Dunes Water Supply Company (now called Dunea).

features.name: Waals-Hervormde Gemeente
features.opening: De Waalse kerk is een kerkgebouw van de Waals-Hervormde gemeente aan het Noordeinde in Den Haag.

facts.text: The neoclassical facade features round arched windows and a plastered coffered ceiling inside.
facts.sourceQuote: De kleine zaalkerk heeft een gestuct koofplafond. In de neoclassicistische gevel bevinden zich enkele rondboogvensters.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The small hall church has a plastered coffered ceiling. There are several round arched windows in the neoclassical facade.

facts.text: A 1885 organ built by Aristide Cavaillé-Coll contains two manuals, 23 registers, and a free pedal.
facts.sourceQuote: Het orgel uit 1885 is gebouwd door de Parijse orgelbouwer Aristide Cavaillé-Coll, het heeft twee manualen, 23 registers en een vrij pedaal.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The 1885 organ was built by the Parisian organ builder Aristide Cavaillé-Coll, it has two manuals, 23 registers and a free pedal.

features.name: Grondwetsherziening van 1848
features.opening: De Heulstraat in Den Haag is een korte, eeuwenoude straat tussen het Noordeinde en de Kneuterdijk.

facts.text: De Nederlandsche Bank occupied the building at Noordeinde 33 until 1994.
facts.sourceQuote: De westkant wordt geheel in beslag genomen door enkele panden die bij paleis Kneuterdijk horen en een bankgebouw (Noordeinde 33) waar tot 1994 De Nederlandsche Bank zat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The west side is completely occupied by several buildings that belong to palace Kneuterdijk and a bank building (Noordeinde 33) where De Nederlandsche Bank was located until 1994.

facts.text: Golden crowns on lanterns mark part of the royal route since 2009.
facts.sourceQuote: Een deel van de route is sinds 2009 aangegeven door gouden kroontjes op de lantaarns.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2009, a part of the route has been indicated by golden crowns on the lanterns.

features.name: Nationaal Monument voor de Koninklijke Marine
features.opening: Het Nationaal Monument voor de Koninklijke Marine bevindt zich aan de Zeekant in Scheveningen.

facts.text: The monument was unveiled on June 14, 1966 to honor naval victims of World War II.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument werd op 14 juni 1966 onthuld en gedenkt de marineslachtoffers van de Tweede Wereldoorlog.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument was unveiled on June 14, 1966 and commemorates the naval victims of World War II.

facts.text: Queen Wilhelmina's quote The Marine did well is inscribed on the pedestal.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het voetstuk staat een citaat van koningin Wilhelmina: "De Marine heeft het goed gedaan." Het beeld toont drie mariniers die op de boeg van een oorlogsschip met geschuttoren staan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the pedestal is a quote from Queen Wilhelmina: "The Marine did well." The image shows three marines standing on the bow of a warship with gun turrets.

features.name: The Hague City Hall
features.opening: The Hague City Hall (Dutch: Stadhuis van Den Haag) is the city hall of The Hague, Netherlands.

facts.text: A central atrium sits between two slab buildings standing ten and twelve storeys tall.
facts.sourceQuote: At its centre is a large atrium, flanked by two large slab buildings, 10 and 12 storeys tall.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At its centre is a large atrium, flanked by two large slab buildings, 10 and 12 storeys tall.

features.name: Mauritshuis, the Royal Dutch Shell wing
features.opening: The Mauritshuis (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈmʌurɪtsˌɦœys]; The Hague dialect: [ˈmɑːʁɪtsˌɦœːs]; lit.

facts.text: John Maurice, Prince of Nassau-Siegen, commissioned the structure while governing Dutch Brazil.
facts.sourceQuote: Between 1636 and 1641, the Mauritshuis was built on this piece of land during John Maurice's governorship of Dutch Brazil.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Between 1636 and 1641, the Mauritshuis was built on this piece of land during John Maurice's governorship of Dutch Brazil.

facts.text: Architects Jacob van Campen and Pieter Post designed this strictly symmetrical Dutch Classicist building.
facts.sourceQuote: It was built in the Dutch Classicist style by the Dutch architects Jacob van Campen and Pieter Post. The two-storey building is strictly symmetrical; originally the interior contained four apartments and a great hall.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was built in the Dutch Classicist style by the Dutch architects Jacob van Campen and Pieter Post. The two-storey building is strictly symmetrical; originally the interior contained four apartments and a great hall.

facts.text: A fire in 1704 destroyed most interiors before a decade-long restoration followed.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1704, most of the interior of the Mauritshuis was destroyed by fire. The building was restored between 1708 and 1718.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1704, most of the interior of the Mauritshuis was destroyed by fire. The building was restored between 1708 and 1718.

facts.text: During Nazi occupation, people hid in its attic and basement despite nearby enemy offices.
facts.sourceQuote: During the Nazi occupation of the Netherlands from 1940 to 1945, the Mauritshuis, despite being a prominent landmark and even occupied by the Nazis, was somehow able to serve as a hideout for people in the area who were evading Nazi slave labour, with people hiding in the building's attic and basement despite being close to Nazi offices in the building.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the Nazi occupation of the Netherlands from 1940 to 1945, the Mauritshuis, despite being a prominent landmark and even occupied by the Nazis, was somehow able to serve as a hideout for people in the area who were evading Nazi slave labour, with people hiding in the building's attic and basement despite being close to Nazi offices in the building.

features.name: 'Bevrijdingsmonument Irene'
features.opening: Het Irenemonument is het bevrijdingsmonument van Den Haag.

facts.text: A messenger daily raised and lowered the flag while the monument stood near the old town hall.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de rand van het platform staat de tekst: ”Gedenk de offers die ’t herwinnen van vrijheids vreugden vroeg - bedenk welk daaglijks offer het doen groeien van vrijheid steeds weerom U vraagt.” Toen het monument bij het oude stadhuis (1953-1996) aan de Burgemeester Patijnlaan stond, werd iedere dag de vlag door een bode gehesen en neergehaald.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the edge of the platform is the text: "Remember the sacrifices that asked for the return of the joys of freedom - remember what daily sacrifice it asks again and again to grow freedom." When the monument stood near the old town hall (1953-1996) on Burgemeester Patijnlaan, the flag was hoisted and lowered every day by a messenger.

facts.text: The municipality lit the monument in 2009 to highlight the tricolor but stopped after a complaint.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2009 werd het monument door de gemeente aangelicht om vervolgens de Nederlandse driekleur weer duurzaam aan de herkregen vrijheid te laten herinneren. Helaas heeft dit een klacht opgeleverd, zodat dit voorlopig niet gebeurt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2009, the monument was lit up by the municipality in order to then sustainably remind the Dutch tricolor of the regained freedom. Unfortunately, this has resulted in a complaint, so this will not happen for the time being.

facts.text: Since 2011, seventh-grade students from the Haagsche School Association attend its May 8 commemoration.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2011 adopteerde de Haagsche Schoolvereeniging het monument. Leerlingen van groep 7 zullen voortaan de herdenking op 8 mei bijwonen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2011, the Haagsche School Association adopted the monument. Students in group 7 will now attend the commemoration on May 8.

features.name: Oude Kerk
features.opening: De Oude Kerk staat in de Keizerstraat, ooit een van de drukste winkelstraten van Scheveningen, in de Nederlandse gemeente Den Haag.

facts.text: The 1570 flood pushed the church from the village center to its edge.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1570 verwoestte de Allerheiligenvloed een groot deel van het vissersdorp. De kerk stond daarna niet meer in het midden van het dorp, maar aan de rand.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1570, the Allerheiligenvloed destroyed much of the fishing village. The church then no longer stood in the center of the village, but on the edge.

facts.text: In 2006, a portion of the organ's pedal mechanism was replaced during maintenance.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1973 heeft Flentrop nog restauraties uitgevoerd en in 2006 werd een deel van het pedaalwerk vervangen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1973, Flentrop carried out restorations and in 2006, part of the pedal work was replaced.

features.name: Johan de Witt
features.opening: Het standbeeld van Johan de Witt is een 20e-eeuws gedenkteken op de Plaats in Den Haag, ter nagedachtenis aan raadpensionaris Johan de Witt.

facts.text: De Witt and his brother Cornelis were murdered on August 20, 1672.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 20 augustus 1672 werden De Witt en zijn broer Cornelis vermoord.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On August 20, 1672, De Witt and his brother Cornelis were murdered.

facts.text: A plaque recounts his 1665 letter describing how he endured storms to help ships escape Bergen.
facts.sourceQuote: Op elke zijde is een bronzen plaquette met opschrift geplaatst: De voorkant: JOHAN DE WITT 1625-1672 RAADPENSIONARIS VAN HOLLAND EN WEST-FRIESLAND 1653-1672 Linkerkant (De tekst verwijst naar een brief van Johan de Witt, die hij in 1665 schreef na zijn bezoek met de vloot dat jaar aan het Noorse Bergen.): ICK HEBBE GEDUYRENDE DE STORM NAER MYN CRANCK VERMOGEN ALLMEDE HELPEN UYTKYCKEN EN SELFFS IN T ALLERHARTSTE VAN T WEDER BOVEN GESTAEN Achterkant: LEIDER EN DIENAAR VAN DE REPUBLIEK, VORMER HARER MACHTIGSTE VLOTEN, VERDEDIGER DER VRIJE ZEE, VERZORGER VAN S LANDS GELDEN, WISKUNDIGE Rechterkant: HIJ WAS EEN VOLMAAKT HOLLANDER(WILLIAM TEMPLE)
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On each side is a bronze plaque with inscription: Front: JOHAN DE WITT 1625-1672 COUNCIL PENSIONARY OF THE LOW COUNTRY AND WEST FRIESLAND 1653-1672 Left side (The text refers to a letter from Johan de Witt, which he wrote in 1665 after his visit with the fleet that year to the Norwegian Bergen.): I HAVE ENDURED THE STORM TO THE FULLEST EXTENT OF MY CRANKING ABILITY TO HELP YOU ESCAPE AND TO SURVIVE THE STORM IN THE HEART OF THE STORM BACKside: LEADER AND SERVANT OF THE REPUBLIC, FORMER OF HER MOST POWERFUL FLOTTS, DEFENDER OF THE FREE SEAS, PROVIDER OF THE COUNTRY'S MONEY, SKILLED Legal Counsel: HE WAS A COMPLETE HOLLANDER(WILLIAM TEMPLE)

facts.text: William Temple described him as a complete Hollander who was both leader and servant of the Republic.
facts.sourceQuote: Op elke zijde is een bronzen plaquette met opschrift geplaatst: De voorkant: JOHAN DE WITT 1625-1672 RAADPENSIONARIS VAN HOLLAND EN WEST-FRIESLAND 1653-1672 Linkerkant (De tekst verwijst naar een brief van Johan de Witt, die hij in 1665 schreef na zijn bezoek met de vloot dat jaar aan het Noorse Bergen.): ICK HEBBE GEDUYRENDE DE STORM NAER MYN CRANCK VERMOGEN ALLMEDE HELPEN UYTKYCKEN EN SELFFS IN T ALLERHARTSTE VAN T WEDER BOVEN GESTAEN Achterkant: LEIDER EN DIENAAR VAN DE REPUBLIEK, VORMER HARER MACHTIGSTE VLOTEN, VERDEDIGER DER VRIJE ZEE, VERZORGER VAN S LANDS GELDEN, WISKUNDIGE Rechterkant: HIJ WAS EEN VOLMAAKT HOLLANDER(WILLIAM TEMPLE)
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On each side is a bronze plaque with inscription: Front: JOHAN DE WITT 1625-1672 COUNCIL PENSIONARY OF THE LOW COUNTRY AND WEST FRIESLAND 1653-1672 Left side (The text refers to a letter from Johan de Witt, which he wrote in 1665 after his visit with the fleet that year to the Norwegian Bergen.): I HAVE ENDURED THE STORM TO THE FULLEST EXTENT OF MY CRANKING ABILITY TO HELP YOU ESCAPE AND TO SURVIVE THE STORM IN THE HEART OF THE STORM BACKside: LEADER AND SERVANT OF THE REPUBLIC, FORMER OF HER MOST POWERFUL FLOTTS, DEFENDER OF THE FREE SEAS, PROVIDER OF THE COUNTRY'S MONEY, SKILLED Legal Counsel: HE WAS A COMPLETE HOLLANDER(WILLIAM TEMPLE)

features.name: Aartsengel Michael
features.opening: Aartsengel Michaël is een natuurstenen monument in Den Haag waarmee de aartsengel bedankt wordt voor zijn bescherming van het ziekenhuis Joannes de Deo (later…

facts.text: Herman van Remmen created the stone image in 1947.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld werd gemaakt door Herman van Remmen en in 1947 onthuld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The image was created by Herman van Remmen and unveiled in 1947.

facts.text: The monument moved with the hospital to its current Westeinde location in 1979.
facts.sourceQuote: Toen het ziekenhuis in 1979 naar de huidige locatie verhuisde, ook aan het Westeinde, werd dit monument meeverhuisd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When the hospital moved to its current location in 1979, also on the Westeinde, this monument was also moved.

features.name: De Mesdag Collectie
features.opening: The Mesdag Collection is an art museum in The Hague, Netherlands.

facts.text: After Hendrik Mesdag died in 1915, parts of his private collection were sold.
facts.sourceQuote: After Henrik Mesdag's death in 1915, parts of his private collection were sold.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After Henrik Mesdag's death in 1915, parts of his private collection were sold.

facts.text: In 1990, management of the museum passed to the Van Gogh Museum.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1990, the museum came under the management of the Van Gogh Museum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1990, the museum came under the management of the Van Gogh Museum.

facts.text: After a two-year renovation, the venue reopened on May 14, 2011, under its current name De Mesdag Collectie.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum was closed for renovation for roughtly two years until Spring 2011. On 14 May 2011 it was re-opened and renamed from "Museum Mesdag" to "The Mesdag Collection".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was closed for renovation for roughtly two years until Spring 2011. On 14 May 2011 it was re-opened and renamed from "Museum Mesdag" to "The Mesdag Collection".

features.name: Indië-monument
features.opening: Het Indië-monument in Den Haag werd opgericht ter nagedachtenis aan circa 161 militairen die in de periode 1945-1950 gesneuveld zijn bij de strijd in het…

facts.text: The memorial was unveiled in 2002 by mayor Wim Deetman after being initiated by the VOMI veterans association.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument werd op initiatief van de Vereniging Oud Militaire Indiëgangers (VOMI) opgericht en op 18 september 2002 onthuld door burgemeester Wim Deetman.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument was established at the initiative of the Association of Old Military Indochinese Veterans (VOMI) and was unveiled on September 18, 2002 by mayor Wim Deetman.

facts.text: Designer Gert Dumbar created an eight-meter wall of dark gray polished stone with names engraved vertically.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument bestaat uit een gedenkmuur van donkergrijze gepolijste natuursteen en werd ontworpen door Gert Dumbar. De muur is 8 meter lang en 1 meter hoog. Op de muur staan op alfabetische volgorde de namen in verticale richting ingegraveerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument consists of a memorial wall of dark gray polished natural stone and was designed by Gert Dumbar. The wall is 8 meters long and 1 meter high. On the wall, the names are engraved vertically in alphabetical order.

features.name: 'Centraal Monument voor Gevallen PTT'ers'
features.opening: Nassauplein is een lang rechthoekig plein in de Archipelbuurt in Den Haag met maar 43 huisnummers.

facts.text: Crown lanterns were reinstalled on both sides of the inner courtyard to restore the square's original allure.
facts.sourceQuote: Er kwamen aan beide zijden van het plein (binnenplantsoen) weer kroontjeslantaarns, zodat het monumentale plein in allure weer aansluit bij de Vijverberg, Voorhout en Willemspark.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Crown lanterns have been installed again on both sides of the square (inner courtyard), so that the monumental square once again connects in allure with the Vijverberg, Voorhout and Willemspark.

facts.text: More than thirty trees and new hedges along a shell path were planted within the square during renovations.
facts.sourceQuote: Daarbinnen zijn ruim dertig bomen geplaatst en langs het schelpenpad zijn nieuwe perken aangelegd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Within it, more than thirty trees have been planted and new hedges have been laid along the shell path.

facts.text: The canal that once occupied this site was dammed up in 1883.
facts.sourceQuote: Eerst was er een gracht, maar die is in 1883 overkluisd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: First there was a canal, but it was dammed up in 1883.

features.name: Duinzichtkerk
features.opening: De Duinzichtkerk is een kerkgebouw aan de Van Hogenhoucklaan in Den Haag.

facts.text: A heavy storm once caused the large tower clock hands to swing noticeably back and forth.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens zware storm zwiepen de wijzers van de grote klok op de toren opvallend heen en weer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During a heavy storm, the hands of the large clock on the tower swung noticeably back and forth.

facts.text: The Zanen family initiated the project to build this new church in the Benoordenhout district.
facts.sourceQuote: Initiatiefnemer was de familie Zanen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The initiator was the Zanen family.

facts.text: Renowned architect Willem Verschoor created the design for this distinctive religious building.
facts.sourceQuote: Het ontwerp kwam van de bekende architect Willem Verschoor.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The design was by the well-known architect Willem Verschoor.

features.name: Onze Lieve Vrouw Hemelvaartkerk
features.opening: De Onze Lieve Vrouw Hemelvaartkerk is een rooms-katholieke kerk in Loosduinen in de Nederlandse stad Den Haag.

facts.text: The organ likely moved from an older church located directly opposite the current site.
facts.sourceQuote: Dit oude kerkje lag tegenover de huidige OLV-Hemelvaartkerk. Aangenomen wordt dat het orgel uit de oude kerk geplaatst is in de nieuwe kerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This old church was located opposite the current OLV-Hemelvaartkerk. It is assumed that the organ was placed from the old church in the new church.

features.name: Yi Jun Peace Museum
features.opening: Yi Chun (Korean: 이준; Hanja: 李儁; December 18, 1859 – July 14, 1907), name sometimes rendered Yi Tjoune, was a Korean prosecutor and diplomat and the father of…

facts.text: Yi Jun died in a room at the Hotel De Jong after protesting his delegation's rejection.
facts.sourceQuote: Yi protested against the decision. A few days later, he was found dead in his room at the Hotel De Jong on Wagenstraat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Yi protested against the decision. A few days later, he was found dead in his room at the Hotel De Jong on Wagenstraat.

facts.text: A grand memorial was established at the site of Yi Jun's initial burial in 1977.
facts.sourceQuote: A grand memorial was established in 1977 at the site of his initial burial.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A grand memorial was established in 1977 at the site of his initial burial.

facts.text: North Korea has issued postage stamps honoring Yi Jun on several occasions.
facts.sourceQuote: On several occasions postage stamps have been issued by North Korea honoring Yi Jun.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On several occasions postage stamps have been issued by North Korea honoring Yi Jun.

features.name: Koninklijke Schouwburg
features.opening: The Koninklijke Schouwburg (literally translated: Royal Theater or Royal Playhouse) is a theater in the city center of The Hague.

facts.text: Dangerous stairways were replaced by two main glass stairways flanking the hall.
facts.sourceQuote: The stairways were considered dangerous, and replaced by two main stairways fully made out of glass on both sides of the main hall.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The stairways were considered dangerous, and replaced by two main stairways fully made out of glass on both sides of the main hall.

facts.text: The venue reopened on September 18, 1999, with a premiere of Oude Mensen.
facts.sourceQuote: On 18 September 1999 the Koninklijke Schouwburg was reopened by the alderman Louise Engering, followed by the premiere of "Oude Mensen" by the Nationale Toneel (directed by Ger Thijs).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On 18 September 1999 the Koninklijke Schouwburg was reopened by the alderman Louise Engering, followed by the premiere of "Oude Mensen" by the Nationale Toneel (directed by Ger Thijs).

facts.text: A 2017 merger created Het Nationale Theater, which now performs at this historic stage.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2017, the Nationale Toneel merged with Theater aan het Spui, another major stage company in The Hague, to Het Nationale Theater - which plays in multiple theaters across the city, including the Koninklijke Schouwburg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2017, the Nationale Toneel merged with Theater aan het Spui, another major stage company in The Hague, to Het Nationale Theater - which plays in multiple theaters across the city, including the Koninklijke Schouwburg.

facts.text: Construction finished in 1766, though regular theatrical performances only began in 1804.
facts.sourceQuote: The theater was built in 1766 and has been in use as theater since 1804.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The theater was built in 1766 and has been in use as theater since 1804.

facts.text: The main hall seats 680 people across the floor and three distinct balconies.
facts.sourceQuote: The main room of the Schouwburg is relatively small for current standards, and can seat 680 people in total with the main room and three balconies.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The main room of the Schouwburg is relatively small for current standards, and can seat 680 people in total with the main room and three balconies.

facts.text: A functional antique revolving stage from 1929 remains on site but is no longer used.
facts.sourceQuote: The stage has a 1929 antique revolving stage that is still functional but no longer in use.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The stage has a 1929 antique revolving stage that is still functional but no longer in use.

features.name: Juliana van Stolberg
features.opening: Juliana van Stolberg en haar vijf zoons is een monument in de Zuid-Hollandse stad Den Haag.

facts.text: The monument's first stone was laid on April 30, 1927, by Prime Minister Dirk Jan de Geer.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste steen voor het monument werd gelegd op de achttiende verjaardag van prinses Juliana, op 30 april 1927, door Dirk Jan de Geer, voorzitter van de ministerraad.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first stone for the monument was laid on the eighteenth birthday of Princess Juliana, on April 30, 1927, by Dirk Jan de Geer, chairman of the Council of Ministers.

facts.text: Queen Wilhelmina and Queen Mother Emma attended the 1930 unveiling ceremony alongside Princess Juliana.
facts.sourceQuote: Drie jaar later, op 23 april 1930, werd het monument onthuld door de prinses ter gelegenheid van haar 18e verjaardag, in aanwezigheid van koningin Wilhelmina en koningin-moeder Emma.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Three years later, on April 23, 1930, the monument was unveiled by the princess on the occasion of her 18th birthday, in the presence of Queen Wilhelmina and Queen Mother Emma.

facts.text: The monument survived the March 3, 1945 bombing with only slight damage.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens het bombardement op het Bezuidenhout op 3 maart 1945 blijft het monument overeind staan te midden van de ruïnes van de omgeving. Het wordt slechts licht beschadigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the bombing of Bezuidenhout on March 3, 1945, the monument remains standing in the middle of the ruins of the surrounding area. It is only slightly damaged.

features.name: Kerk van de H.H. Jacobus en Augustinus
features.opening: De H.H. Jacobus- en Augustinuskerk is een oudkatholieke kerk in de Juffrouw Idastraat in Den Haag.

facts.text: Municipal permission to build was granted in 1720 on the condition that it remained invisible from the street.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1720 gaf het stadsbestuur toestemming een katholieke kerk te bouwen mits die niet vanaf de straat te zien zou zijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1720, the municipal government gave permission to build a Catholic church provided that it would not be visible from the street.

facts.text: The ceiling features twelve apostles surrounding a central depiction of Christ's ascension.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het plafond staan de twaalf apostelen afgebeeld. In het midden is een voorstelling van de hemelvaart van Christus.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The twelve apostles are depicted on the ceiling. In the center is a depiction of the ascension of Christ.

facts.text: Jean Baptist Xavery crafted the pulpit in 1729, with its crown added shortly after.
facts.sourceQuote: De kansel werd gemaakt door Jean Baptist Xavery en is uit 1729, de bekroning is enkele jaren later gemaakt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The pulpit was made by Jean Baptist Xavery and dates from 1729, the crown was made a few years later.

facts.text: Rudolph Garrels built the organ in 1726, which is now designated as a national monument.
facts.sourceQuote: Het orgel is in 1726 gemaakt door Rudolph Garrels en is nu een rijksmonument.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The organ was made in 1726 by Rudolph Garrels and is now a national monument.

features.name: Grondwetbank
features.opening: De grondwetbank is een monument voor de Nederlandse Grondwet gelegen aan de Hofplaats te Den Haag.

facts.text: The Grondwetbank is a 45-meter-long bench made of smooth marble.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument heeft de vorm van een 45 meter lange zitbank van glad marmer waarop de tekst is aangebracht van artikel 1 van de Nederlandse Grondwet.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument is in the shape of a 45-meter-long bench of smooth marble on which the text of article 1 of the Dutch Constitution is inscribed.

facts.text: The Hague municipality gifted this monument to the government in 1992.
facts.sourceQuote: De gemeente Den Haag heeft het monument in 1992 cadeau gedaan aan de regering.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The municipality of The Hague gave the monument as a gift to the government in 1992.

features.name: Ver Huellbank
features.opening: De Ver Huellbank is een gedenkbank die in 1881 werd opgericht in Den Haag ter nagedachtenis aan jhr.

facts.text: Henry Christiaan Arnoud Ver Huell died before the bench honoring him was unveiled in September 1881.
facts.sourceQuote: Nog tijdens zijn leven werd besloten hem te eren met een bank. Hij heeft de onthulling daarvan, in september 1881, door zijn overlijden niet meer kunnen meemaken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Even during his lifetime, it was decided to honor him with a bench. He was unable to witness the revelation of that in September 1881 due to his death.

facts.text: Sculptor Eugène Lacomblé likely designed the monument, while Laurent Phillips of The Hague crafted it.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument in neo-empirestijl werd waarschijnlijk ontworpen door beeldhouwer Eugène Lacomblé en werd gemaakt door de firma Laurent Phillips uit Den Haag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument in neo-imperial style was probably designed by sculptor Eugène Lacomblé and was made by the company Laurent Phillips from The Hague.

features.name: The Hague University of Applied Sciences
features.opening: The Hague University of Applied Sciences (abbreviated as: THUAS; Dutch: De Haagse Hogeschool) is a university of applied sciences with its campuses located in…

facts.text: The sports campus now stands where ADO Den Haag's Zuiderpark stadium once stood until 2007.
facts.sourceQuote: In September 2017, the Physical Education Teacher Training Programme (HALO), Sport Studies and International Sport Management degree programmes moved into Zuiderpark Sports Campus, built on the site where ADO Den Haag's Zuiderpark stadium stood until 2007.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In September 2017, the Physical Education Teacher Training Programme (HALO), Sport Studies and International Sport Management degree programmes moved into Zuiderpark Sports Campus, built on the site where ADO Den Haag's Zuiderpark stadium stood until 2007.

facts.text: The new sports complex includes twelve lecture halls alongside various athletic facilities.
facts.sourceQuote: The complex that replaced the stadium contains various sports facilities as well as 12 lecture halls.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The complex that replaced the stadium contains various sports facilities as well as 12 lecture halls.

facts.text: Professionals with years of experience can study part-time or in dual bachelor programmes.
facts.sourceQuote: Professionals with several years of work experience can follow a part-time or dual programme at bachelor level.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Professionals with several years of work experience can follow a part-time or dual programme at bachelor level.

facts.text: The institution offers extensive master's degrees and postgraduate education via The Hague Graduate School.
facts.sourceQuote: The university also offers an extensive range of master's degree programmes and further postgraduate education through The Hague Graduate School.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The university also offers an extensive range of master's degree programmes and further postgraduate education through The Hague Graduate School.

features.name: Mauritspoort
features.opening: De Mauritspoort of Grenadierspoort is de oostelijke toegangspoort tot het Binnenhof in Den Haag.

facts.text: The canal beneath the gate was filled in during 1860.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1860 is de hofgracht onder de brug gedempt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1860, the canal under the bridge was filled in.

facts.text: Pulley holes from its original drawbridge mechanism remain visible on the exterior.
facts.sourceQuote: De katrolgaten zijn nog zichtbaar aan de buitenzijde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The pulley holes are still visible on the outside.

features.name: Geünieerde Loge van Theosofen
features.opening: The United Lodge of Theosophists or ULT is an informal and wholly voluntary association of students of Theosophy.

facts.text: Robert Crosbie left Point Loma in 1904 after feeling original teachings were eclipsed by sensational programs.
facts.sourceQuote: However, by 1904, he felt the original teachings of Theosophy were almost completely eclipsed by Katherine Tingley's sensational programs. Convinced that further effort was futile, he quietly left Point Loma and moved to Los Angeles.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: However, by 1904, he felt the original teachings of Theosophy were almost completely eclipsed by Katherine Tingley's sensational programs. Convinced that further effort was futile, he quietly left Point Loma and moved to Los Angeles.

facts.text: By February 1909, Crosbie had gathered a study group of seven individuals to restore Theosophy's original lines.
facts.sourceQuote: By February 1909, he had gathered around him seven individuals as part of a study group, four of whom were new to Theosophy. This nucleus, under Robert Crosbie's guidance, set to the task of restoring Theosophy along the original lines of its founders without organizational distractions.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: By February 1909, he had gathered around him seven individuals as part of a study group, four of whom were new to Theosophy. This nucleus, under Robert Crosbie's guidance, set to the task of restoring Theosophy along the original lines of its founders without organizational distractions.

facts.text: The first parent lodge was established in Los Angeles on February 18, 1909.
facts.sourceQuote: The first parent lodge of the ULT was started in Los Angeles by Robert Crosbie and seven other associates through the adoption of its Declaration on February 18, 1909.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first parent lodge of the ULT was started in Los Angeles by Robert Crosbie and seven other associates through the adoption of its Declaration on February 18, 1909.

features.name: Mijlpalen van het Wateringse Veld
features.opening: De Mijlpalen van het Wateringse Veld zijn vier mijlpalen uit de Romeinse tijd, die zijn gevonden bij opgravingen in de wijk Wateringse Veld in Den Haag.

facts.text: Archaeologists uncovered these Roman road markers during a 1997 excavation for a new residential area.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de start van de bouw van de nieuwbouwwijk "Wateringse Veld" werden door de archeologische dienst van de gemeente Den Haag in 1997 een aantal opgravingen gedaan, toen in een greppel bij de weg "Oosteinde" twee rechthoekige natuurstenen blokken werden gevonden. Bij het verder uitdiepen van deze greppel werden de vier mijlpalen aangetroffen, waarvan drie nog in goede staat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When construction began on the new residential area "Wateringse Veld", a number of excavations were carried out by the archaeological service of the municipality of The Hague in 1997, when two rectangular natural stone blocks were found in a ditch near the road "Oosteinde". When further exploring this ditch, the four mile markers were found, three of which are still in good condition.

facts.text: New posts were simply placed next to older ones rather than replacing them when new distances needed marking.
facts.sourceQuote: De oudere palen werden niet vervangen, er werd gewoon een nieuwe naast geplaatst.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The older poles were not replaced, a new one was simply placed next to them.

facts.text: Some stones honored specific events like road construction or restoration instead of just measuring distance to cities.
facts.sourceQuote: Het was standaard Romeins gebruik om langs de hoofdwegen om de Romeinse mijl een paal te plaatsen, die zowel de afstand naar de dichtstbijzijnde stad aangaf, de regerende keizer eerde of herinnerde aan een bijzondere gebeurtenis, zoals de aanleg van een weg of het herstel daarvan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was standard Roman practice to place a post along the main roads around the Roman mile, which indicated both the distance to the nearest city, honored or remembered the reigning emperor or a special event, such as the construction or restoration of a road.

features.name: Peace Palace Library
features.opening: The Peace Palace Library is a collection of studies and references specializing in international law.

facts.text: Carnegie insisted the building include a legal library alongside the court.
facts.section: History and relationship with the Carnegie Foundation
facts.sourceQuote: The palace was built to accommodate the Permanent Court of Arbitration, but Carnegie insisted that room be made available also for a legal library.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The palace was built to accommodate the Permanent Court of Arbitration, but Carnegie insisted that room be made available also for a legal library.

facts.text: The library was established to support the Permanent Court of Justice.
facts.sourceQuote: It is located in The Hague, Netherlands, and was established to support the Permanent Court of Justice.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is located in The Hague, Netherlands, and was established to support the Permanent Court of Justice.

features.name: Lourdeskapel
features.opening: De Lourdeskapel te Scheveningen is onderdeel van het in het register van rijksmonumenten opgenomen stedenbouwkundig complex dat wel 'het kerkdorp' wordt…

facts.text: Artist Leo Stracké created the cave containing the statue of Mary inside the prayer chapel.
facts.sourceQuote: De grot met het Mariabeeld zijn ontworpen door kunstenaar Leo Stracké (1851-1923).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The cave with the Mary statue was designed by artist Leo Stracké (1851-1923).

facts.text: A faithful one-to-thirteen scale copy of the French grotto stands behind the altar.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kapelgedeelte achter het altaar herbergt een getrouwe kopie op een schaal van 1:13 van de grot bij Lourdes in Zuid-Frankrijk waar Maria, de moeder van Jezus, in 1858 aan Bernadette Soubirous zou zijn verschenen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The chapel section behind the altar houses a faithful copy at a scale of 1:13 of the grotto in Lourdes, southern France, where Mary, the mother of Jesus, is said to have appeared to Bernadette Soubirous in 1858.

features.name: Willibrorduskapel
features.opening: De Willibrorduskapel is een katholieke kapel in Den Haag, gelegen op de eerste verdieping van het Willibrordushuis aan de Oude Molstraat 35.

facts.text: The chapel was built in 1928 using the distinctive Delft School architectural style.
facts.sourceQuote: De kapel is een gemeentelijk monument en werd in 1928 gebouwd in de stijl van de Delftse School, naar ontwerp van de Haagse architect Jos Duynstee, voor de Zusters van Liefde uit Tilburg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The chapel is a municipal monument and was built in 1928 in the style of the Delft School, designed by the Hague architect Jos Duynstee, for the Sisters of Love from Tilburg.

facts.text: Hague architect Jos Duynstee designed this structure specifically for the Sisters of Love from Tilburg.
facts.sourceQuote: De kapel is een gemeentelijk monument en werd in 1928 gebouwd in de stijl van de Delftse School, naar ontwerp van de Haagse architect Jos Duynstee, voor de Zusters van Liefde uit Tilburg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The chapel is a municipal monument and was built in 1928 in the style of the Delft School, designed by the Hague architect Jos Duynstee, for the Sisters of Love from Tilburg.

facts.text: A wooden gable with a finial crowns the chapel's saddle roof.
facts.sourceQuote: Het zadeldak wordt bekroond door een houten dakruiter met spits.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The saddle roof is crowned by a wooden gable with finial.

facts.text: The facade features a rose window above a stone-carved image of Saint Willibrordus.
facts.sourceQuote: Bovenin bevindt zich een roosvenster, daaronder een in natuursteen gehouwen beeld van de heilige Willibrordus, en op de begane grond drie vensters met zandstenen hoekblokken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the top is a rose window, below it a stone-carved image of the saint Willibrordus, and on the ground floor three windows with sandstone corner blocks.

facts.text: Three ground-floor windows are framed by distinctive sandstone corner blocks.
facts.sourceQuote: Bovenin bevindt zich een roosvenster, daaronder een in natuursteen gehouwen beeld van de heilige Willibrordus, en op de begane grond drie vensters met zandstenen hoekblokken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the top is a rose window, below it a stone-carved image of the saint Willibrordus, and on the ground floor three windows with sandstone corner blocks.

features.name: H. Teresia van Avila
features.opening: De Teresia van Avilakerk, ook Kerk van de Heilige Teresia van Avila genoemd, is een rooms-katholieke kerk uit 1841 die zich bevindt in het voormalige…

facts.text: Polish Eucharistic celebrations are held here on Sundays while Dutch services stopped.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk wordt vanwege het gestaag afnemende kerkbezoek niet meer zondags gebruikt voor eucharistievieringen in het Nederlands. Wel vinden er op zondag Poolse eucharistievieringen plaats.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Due to the steadily declining church attendance, the church is no longer used on Sundays for Eucharistic celebrations in Dutch. However, Polish Eucharistic celebrations take place on Sunday.

facts.text: The chapel reopened in 1816 after being closed for religious services since Spain sold the residence in 1811.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1811 verkocht Spanje de residentie en de kapel waarna deze voor erediensten werd gesloten. Op aandingen van gelovigen heropende de kapel in 1816.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1811, Spain sold the residence and chapel, after which it was closed for religious services. At the urging of believers, the chapel reopened in 1816.

facts.text: Friars replaced the Jesuits as priests in the chapel following the abolition of the order in Spain in 1766.
facts.sourceQuote: Nadat Karel III van Spanje in 1766 de orde van de jezuïeten afschafte in Spanje, namen in de Spaanse kapel priesters van de minderbroeders hun plaats in.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After Charles III of Spain abolished the order of the Jesuits in Spain in 1766, priests of the friars took their place in the Spanish chapel.

features.name: Omniversum
features.opening: Omniversum is een grootbeeld filmtheater in het westen van de wijk Zorgvliet in Den Haag.

facts.text: The name Omniversum blends 'Omnimax' and 'Universum', referencing the dome projection system and astronomy.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam Omniversum is samengesteld uit 'Omnimax' en 'Universum'. Omnimax is de oorspronkelijke naam van het gebruikte filmprojectiesysteem, dat later is omgedoopt naar IMAX Dome. Universum herinnert aan de sterrenkundige kant van de programma's die vroeger vertoond werden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name Omniversum is composed of 'Omnimax' and 'Universum'. Omnimax is the original name of the used film projection system, which was later renamed IMAX Dome. Universum reminds us of the astronomical side of the programs that used to be shown.

features.name: Haags Historisch Museum
features.opening: The Haags Historisch Museum is a museum situated on the Korte Vijverberg in The Hague, Netherlands, dedicated to the history of the city.

facts.text: The collection became The Hague's first museum when it moved to a Beestenmarkt house in 1871.
facts.sourceQuote: The collection was transferred to a house on the Beestenmarkt in 1871, where nineteenth-century art was shown; this became the first museum in The Hague.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The collection was transferred to a house on the Beestenmarkt in 1871, where nineteenth-century art was shown; this became the first museum in The Hague.

facts.text: In 1912, the art and historical collections were split, leaving the guild house with a distinct historical focus.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1912, the art and historical collection are split up, leaving a distinctive historical character to the museum in the guild house.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1912, the art and historical collection are split up, leaving a distinctive historical character to the museum in the guild house.

facts.text: Members of the Saint Sebastian guild are depicted within the museum's collections.
facts.sourceQuote: In the seventeenth century, this guild house was the home of the civilian militia of Saint Sebastian, whose members are depicted in some of the museum collections.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the seventeenth century, this guild house was the home of the civilian militia of Saint Sebastian, whose members are depicted in some of the museum collections.

features.name: Het Nutshuis
features.opening: Het Nutshuis is het voormalige hoofdkantoor van de Haagse Nutsspaarbank.

facts.text: Visitors can hear the Great Church carillon from a listening spot on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays at noon.
facts.sourceQuote: Hier is ook een luisterplaats te vinden waar op maandag, woensdag en vrijdag tussen 12:00 uur en 13:00 uur naar het carillon van de Grote Kerk kan worden geluisterd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Here you can also find a listening place where on Monday, Wednesday and Friday between 12:00 pm and 1:00 pm you can listen to the carillon of the Great Church.

facts.text: The bank's own building stood for only a decade before demolition.
facts.sourceQuote: Hierdoor moesten huizen en gebouwen gesloopt worden, waaronder het tien jaar oude pand van de Nutsspaarbank.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: As a result, houses and buildings had to be demolished, including the ten-year-old building of the Nutsspaarbank.

facts.text: A ten-year-old structure was torn down to widen a street and create a square.
facts.sourceQuote: Het moest gesloopt worden omdat de gemeente Den Haag de Jan Hendrikstraat wilde verbreden. Bovendien was de gemeente van plan een plein te bouwen bij het Westeinde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It had to be demolished because the municipality of The Hague wanted to widen Jan Hendrikstraat. In addition, the municipality was planning to build a square near the Westeinde.

features.name: Long Walk to Freedom
features.opening: Long Walk to Freedom is een standbeeld in Den Haag.

facts.text: The bronze statue was sculpted by artist Arie Schippers.
facts.sourceQuote: Het bronzen standbeeld van Nelson Mandela werd gemaakt door kunstenaar Arie Schippers en het staat aan de Johan de Wittlaan in Den Haag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bronze statue of Nelson Mandela was made by artist Arie Schippers and stands on Johan de Wittlaan in The Hague.

facts.text: The sculptor studied at Rotterdam's Academy of Fine Arts and Amsterdam's Rijksakademie.
facts.sourceQuote: Schippers studeerde aan de Academie van Beeldende Kunsten (thans Willem de Kooning Academie) in Rotterdam en de Rijksakademie van Beeldende Kunsten in Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Schippers studied at the Academy of Fine Arts (now Willem de Kooning Academy) in Rotterdam and the Rijksakademie van Beeldende Kunsten in Amsterdam.

facts.text: Plaster preliminary studies of the monument were exhibited in summer 2012.
facts.sourceQuote: In de zomer van 2012 vertoonde het museum Beelden aan Zee enkele gipsen voorstudies van dit monument.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the summer of 2012, the Beelden aan Zee museum exhibited several plaster preliminary studies of this monument.

features.name: Maranathakerk
features.opening: De Maranathakerk is een Nederlandse Hervormde Kerk aan de Tweede Sweelinckstraat in Den Haag.

facts.text: Construction began in 1949 on land cleared by wartime demolition work.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk werd in 1949 gebouwd op een terrein dat braak lag door afbraakwerkzaamheden voor de Atlantikwall, een verdedigingswerk van de Duitsers tegen mogelijke geallieerde aanvallen in de Tweede Wereldoorlog.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was built in 1949 on a site that was vacant due to demolition work for the Atlantikwall, a German defensive work against possible Allied attacks during World War II.

features.name: Van Karnebeekbron
features.opening: De Van Karnebeekbron is een zandstenen monument dat de Carnegie Stichting en de opening van het Vredespaleis in Den Haag op 28 augustus 1913 herdenkt.

facts.text: Spring water flows from a lion's head set in the center of the curved middle section.
facts.sourceQuote: Het gebogen middendeel is hoger dan de twee zijdelen en heeft in het midden een leeuwenkop waar bronwater uit komt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The curved middle part is higher than the two sides and has a lion's head in the middle where spring water comes out.

features.name: Literatuurmuseum
features.opening: Het Literatuurmuseum, gevestigd in het Koninklijke Bibliotheek-complex in Den Haag, is gewijd aan auteurs uit het Nederlandstalige gebied vanaf 1750.

facts.text: Medieval poetess Hadewych appears in the Pantheon despite the boundary starting after 1750.
facts.sourceQuote: De begingrens is hier overigens niet het jaar 1750: ook de middeleeuwse dichteres Hadewych komt erin voor.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: By the way, the boundary of the beginning is not the year 1750 here: the medieval poetess Hadewych also appears in it.

features.name: Fotomuseum Den Haag
features.opening: The Fotomuseum Den Haag (The Hague Museum of Photography) is a photography museum in The Hague.

facts.text: The institution opened its doors in 2002 after splitting from the Kunstmuseum Den Haag.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum was founded in 2002. It was a spin-off of the nearby Kunstmuseum Den Haag, when then director Wim van Krimpen decided that the Kunstmuseum's collection of photography had become so rich that it deserved a separate location.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was founded in 2002. It was a spin-off of the nearby Kunstmuseum Den Haag, when then director Wim van Krimpen decided that the Kunstmuseum's collection of photography had become so rich that it deserved a separate location.

facts.text: Visitors enter through a shared space with the contemporary art museum KM21.
facts.sourceQuote: It shares an entrance and space with the museum of contemporary art KM21.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It shares an entrance and space with the museum of contemporary art KM21.

facts.text: A 2016 expansion increased the gallery space from 400 to 1,000 square meters.
facts.sourceQuote: The Foto Museum was expanded from 400 to 1,000 square meters in 2016, taking over more space from the then-called GEM for contemporary art museum, also located in the building.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Foto Museum was expanded from 400 to 1,000 square meters in 2016, taking over more space from the then-called GEM for contemporary art museum, also located in the building.

features.name: Mauritshuis
features.opening: The Mauritshuis (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈmʌurɪtsˌɦœys]; The Hague dialect: [ˈmɑːʁɪtsˌɦœːs]; lit.

facts.text: Prince John Maurice of Nassau-Siegen commissioned the palace while governing Dutch Brazil.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1631, John Maurice, Prince of Nassau-Siegen, a cousin of Stadtholder Frederick Henry, bought a plot bordering the Binnenhof and the adjacent Hofvijver pond in The Hague, at that time the political centre of the Dutch Republic. Between 1636 and 1641, the Mauritshuis was built on this piece of land during John Maurice's governorship of Dutch Brazil.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1631, John Maurice, Prince of Nassau-Siegen, a cousin of Stadtholder Frederick Henry, bought a plot bordering the Binnenhof and the adjacent Hofvijver pond in The Hague, at that time the political centre of the Dutch Republic. Between 1636 and 1641, the Mauritshuis was built on this piece of land during John Maurice's governorship of Dutch Brazil.

facts.text: Architects Jacob van Campen and Pieter Post designed this strictly symmetrical Dutch Classicist structure.
facts.sourceQuote: It was built in the Dutch Classicist style by the Dutch architects Jacob van Campen and Pieter Post. The two-storey building is strictly symmetrical; originally the interior contained four apartments and a great hall.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was built in the Dutch Classicist style by the Dutch architects Jacob van Campen and Pieter Post. The two-storey building is strictly symmetrical; originally the interior contained four apartments and a great hall.

facts.text: During Nazi occupation, people evading slave labor hid in the attic and basement near enemy offices.
facts.sourceQuote: During the Nazi occupation of the Netherlands from 1940 to 1945, the Mauritshuis, despite being a prominent landmark and even occupied by the Nazis, was somehow able to serve as a hideout for people in the area who were evading Nazi slave labour, with people hiding in the building's attic and basement despite being close to Nazi offices in the building.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the Nazi occupation of the Netherlands from 1940 to 1945, the Mauritshuis, despite being a prominent landmark and even occupied by the Nazis, was somehow able to serve as a hideout for people in the area who were evading Nazi slave labour, with people hiding in the building's attic and basement despite being close to Nazi offices in the building.

facts.text: The name Mauritshuis means 'Maurice House' in Dutch.
facts.sourceQuote: The Mauritshuis (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈmʌurɪtsˌɦœys]; The Hague dialect: [ˈmɑːʁɪtsˌɦœːs]; lit. 'Maurice House') is an art museum in The Hague, Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Mauritshuis (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈmʌurɪtsˌɦœys]; The Hague dialect: [ˈmɑːʁɪtsˌɦœːs]; lit. 'Maurice House') is an art museum in The Hague, Netherlands.

facts.text: Count John Maurice of Nassau originally lived in this seventeenth-century residence.
facts.sourceQuote: Originally, the 17th-century building was the residence of Count (later Prince) John Maurice of Nassau.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Originally, the 17th-century building was the residence of Count (later Prince) John Maurice of Nassau.

features.name: Landgoed Ockenburgh
features.opening: Landgoed Ockenburgh is a former estate with a house in the municipality of The Hague.

facts.text: In 1944, a V2 rocket base was established here to fire at London and Antwerp.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1944 werd op het landgoed een basis voor V2-raketten ingericht. Deze werden vooral afgeschoten op Londen en Antwerpen, waar ze veel schade veroorzaakten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1944, a base for V2 rockets was set up on the estate. These were mainly fired at London and Antwerp, where they caused a lot of damage.

facts.text: During World War I, the estate housed 1500 interned Belgian military personnel.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de Eerste Wereldoorlog waren 1500 Belgische militairen geïnterneerd op het landgoed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During World War I, 1500 Belgian military personnel were interned on the estate.

facts.text: From 1938, Jewish children fleeing Germany and Austria found refuge on this estate.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf 1938 werden uit Duitsland en Oostenrijk gevluchte Joodse kinderen op het landgoed gehuisvest.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1938, Jewish children fleeing from Germany and Austria were housed on the estate.

facts.text: Fierce fighting occurred over the airfield during the German attack in 1940.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de Duitse aanval op Nederland in 1940 is zwaar gevochten om het vliegveld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the German attack on the Netherlands in 1940, fierce fighting took place over the airfield.

facts.text: The estate became part of the protected natural monument Solleveld in 1990.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 1990 maakt het landgoed deel uit van het beschermd natuurmonument Solleveld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1990, the estate has been part of the protected natural monument Solleveld.

features.name: Sint Hubertuspark
features.opening: } The Sint Hubertuspark is a park in The Hague with an area of 17.7 ha.

facts.text: A Blue Tram line operated along the park's edge from 1924 until 1957.
facts.sourceQuote: Langs het park en een stukje van de Kwekerijweg reed tussen 1924 & 1957 de Blauwe Tram.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Along the park and a section of Kwekerijweg, the Blue Tram ran between 1924 & 1957.

facts.text: Cyclists are forbidden to ride on the Park Route section passing through this specific park.
facts.sourceQuote: Hoewel de Parkenroute door het Hubertuspark loopt, mag er op dat deel van de fietsroute niet gefietst worden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Although the Park Route runs through Hubertuspark, cycling is not allowed on that part of the cycling route.

facts.text: Before 1924, a steam tram ran nearby even though Sint Hubertuspark did not yet exist.
facts.sourceQuote: Voor 1924 reed de stoomtram daar al, maar toen was het Hubertuspark er nog niet.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Before 1924, the steam tram already ran there, but Hubertuspark was not yet there.

facts.text: A game warden resided in Villa Switzerland on Kwekerijweg during the nineteenth century.
facts.sourceQuote: In de negentiende eeuw woonde de jachtopziener in 'Villa Zwitserland' aan de Kwekerijweg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the nineteenth century, the game warden lived in 'Villa Switzerland' on Kwekerijweg.

facts.text: From 1880 until 1923, the site served as a training ground for artillery and gunpowder tests.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1880 gaf de gemeente toestemming om het terrein te gebruiken voor buskruitproeven en als oefenterrein voor de artillerie. Dit duurde tot 1923.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1880, the municipality gave permission to use the site for gunpowder tests and as a training ground for the artillery. This lasted until 1923.

features.name: Westbroekpark
features.opening: The Westbroekpark is a park and district with an area of 18 hectares, located in The Hague, between Madurodam and Scheveningen.

facts.text: The Nieuwe Park was renamed Westbroekpark in 1926 to honor its designer who died the previous year.
facts.sourceQuote: Dit plan voor het "Nieuwe Park" werd in 1925 voltooid. Westbroek overleed in 1926; ter nagedachtenis aan hem werd het Nieuwe Park in 1926 officieel Westbroekpark genoemd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This plan for the "New Park" was completed in 1925. Westbroek died in 1926; in memory of him, the Nieuwe Park was officially renamed Westbroekpark in 1926.

facts.text: During World War I, the site served as an internment camp for British soldiers crossing from Belgium.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de Eerste Wereldoorlog werd het terrein gebruikt als interneringskamp voor Britse militairen die vanuit België de Nederlandse grens waren overgestoken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During World War I, the site was used as an internment camp for British military personnel who had crossed the Dutch border from Belgium.

facts.text: German bunkers constructed during the war still stand within the park today.
facts.sourceQuote: In de oorlog bouwden de Duitsers twee bunkers in het park, die nog bestaan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the war, the Germans built two bunkers in the park, which still exist.

features.name: Zuiderpark
features.opening: Zuiderpark is a city park in The Hague and also forms one of the districts of the city.

facts.text: Until mid-2007, the site hosted the Zuiderpark Stadium, home to football club fc/ADO The Hague.
facts.sourceQuote: In het park bevond zich tot medio 2007 het Zuiderparkstadion, de thuishaven van voetbalclub fc/ADO Den Haag, inmiddels gehuisvest in een nieuw stadion in het Forepark (Bingoal Stadion).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until mid-2007, the Zuiderpark Stadium was located in the park, the home ground of football club fc/ADO The Hague, which has since been housed in a new stadium in the Forepark (Bingoal Stadium).

features.name: Koekamp
features.opening: The Koekamp, sometimes referred to as the Koekamp, is a park and deer reserve in The Hague that historically forms part of the Hague Forest, which consists of…

facts.text: The oldest known mention of Koekamp dates to the year 1316.
facts.sourceQuote: De oudste vermelding van de Koekamp dateert uit 1316.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The oldest mention of the Koekamp dates back to 1316.

facts.text: Garden architect Jan D. Zocher jr. transformed the area into an English garden in the 19th century.
facts.sourceQuote: In de 19e eeuw heeft de tuin- en landschapsarchitect Jan D. Zocher jr. de Koekamp veranderd in een Engelse tuin.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 19th century, the garden and landscape architect Jan D. Zocher jr. transformed the Koekamp into an English garden.

facts.text: During the 1940 invasion, Dutch radar equipment was stationed here to eavesdrop on German aircraft.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 10 mei 1940, bij de Duitse inval, stonden bij het hertenkamp enkele mitrailleurs en een van het Meetgebouw te Waalsdorp afkomstig elektrisch luistertoestel (Nederlandse radar). Met het luistertoestel werden Duitse vliegtuigen gepeild.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On May 10, 1940, during the German invasion, several machine guns and an electrical listening device (Dutch radar) from the Meetgebouw in Waalsdorp were stationed at the deer camp. The listening device was used to eavesdrop on German aircraft.

facts.text: The name Koekamp likely means 'cattle field' but once referred to a deer warren.
facts.sourceQuote: De suffix -kamp verwijst naar een veld, kennelijk met runderen, maar in de zeventiende eeuw werd genoteerd dat er veel herten waren, wat overeenkomt met een functie als warande.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The suffix -kamp refers to a field, apparently with cattle, but in the seventeenth century it was noted that there were many deer, which corresponds to a function as a warren.

facts.text: A bicycle path here bears the unusual name Laan van Reagan en Gorbatsjov since 2015.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de centrumzijde van de Koekamp bevindt zich een fietspad dat sinds 2015 de naam Laan van Reagan en Gorbatsjov draagt, verwijzend naar de presidenten die in de jaren tachtig het einde van de Koude Oorlog inleidden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the center side of the Koekamp there is a bicycle path that has been called Laan van Reagan en Gorbatsjov since 2015, referring to the presidents who ushered in the end of the Cold War in the 1980s.

features.name: Scheveningse Bosjes
features.opening: The Scheveningse Bosjes is an original dune area and now a park in the Scheveningen district.

facts.text: Centuries of overgrazing and wood theft kept the dunes unplanted until the landscape finally stabilized.
facts.sourceQuote: Eeuwenlang bleven de gronden onbebost door overbeweiding, houtroof en verstuivingen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For centuries, the lands remained unplanted due to overgrazing, wood theft and dust storms.

facts.text: Jacob Cats built his country house Sorghvliet in the dunes and moved in on July 14, 1652.
facts.sourceQuote: In het midden van de 17de eeuw liet Jacob Cats een buitenplaats bouwen in de duinen, die hij Sorghvliet noemde en die hij op 14 juli 1652 betrok.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the middle of the 17th century, Jacob Cats had a country house built in the dunes, which he called Sorghvliet and which he moved into on July 14, 1652.

facts.text: Between 1892 and 1895, the Nieuwe Scheveningse Bosjes were created as a job project for the unemployed.
facts.sourceQuote: Tussen 1892 en 1895 werden de Nieuwe Scheveningse Bosjes aangelegd als werkverschaffingsproject voor werklozen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Between 1892 and 1895, the Nieuwe Scheveningse Bosjes were built as a job creation project for the unemployed.

features.name: Westduinpark & Wapendal
features.opening: Wapendal is a nature reserve in The Hague that together with the Westduinpark and the Bosjes van Poot forms a Natura 2000 area.

facts.text: Wapendal derives from 'wapel', an old term for low-lying humid grazing land.
facts.sourceQuote: Wapendal is genoemd naar een oude benaming voor een laaggelegen vochtige plek, wapel, waar boeren hun vee lieten grazen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Wapendal is named after an old name for a low-lying humid place, wapel, where farmers let their livestock graze.

facts.text: Shetland ponies graze here to preserve the original dune vegetation.
facts.sourceQuote: Beheersmaatregelen zoals plaggen, het selectief verwijderen van bomen en begrazing door Shetlandpony's moeten ervoor zorgen dat de oorspronkelijke duinbegroeiing behouden blijft.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Management measures such as clipping, selective removal of trees and grazing by Shetland ponies should ensure that the original dune vegetation is preserved.

features.name: Javabosje
features.opening: Landgoed Roosendoorn was a small estate just outside the Hague canal belt in the 17th century.

facts.text: The estate once held two houses named De Roos and De Doorn, neither of which survives today.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het landgoed stonden twee huizen, De Roos en De Doorn. Beide bestaan niet meer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There were two houses on the estate, De Roos and De Doorn. Neither exists anymore.

features.name: Landgoed Duinweide
features.opening: Duinweide was a country house in The Hague, located on the site of the current Archipelbuurt.

facts.text: The estate began as a farmer's farm first recorded in 1561.
facts.sourceQuote: De buitenplaats kwam voort uit een boerenhoeve, die in 1561 voor het eerst genoemd werd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The estate originated from a farmer's farm, which was first mentioned in 1561.

facts.text: Jacob Cats owned the property known as Duinhoeve from 1644 until his heirs sold it in 1655.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1644 kwam Duinhoeve in het bezit van Jacob Cats, wiens erfgenamen het in 1655 weer verkochten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1644 Duinhoeve came into the possession of Jacob Cats, whose heirs sold it again in 1655.

facts.text: Two buildings in the Archipelbuurt retain the name Villa Duinweide or display a Duinweide nameplate.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam van de buitenplaats keert terug in twee panden in de Archipelbuurt: Bankaplein 4-5 heet Villa Duinweide en aan de Riouwstraat staat de naam Duinweide op een naamplaat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name of the country house returns in two buildings in the Archipelbuurt: Bankaplein 4-5 is called Villa Duinweide and on Riouwstraat the name Duinweide is on a nameplate.

features.name: Haagse Bos
features.opening: Haagse Bos (Dutch pronunciation: [ˌɦaːxsə ˈbɔs]; lit.

facts.text: William the Silent's 1576 Act of Redemption legally banned all future cutting or sale of the forest.
facts.sourceQuote: The so-called "Act of Redemption", signed on 1576 by William the Silent declared that no further cutting or sale of the forest would be permitted. This law still stands today.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The so-called "Act of Redemption", signed on 1576 by William the Silent declared that no further cutting or sale of the forest would be permitted. This law still stands today.

facts.text: During WWII, German forces used the forest to launch V-1 and V-2 rockets.
facts.sourceQuote: During World War II, the park was used by the Germans for launching V-1 and V-2 rockets.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During World War II, the park was used by the Germans for launching V-1 and V-2 rockets.

features.name: Landgoed Oostduin en Arendsdorp
features.opening: Arendsdorp is the remains of an old estate and a country house, located in the Rijksbeschermd stadsgezicht Benoordenhout in The Hague.

facts.text: The Van Bylandthuis office building opposite the Haagse Bos was renovated in 1999.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de Benoordenhoutseweg staat het 'Van Bylandthuis'; dit kantoorgebouw staat tegenover het Haagse Bos en is in 1999 gerenoveerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The 'Van Bylandthuis' is located on Benoordenhoutseweg; this office building is opposite the Haagse Bos and was renovated in 1999.

facts.text: Later occupants included the Ministry of the Interior and Security's Royal Training Institute.
facts.sourceQuote: Daarna heeft het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken er een Rijksopleidingsinstituut in onderbracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After that, the Ministry of the Interior and Security housed a Royal Training Institute there.

facts.text: Sir Arend van Dorp purchased the original farmstead in 1586 and moved into its main house.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1586 kocht jonkheer Arend van Dorp een stuk land met een boerenhoeve. Hij ging in het voorhuis wonen van de boerderij, de rest werd verpacht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1586, Sir Arend van Dorp bought a piece of land with a farmstead. He moved into the main house of the farm, the rest was rented out.

facts.text: An eight-sided pavilion built around 1650 has been called the 'dome' since the twentieth century.
facts.sourceQuote: Rond 1650 werd een apart paviljoen gebouwd, dat als buitenverblijf ging dienen. Dit achtkantige paviljoen van twee lagen onder een door pannen afgedekt tentdak, wordt sinds de twintigste eeuw de 'koepel' genoemd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Around 1650, a separate pavilion was built, which was to serve as an outbuilding. This eight-sided pavilion of two floors under a tiled tent roof has been called the 'dome' since the twentieth century.

facts.text: The estate Oostduin was only named as such in 1810, though it had been built in 1560.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1845 werd Arendsdorp met het ernaast gelegen Oostduin verenigd. Oostduin was in 1560 al aangelegd, maar werd pas in 1810 'Oostduin' genoemd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1845, Arendsdorp was merged with the adjacent Oostduin. Oostduin had already been built in 1560, but was only named 'Oostduin' in 1810.

features.name: Park Sorghvliet
features.opening: Zorgvliet is a district and estate northwest of the center of The Hague.

facts.text: Part of the district was demolished in 1942-1943 to build the Atlantic Wall.
facts.sourceQuote: De groene villawijk werd gebouwd in de jaren 1910-1919 en tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog, in 1942-1943, voor een deel gesloopt ten behoeve van de aanleg van de Atlantikwall.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The green villa district was built in the 1910s-1919 and during World War II, in 1942-1943, part of it was demolished for the construction of the Atlantic Wall.

facts.text: Johan de Wittlaan features high buildings constructed along the former tank ditch course.
facts.sourceQuote: In het wederopbouwplan van Dudok keerden de villa's niet terug, maar werd over het tracé van de tankgracht de Johan de Wittlaan met hoogbouw aangelegd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In Dudok's reconstruction plan, the villas did not return, but the Johan de Wittlaan with high buildings was built along the course of the tank ditch.

facts.text: The name Sorghvliet suggests letting worries fly away.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam duidt op "je zorgen laten vlieden", oftewel je zorgen vergeten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name indicates "letting your worries fly away", or forgetting your worries.

facts.text: Poet and statesman Jacob Cats built the estate around 1643.
facts.sourceQuote: Zorgvliet of Sorghvliet werd rond 1643 als landgoed aangelegd door dichter en staatsman Jacob Cats.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Zorgvliet or Sorghvliet was built around 1643 as a country estate by poet and statesman Jacob Cats.
