features.opening: Malieveld (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈmaːlivɛlt] , lit.

facts.text: A 1998 Rolling Stones concert drew 86,000 fans in the rain, setting a record for ticketed shows in the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuote: On 5 September 1998, The Rolling Stones performed at the Malieveld to celebrate the 750th anniversary of The Hague, which was established in 1248. Despite the rain, it was attended by 86,000 people and became the largest ticketed concert in the history of the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On 5 September 1998, The Rolling Stones performed at the Malieveld to celebrate the 750th anniversary of The Hague, which was established in 1248. Despite the rain, it was attended by 86,000 people and became the largest ticketed concert in the history of the Netherlands.

facts.text: Singer Anouk married her husband during a 2022 Malieveld performance attended by over 40,000 people.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2022, Anouk married her husband Dominique Schemmekes at the Malieveld during her concert there, attended by over 40,000 people.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2022, Anouk married her husband Dominique Schemmekes at the Malieveld during her concert there, attended by over 40,000 people.

features.name: Meijendel
features.opening: Meijendel is an extensive water-rich dune and nature area west of southern Wassenaar and north of The Hague (Scheveningen).

facts.text: Between 250 and 280 Dutch people were executed here by German occupiers during World War II.
facts.sourceQuote: In het zuiden van Meijendel ligt de Waalsdorpervlakte waar in de Tweede Wereldoorlog tussen de 250 en 280 Nederlanders door de Duitse bezetters zijn geëxecuteerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the south of Meijendel lies the Waalsdorpervlakte where between 250 and 280 Dutch people were executed by the German occupiers during World War II.

facts.text: The memorial features a stone with four bronze crosses behind it and a bell tower in the background.
facts.sourceQuote: Het bestaat uit een steen met daarachter vier bronzen kruisen; op de achtergrond staat een klokkenstoel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It consists of a stone with four bronze crosses behind it; in the background stands a bell tower.

features.name: Algemene Begraafplaats
features.opening: The Algemene Begraafplaats on the Kerkhoflaan is a 19th-century cemetery in the Archipelbuurt district in The Hague, on the edge of the Scheveningen Woods.

facts.text: Swiss commander Nicholas Emanuel Frederick von Gumoëns died from injuries sustained defending Antwerp in 1832.
facts.sourceQuote: Tiendaagse Veldtocht Een monumentale obelisk uit 1832 gedenkt de Zwitserse opperbevelhebber Nicolaas Emanuel Frederik von Gumoëns, die vrijwillig tijdens de Tiendaagse Veldtocht betrokken was bij de verdediging van Antwerpen. Hij overleed later aan zijn verwondingen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Ten-Day Campaign A monumental obelisk from 1832 commemorates the Swiss Supreme Commander Nicholas Emanuel Frederick von Gumoëns, who volunteered during the Ten-Day Campaign to participate in the defense of Antwerp. He later died from his injuries.

facts.text: The Military Honor Square features a triptych of natural stone sculptures engraved with the names of 167 fallen soldiers.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Militair erehof Den Haag Kerkhoflaan gedenkt 167 militaire slachtoffers, gevallen tijdens de Slag om Den Haag in mei 1940. Het monument staat in het lage deel van de begraafplaats en bestaat uit een drieluik van natuursteen met sculpturen en teksten, waarop hun namen staan ingegraveerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Military Honor Square The Hague Kerkhoflaan commemorates 167 military victims, fallen during the Battle of The Hague in May 1940. The monument is located in the lower part of the cemetery and consists of a triptych of natural stone with sculptures and texts, on which their names are engraved.

facts.text: City architect Zeger Reyers designed the new cemetery on Kerkhoflaan.
facts.sourceQuote: De nieuwe begraafplaats aan de Kerkhoflaan werd ontworpen door de stadsarchitect Zeger Reyers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The new cemetery on Kerkhoflaan was designed by the city architect Zeger Reyers.

features.name: Dr. Abraham Schierbeek Tuin
features.opening: The Dr.

facts.text: Despite being only one hectare, the park hosts wood owls and hedge pigeons among its thorny shrubs.
facts.sourceQuote: Hoewel het een terrein is van slechts bijna een ha, is het door de begroeiing een paradijs voor vogels zoals de bosuil, sperwer, heggenmus, roodborst, winterkoning en merel.Er zijn veel besdragende struiken zoals meidoorn, braam en hulst.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Although it is a site of only almost one hectare, it is a paradise for birds such as the wood owl, sparrowhawk, hedge pigeon, red breast, winter king and thrush due to the vegetation. There are many thorny shrubs such as hawthorn, bramble and holly.

features.name: Bosje van Repelaer
features.opening: Landgoed Roosendoorn was a small estate just outside the Hague canal belt in the 17th century.

facts.text: The estate once held two houses named De Roos and De Doorn, neither of which survives today.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het landgoed stonden twee huizen, De Roos en De Doorn. Beide bestaan niet meer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There were two houses on the estate, De Roos and De Doorn. Neither exists anymore.

features.name: Nieuwe Scheveningsche Bosjes
features.opening: The Nieuwe Scheveningse Bosjes in The Hague were built at the end of the 19th century for the purpose of employment.

facts.text: During WWII, Germans sharpened pine trees to create anti-paratrooper obstacles in the meadows.
facts.sourceQuote: De Duitsers haalden wel dennen uit het bos om ze te gebruiken om parachutisten af te weren. Er werden scherpe punten aan gemaakt, waarna ze in weilanden werden geprikt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Germans did cut down pine trees from the forest to use them to repel paratroopers. Sharp points were made to them, after which they were pierced into meadows.

features.name: Landgoed Clingendael
features.opening: Clingendael is the name of a 17th-century manor house and surrounding parkland just outside The Hague, Netherlands, in the municipality of Wassenaar.

facts.text: Landgoed Clingendael means valley in the dunes.
facts.sourceQuote: The name Clingendael means valley in the dunes.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name Clingendael means valley in the dunes.

facts.text: Lady Daisy, an unmarried daughter, laid out the estate's Japanese garden.
facts.sourceQuote: Arnout’s unmarried daughter Marguérite, known as Lady Daisy, laid out Clingendael’s fine Japanese garden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Arnout’s unmarried daughter Marguérite, known as Lady Daisy, laid out Clingendael’s fine Japanese garden.

facts.text: During WWII, Nazis occupied the manor with Reichskommissar Arthur Seyss-Inquart.
facts.sourceQuote: During World War II, the estate was confiscated by the Nazis and occupied by Reichskommissar Arthur Seyss-Inquart.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During World War II, the estate was confiscated by the Nazis and occupied by Reichskommissar Arthur Seyss-Inquart.

features.name: Landgoed Oosterbeek
features.opening: Oosterbeek is a estate on the territory of the municipality of Wassenaar, it has been owned by the municipality of The Hague since 1953.

facts.text: German forces seized its film studios to produce propaganda before British bombers destroyed them.
facts.sourceQuote: Zijn filmstudio's op Oosterbeek werden in beslag genomen en door de Duitse filmmaatschappij U.F.A. gebruikt om propagandafilms te maken. Engelse vliegtuigen hebben de studio's gebombardeerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: His film studios on Oosterbeek were seized and used by the German film company U.F.A. to make propaganda films. British aircraft bombed the studios.

facts.text: Radio pioneer Hanso Idzerda was hanged under a beech tree on the estate during the war.
facts.sourceQuote: Radio-omroeppionier Hanso Idzerda werd tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog op landgoed Oosterbeek onder een beukenboom standrechtelijk geëxecuteerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Radio pioneer Hanso Idzerda was executed by hanging under a beech tree on Oosterbeek estate during World War II.

features.name: Haagse Markt
features.opening: De Haagse Markt or Haagse Mart is the largest market in the Netherlands, located in The Hague on the border of the Transvaal district and the Schilderswijk.

facts.text: Exotic bananas were already sold at the market by 1920.
facts.sourceQuote: Zo werden er al in 1920 exotische vruchten zoals bananen verkocht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For example, exotic fruits such as bananas were already sold in 1920.

facts.text: The current site on Herman Costerstraat opened on May 16, 1938.
facts.sourceQuote: De opening van het 2,11 hectare grote marktterrein aan de Herman Costerstraat vond plaats op 16 mei 1938.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The opening of the 2.11 hectare large market area on Herman Costerstraat took place on May 16, 1938.

facts.text: Visitors can shop here on four specific days: Monday, Wednesday, Friday, and Saturday.
facts.sourceQuote: De markt is vier dagen per week geopend: maandag, woensdag, vrijdag en zaterdag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The market is open four days a week: Monday, Wednesday, Friday and Saturday.

facts.text: Local officials claim this bustling hub ranks among the largest markets across all of Europe.
facts.sourceQuote: Volgens de gemeente is het een van de grootste markten van Europa.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: According to the municipality, it is one of the largest markets in Europe.

features.name: Hubertustunnel
features.opening: The Hubertustunnel is a tunnel for through traffic in the north of The Hague.

facts.text: The tunnel served as a filming location for an action scene in the movie Pizza Maffia.
facts.sourceQuote: Een actiescène uit de film Pizza Maffia is gedeeltelijk in deze tunnel opgenomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: An action scene from the movie Pizza Maffia was partially filmed in this tunnel.

facts.text: The tunnel's speed limit increased to 70 km/h in 2013, up from the previous 50 km/h.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 2013 is de maximumsnelheid in de tunnel 70 km/u Voorheen bedroeg de maximumsnelheid in de tunnel 50 km/u.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2013, the maximum speed in the tunnel has been 70 km/h Previously, the maximum speed in the tunnel was 50 km/h.

features.name: Kazernestraat
features.opening: The Kazernestraat is a street in the center of The Hague, which runs from Parkstraat to Denneweg.

facts.text: Since August 2021, the Dutch House of Representatives temporarily occupies a former barracks office here.
facts.sourceQuote: De achteruitgang van deze kazerne was waar later op Kazernestraat 52 de Hoge Raad der Nederlanden zijn kantoor had. Sinds 23 augustus 2021 is in dat kantoorgebouw tijdelijk de Eerste Kamer gezeteld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The decline of this barracks was where later on Kazernestraat 52 the High Council of the Netherlands had its office. Since August 23, 2021, the House of Representatives has been temporarily housed in that office building.

facts.text: Bibliotheekstraat is only 7 meters long and 2 meters wide.
facts.sourceQuote: Dan is even verderop links een kort, breed, doodlopend zijstraatje, de Bibliotheekstraat, tevens de kortste straat van Den Haag. Deze kortste straat is maar 7 meter lang en 2 meter breed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Then just further up on the left is a short, wide, dead-end side street, the Bibliotheekstraat, also the shortest street in The Hague. This shortest street is only 7 meters long and 2 meters wide.

features.name: Amsterdamse Veerkade
features.opening: The Amsterdamse Veerkade is now a street in The Hague that runs between the Spui and the Stille Veerkade.

facts.text: The canal was once known as Rotterdamse Veerkade because the tugboat to Rotterdam departed from here.
facts.sourceQuote: In de loop van de eeuwen veranderde de naam van de gracht herhaaldelijk van onofficiële naam – officiële straatnaambordjes en naamgeving zoals we in de 21e eeuw toepassen, bestonden nog niet – en zo werden benamingen als Eerste, Tweede en Derde Veerkade en Rotterdamse Veerkade (omdat de trekschuit naar Rotterdam er toen vertrok) gehanteerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Over the centuries, the name of the canal changed repeatedly from unofficial name - official street signs and naming as we apply them in the 21st century did not yet exist - and so names such as Eerste, Tweede and Derde Veerkade and Rotterdamse Veerkade (because the tugboat to Rotterdam left then) were used.

facts.text: A wide central berm replaced the water to serve as a walking path with two new rows of trees.
facts.sourceQuote: In de plaats ervoor kwam een brede middenberm die als wandelpad kon fungeren en twee rijen nieuwe boomaanplant.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In its place, a wide central berm was created that could serve as a walking path and two rows of new tree planting.

facts.text: Amsterdamse Veerkade served as a transhipment point for goods arriving by ship from Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: Ver voor die tijd was het een overslagpunt voor goederen die per schip uit Amsterdam werden aangevoerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Long before that, it was a transhipment point for goods brought in by ship from Amsterdam.

features.name: Hofvijver
features.opening: The Hofvijver (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈɦɔˌfɛivər]; English: Court Pond) is a small lake in the centre of The Hague, Netherlands.

facts.text: Willem II built his palace on a dune lake island in 1248.
facts.sourceQuote: In this dune lake there was an island (not the current island in the Hofvijver) on which Willem II built his palace in 1248.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In this dune lake there was an island (not the current island in the Hofvijver) on which Willem II built his palace in 1248.

facts.text: The pond holds roughly 32,000 cubic meters of water.
facts.sourceQuote: The Hofvijver (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈɦɔˌfɛivər]; English: Court Pond) is a small lake in the centre of The Hague, Netherlands. its water volume approximately is 32000 m³ ( 26 ac ft ) It is adjoined in the east by the Korte Vijverberg road, in the south by the Binnenhof and the Mauritshuis, in the west by the Buitenhof and in the north by the Lange Vijverberg road.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Hofvijver (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈɦɔˌfɛivər]; English: Court Pond) is a small lake in the centre of The Hague, Netherlands. its water volume approximately is 32000 m³ ( 26 ac ft ) It is adjoined in the east by the Korte Vijverberg road, in the south by the Binnenhof and the Mauritshuis, in the west by the Buitenhof and in the north by the Lange Vijverberg road.

features.name: Noord West Singelsgracht
features.opening: The Haagse grachtengordel is the (partly 16th and especially early) 17th-century Singelsgracht that is still intact.

facts.text: Unlike typical canal belts, the Singelsgracht follows an angular shape rather than a ring or circle.
facts.sourceQuote: Een gordel is ring-, of cirkelvormig, de Singelsgracht van Den Haag heeft een andere (hoekige) vorm.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A belt is ring- or circular in shape, the Singelsgracht of The Hague has a different (angular) shape.

facts.text: Some bridges were demolished to stop enemies, including the Draaibrug of Enthoven near the Noordwal.
facts.sourceQuote: Dat gold ook voor de Draaibrug van Enthoven bij de Noordwal. Andere bruggen (ook bij de Noordwal) werden gesloopt om de vijand te stoppen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: That also applied to the Draaibrug of Enthoven near the Noordwal. Other bridges (also at the North Wall) were demolished to stop the enemy.

facts.text: A major widening of the Spui occurred in 1595, transforming it into a key transport channel.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1595 werd het Spui verder verbreed. Als vanzelfsprekend werd het Spui hét transportkanaal van Den Haag en groeide de stad in die richting.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1595, the Spui was further widened. Naturally, the Spui became the transport channel of The Hague and the city grew in that direction.

features.name: Laak
features.opening: The Laak is an ancient peat river that runs through The Hague.

facts.text: The name Laak shares a linguistic connection with the river Lek.
facts.sourceQuote: Het woord heeft een samenhang met de riviernaam Lek.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The word has a connection to the river name Lek.

facts.text: Historically, water flowed through this stream to reach the Haagvliet.
facts.sourceQuote: Via de Laak werd het water afgevoerd richting de Haagvliet.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Through the Laak, the water was discharged towards the Haagvliet.

features.name: Kerstanje
features.opening: The Kerstanje or Chestnut Weir in the Dutch high authority of Delfland is a drainage and waterway connection.

facts.text: The name Kerstanje may derive from a chestnut tree, though it could also honor a person named Kerstant.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kanaal werd misschien naar een kastanjeboom genoemd. Ook bestaat de mogelijkheid dat het verwijst naar een persoonsnaam, Kerstant.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The channel may have been named after a chestnut tree. There is also the possibility that it refers to a personal name, Kerstant.

facts.text: Westlanders used barges on this channel to transport horticultural goods to markets in Leiden and Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: De Kerstanje was een belangrijke vaarverbinding van en naar het Westland. De Westlanders gebruikten de Kerstanje om met hun schuiten hun tuinbouwproducten in Leiden en Amsterdam op de markt te brengen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Kerstanje was an important waterway connection from and to the Westland. The Westlanders used the Kerstanje to market their horticultural products in Leiden and Amsterdam with their barges.

features.name: Koninginnegracht
features.opening: The Koninginnegracht is a canal and a street in The Hague.

facts.text: Romantic painter Andreas Schelfhout moved his family to number 6 in 1842.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1842 verhuisde de Romantische landschapsschilder Andreas Schelfhout (1787-1870) met zijn gezin van de Zuidwal naar Koninginnegracht 6.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1842, the Romantic landscape painter Andreas Schelfhout (1787-1870) moved with his family from the Zuidwal to Koninginnegracht 6.

facts.text: Joseph Israëls lived at number 6 before moving to number 2 just two years later.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1871 betrok Jozef Israëls (1824-1911) dezelfde Koninginnegracht 6, maar twee jaar later verhuisde hij naar nummer 2.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1871, Joseph Israëls (1824-1911) moved into the same Koninginnegracht 6, but two years later he moved to number 2.

facts.text: The route was briefly called Koninginnelaan before the canal's completion changed it to Koninginnegracht.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens het graven van de gracht sprak men over de Koninginnelaan, toen de gracht klaar was veranderde dit in Koninginnegracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the digging of the canal, they spoke about the Koninginnelaan, when the canal was finished this changed to Koninginnegracht.

facts.text: In 1890, the first electric trams in the Benelux ran here using batteries.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1890 reden hier de eerste elektrische trams in de Benelux, met accu's.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1890, the first electric trams in the Benelux ran here, with batteries.

facts.text: Before the canal existed, a path named Kemelslaan honored meadow owner Melchior Kemels.
facts.sourceQuote: Voordat de gracht gegraven werd, liep er al een sloot en een eenvoudig pad, dat de Kemelslaan werd genoemd naar de eigenaar van de aangrenzende weilanden, Melchior Kemels.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Before the canal was dug, there was already a ditch and a simple path, which was called Kemelslaan after the owner of the adjacent meadows, Melchior Kemels.

facts.text: The Hague Zoo stood on the opposite bank until it closed in 1943 due to the war.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de overkant van de Koninginnegracht lag de Haagse Dierentuin, die in 1943 moest sluiten wegens de oorlog.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the other side of the Koninginnegracht was the Hague Zoo, which had to close in 1943 due to the war.

features.name: Noord Singelsgracht
features.opening: The Haagse grachtengordel is the (partly 16th and especially early) 17th-century Singelsgracht that is still intact.

facts.text: Unlike typical canal belts, the Singelsgracht features an angular shape rather than a ring or circle.
facts.sourceQuote: Een gordel is ring-, of cirkelvormig, de Singelsgracht van Den Haag heeft een andere (hoekige) vorm.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A belt is ring- or circular in shape, the Singelsgracht of The Hague has a different (angular) shape.

facts.text: Bridges like the Draaibrug were opened or demolished to block enemy forces during wartime.
facts.sourceQuote: Dat gold ook voor de Draaibrug van Enthoven bij de Noordwal. Andere bruggen (ook bij de Noordwal) werden gesloopt om de vijand te stoppen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: That also applied to the Draaibrug of Enthoven near the Noordwal. Other bridges (also at the North Wall) were demolished to stop the enemy.

facts.text: The waterway was first widened in 1345 to connect the Vliet between Delft and Leiden.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1345 werd dit kanaal, dat de eerste Haagse gracht kan worden genoemd, verbreed en door het graven van het Zieke en in het verlengde daarvan de Haagse Trekvliet aangesloten op de Vliet die tussen Delft en Leiden loopt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1345, this canal, which can be called the first Haagse canal, was widened and connected to the Vliet that runs between Delft and Leiden by digging the Zieke and, in the extension of it, the Haagse Trekvliet.

features.name: Oost Singelsgracht
features.opening: The Haagse grachtengordel is the (partly 16th and especially early) 17th-century Singelsgracht that is still intact.

facts.text: Unlike typical canal belts, the Singelsgracht features an angular shape rather than a ring or circular form.
facts.sourceQuote: Een gordel is ring-, of cirkelvormig, de Singelsgracht van Den Haag heeft een andere (hoekige) vorm.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A belt is ring- or circular in shape, the Singelsgracht of The Hague has a different (angular) shape.

facts.text: Although never successfully besieged, the canal belt served as a defensive line in both 1672 and 1940.
facts.sourceQuote: De grachtengordel is nooit belegerd geweest maar in het rampjaar 1672 wel als verdedigingslinie gebruikt. Ook in 1940 werd het als verdedigingslinie gebruikt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The canal belt has never been besieged but in the disaster year of 1672 it was used as a defensive line. In 1940 it was also used as a defensive line.

facts.text: In 1345, the original canal was widened and linked to the Vliet river via new digging projects.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1345 werd dit kanaal, dat de eerste Haagse gracht kan worden genoemd, verbreed en door het graven van het Zieke en in het verlengde daarvan de Haagse Trekvliet aangesloten op de Vliet die tussen Delft en Leiden loopt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1345, this canal, which can be called the first Haagse canal, was widened and connected to the Vliet that runs between Delft and Leiden by digging the Zieke and, in the extension of it, the Haagse Trekvliet.

features.name: West Singelsgracht
features.opening: The Haagse grachtengordel is the (partly 16th and especially early) 17th-century Singelsgracht that is still intact.

facts.text: The canal belt including West Singelsgracht served as a defensive line during the disaster year of 1672.
facts.sourceQuote: De grachtengordel is nooit belegerd geweest maar in het rampjaar 1672 wel als verdedigingslinie gebruikt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The canal belt has never been besieged but in the disaster year of 1672 it was used as a defensive line.

facts.text: The canal was first widened in 1345 to connect to the Vliet.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1345 werd dit kanaal, dat de eerste Haagse gracht kan worden genoemd, verbreed en door het graven van het Zieke en in het verlengde daarvan de Haagse Trekvliet aangesloten op de Vliet die tussen Delft en Leiden loopt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1345, this canal, which can be called the first Haagse canal, was widened and connected to the Vliet that runs between Delft and Leiden by digging the Zieke and, in the extension of it, the Haagse Trekvliet.

features.name: Zuid Singelsgracht
features.opening: The Haagse grachtengordel is the (partly 16th and especially early) 17th-century Singelsgracht that is still intact.

facts.text: Unlike typical canal belts, the Singelsgracht follows an angular shape rather than a ring.
facts.sourceQuote: Een gordel is ring-, of cirkelvormig, de Singelsgracht van Den Haag heeft een andere (hoekige) vorm.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A belt is ring- or circular in shape, the Singelsgracht of The Hague has a different (angular) shape.

facts.text: In 1345, the original canal was widened and linked to the Vliet via the Zieke.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1345 werd dit kanaal, dat de eerste Haagse gracht kan worden genoemd, verbreed en door het graven van het Zieke en in het verlengde daarvan de Haagse Trekvliet aangesloten op de Vliet die tussen Delft en Leiden loopt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1345, this canal, which can be called the first Haagse canal, was widened and connected to the Vliet that runs between Delft and Leiden by digging the Zieke and, in the extension of it, the Haagse Trekvliet.

facts.text: Using just 'Trekvliet' is incorrect because another canal in Leiden shares that exact name.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook Haagse Vliet of Haagvliet mogen in het dagelijks verkeer worden gebruikt, maar Trekvliet alleen is fout, omdat er bij Leiden, tussen de Oude Rijn en Vliet, nog een watergang bestaat met de naam Trekvliet.

facts.text: The canal was dug between 1344 and 1345 by order of Count William IV of Holland.
facts.sourceQuote: De Haagse Trekvliet, ook bekend als Haagse Vliet, Haagvliet of Trekvliet, is een kanaal dat in 1344-1345 werd gegraven in opdracht van graaf Willem IV van Holland, als verbinding van het Haagse grachtenstelsel met de Vliet.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Haagse Trekvliet, also known as Haagse Vliet, Haagvliet or Trekvliet, is a canal that was dug in 1344-1345 at the behest of Count William IV of Holland, as a connection of the Hague canal system with the Vliet.

facts.text: Although it borders Voorburg and Rijswijk, the waterway belongs to The Hague since July 2001.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kanaal vormt praktisch gezien de grens tussen de Nederlandse steden Voorburg en Rijswijk, al behoort de Trekvliet zelf sinds de gemeentelijke herindeling van 2 juli 2001 tot het grondgebied van de gemeente Den Haag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Practically speaking, the canal forms the border between the Dutch cities Voorburg and Rijswijk, although the Trekvliet itself has been part of the territory of the municipality of The Hague since the municipal reorganization of July 2, 2001.

facts.text: Unlike typical canal belts, this waterway follows an angular shape rather than a ring.

facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A belt is ring- or circular in shape, the Singelsgracht of The Hague has a different (angular) shape.

facts.text: A major widening of the Spui occurred in 1595, transforming it into the city's main transport channel.

facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1595, the Spui was further widened. Naturally, the Spui became the transport channel of The Hague and the city grew in that direction.

features.name: Het Kanaal
features.opening: Het Kanaal (partly called Koninginnegracht) is a waterway that connects the Dutch city of The Hague and Scheveningen.

facts.text: Mayor Copes of Cattenburch initiated the digging project in 1825 to boost trade.
facts.sourceQuote: Copes van Cattenburch, sinds 1823 burgemeester van Den Haag, wilde de handel helpen en liet in 1825 een begin maken van de werkzaamheden om Het Kanaal te graven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Copes of Cattenburch, mayor of The Hague since 1823, wanted to help the trade and began work in 1825 to dig Het Kanaal.

facts.text: Construction halted by financial issues in 1834 before resuming in 1852.
facts.sourceQuote: Financiële en technische problemen legden het werk in 1834 stil, maar in 1852 konden zij hervat worden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Financial and technical problems stopped the work in 1834, but in 1852 it could be resumed.

facts.text: The canal featured two side arms known as the Shell Hole and the Beam Hole.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Kanaal had twee zijarmen: het Schelpengat bij de Neptunusstraat en het Balkengat bij de Seinpoststraat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Het Kanaal had two side arms: the Shell Hole near Neptunusstraat and the Beam Hole near Seinpoststraat.
